श: श The thirtieth consonant of the Nāgarī alphabet and first of the three sibilants; it is termed the palatal sibilant, and corresponds to Sh pronounced softly, as in Shun; in the Roman character it is distinguished by an accent, as S.
श m. (-शः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 A weapon. n. adv. (शं) or ind. (शं or शम्) Happy, happily, auspiciously. E. शी to sleep or शो to pare, &c. aff. ड.
शंयु: शंयु mfn. (-युः-युः-यु) Happy, prosperous, fortunate. m. (-युः) A sort of snake. E. शम् happily, and युस aff.
शंय्य: शंय्य mfn. (-य्यः-य्या-य्यं) Happy, fortunate. f. (-य्या) Knowledge, understanding. E. शम् happily, यस् aff.
शंव: शंव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Fortunate, prosperous. m. (-वः) 1 The thunderbolt of INDRA. 2 The iron head of a pestle. E. शं good fortune, and व poss. aff.; also as differently derived, read शम्ब and सम्ब, &c.
शंवर: शंवर n. (-रं) Water. E. शं happily, वृ to choose or cover, aff. अरप्, more usually read शम्बर, q. v.
शंस: शंस (उ,) शंसु r. 1st cl. (शंसति) 1 To praise. 2 To hurt. 3 To wish. 4 To calumniate. With अभि prefixed, To accuse wrongfully. With आङ् 1 To hope. 2 To speak. With प्र, To praise, to flatter; this root and its derivatives are sometimes read with the palatal sibilant final or शंश, &c.
शंसा: शंसा f. (-सा) 1 Speech. 2 Wish, desire. 3 Praise, flattery, eulogium. E. शंस to praise, &c. aff. अङ् and टाप्.
शंसित: शंसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Certain, ascertained. 2 Calumniated, falsely accused. 3 Said, declared. 4 Praised, celebrated. 5 Wished, desired. E. शंस to wish, aff. क्त.
शंस्तृ: शंस्तृ m. (-स्ता) An encomiast, a panegyrist, a flatterer. E. शंस to praise, तृन् Uṇādi aff.
शंस्थ: शंस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Happy, prosperous, well-faring. E. शं happily, स्था to stay or be, aff. क.
शंस्था: शंस्था mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) Happy, prosperous. E. शम् happily, ष्ठा to stay or be, aff. क्विप्.
शंस्य: शंस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 1 Desirable, to be wished. 2 Meritorious, to be praised. E. शंस to praise, &c. aff. क्यप्; also शस्य.
शक: शक r. 4th cl. (शक्यति-ते) r. 5th cl. (इर ऌ) इरशक्तृ (शक्नोति) 1 To bear patiently, to endure, to be patient. 2 To be able to effect, to be competent or powerful. (इ) शकि r. 1st cl. (शङ्कते) 1 To think probable, to suspect. 2 To fear, to apprehend. With आङ्, to dread.

शक m. (-कः) 1 A sovereign, any prince who gives his name to an era, especially applied to Śālivāhana. 2 A particular caste, the followers or descendants of ŚAKA, or Sālivāhana. 3 A country, or m. plu. (-काः) The inhabitants, the Sacœ, the Scythians. 4 An era: see शाक. E. शक to be able, aff. अच्.
शकट: शकट mfn. subst. (-टः-टी-टं) A cart. m. (-टः) 1 A Daitya slain by KṚṢṆA. 2 A cart load. E. शक to be able, अटन् Uṇādi aff.
शकटहन्: शकटहन् m. (-हा) KṚṢṆA. E. शकट the demon so named, and हन destroyer; also similar compounds, as शकटारि, &c.
शकटाल: शकटाल m. (-लः) The minister of NANDA: also read ŚAKATĀRA.
शकटाह्वा: शकटाह्वा f. (-ह्वा) The fourth lunar asterism, Rohiṇī, the stars of which are represented as a cart. E. शकट a cart, आह्व appellation.
शकटिका: शकटिका f. (-का) A small cart, a toy-cart. E. कन् added to शकटी.
शकल: शकल mn. (-लः-लं) A part, a portion, a piece. n. (-लं) 1 Skin. 2 Bark. 3 A kind of (black) pigment or die. 4 The scales of a fish. E. शक to be able, कलच् Uṇādi aff.
शकलिन्: शकलिन् m. (-ली) A fish. E. शकल skin or scales, and इनि aff.
शकलीकरण: शकलीकरण n. (-णं) Parting, dividing, cutting or breaking in pieces. E. शकल, and करण making, with च्चि. augment.
शकलीकृत: शकलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Parted, cut in pieces, wounded. E. शकल, कृत made, augment च्चि.
शकशकायत्: शकशकायत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) Rustling, making a noise (as the leaves of a tree in the wind.) E. शकत् imitative sound, nominal verb, शतृ aff.
शकान्तक: शकान्तक m. (-कः) 1 The prince, VIKRAMĀDITYA. 2 The name of SĀLIVĀHANA. E. शक an era or a Scythian, and अन्तक destroyer.
शकाब्द: शकाब्द n. (-ब्दं) 1 A year of the Śaka era, or era of SĀLIVĀHANA. E. शक, and अब्द a year.
शकार: शकार m. (-रः) A silly brother in law of a Raja.
शकारि: शकारि m. (-रिः) VIKRAMĀDITYA, the celebrated sovereign of Oujein. E. शक a Saca or Scythian, and अरि the foe.
शकुन: शकुन m. (-नः) 1 A bird in general. 2 A kind of bird, either the Indian vulture or the common kite, (Falco cheela); it is also applied to the Pondicherry eagle, (Falco ponticeriana.) 3 A sort of hymn or song, sung at festivals to solicit or secure lucky events. n. (-नं) Any lucky or auspicious object or omen. E. शक to be able, उन Uṇādi aff.
शकुनज्ञा: शकुनज्ञा f. (-ज्ञा) A small house lizard. E. शकुन a bird, and ज्ञ who knows.
शकुनि: शकुनि m. (-निः) 1 A bird. 2 The maternal uncle of the Kaurava princes, and counsellor of DURYODHANA. 3 One of the astronomical periods called Karaṇas. 4 The Indian kite or eagle, (Falco cheela.) f. (-नी) A hen sparrow. E. शक to be able, उनि Uṇādi aff.
शकुनिप्रपा: शकुनिप्रपा f. (-पा) A trough or little well for watering birds. E. शकुनि a bird, प्र before पा to drink, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
शकुनीश्वर: शकुनीश्वर m. (-रः) A name of GARUḌA. E. शकुनि a bird, and ईश्वर chief.
शकुन्त: शकुन्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A bird. 2 A kind of bird, the Indian vulture. 3 Another sort of bird, described as of aquatic habits, perhaps a kind of maritime or fishing falcon. 4 A sort of insect. 5 The blue jay. E. शक to be able, उन्त Uṇādi aff.; also शकुन, &c.
शकुन्तला: शकुन्तला f. (-ला) The daughter of MENAKĀ, the courtezan of Svarga, by the sage VIŚVĀMITRA, brought up by KAṆVA the hermit, and afterwards married to DUṢYANTA, by whom she became the mother of BHARATA, the sovereign of all India. E. शकुन्त a bird, ला to get, aff. क, and टाप्, being born in a solitary forest, and protected by the birds till found by KAṆVA.
शकुन्तलात्मज: शकुन्तलात्मज m. (-जः) BHARATA, the sovereign of India. E. शकुन्तला as above, and आत्मज the son.
शकुन्ति: शकुन्ति m. (-न्तिः) 1 A bird in general. 2 A kind of bird: see शकुन्त, &c. E. शक to be able, Uṇādi aff. उन्ति.
शकुन्तिका: शकुन्तिका f. (-का) A locust, a cricket. E. शकुन्त a bird, कन् aff. of comparison.
शकुल: शकुल m. (-लः) A fish. E. शक to be able, aff. उलच्.
शकुलगण्ड: शकुलगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A kind of fish, the gilt-head.
शकुलाक्षक: शकुलाक्षक m. (-कः) Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon), with white blossoms. E. शकुल a fish, अक्षि the eye, अच् substituted for the final vowel; the blossoms being compared to the eye of a fish.
शकुलादनी: शकुलादनी f. (-नी) 1 A medicinal plant, commonly Kaṭuki, (Wrightea antidysenterica.) 2 A creeping plant, (Jussieua repens.) 3 A drug, commonly Kāyaphal. 4 An earth worm. E. शकुल a fish, अद to eat, aff. ल्युट्.
शकुलार्भक: शकुलार्भक m. (-कः) A sort of gilt-head, (Sparus emarginatus.) E. शकुल a fish, and अर्भक a young one.
शकृत्: शकृत् n. (-कृत्) Fæces, excrement. E. शक to be able, (to expel,) Uṇādi aff. ऋतन्.
शकृत्करि: शकृत्करि mf. (-रिः-री) A calf. E. शकृत् ordure, कृ to make, इन् aff. in this sense.
शकृत्कार: शकृत्कार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Making ordure or fæces. E. शकृत् ordure, and कार who or what makes.
शकृद्वार: शकृद्वार n. (-रं) The anus. E. शकृत् fæces, and द्वार passage.
शक्कर: शक्कर m. (-रः) A bull. f. (-री) 1 A river. 2 A zone, a girdle. 3 A form of metre, a stanza of four lines of fourteen syllables each. 4 A woman of an impure caste; it is also read शक्वर, q. v.
शक्करि: शक्करि m. (-रिः) A bull; see the last.
शक्त: शक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Able, capable, strong, powerful. 2 Speaking civilly, able to please by the manner of speaking. 3 Diligent, attentive, intent. E. शक to be able, aff. क्त.
शक्तता: शक्तता f. (-ता,) Ability, power. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, शक्तत्वं.
शक्ति: शक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 Power, regal power as resulting from majesty, perseverance, and counsel. 2 Power, strength, prowess. 3 An iron spear or dart. 4 The energy or active power of a deity, personified as his wife, as GAURI of ŚIVA, LAKṢMĪ of VIṢṆU, &c. 5 The female organ as the counterpart of the phallic personification of ŚIVA, and worshipped either literally or figuratively by a sect of Hindus, thence termed Śāktas. 6 Allaying or appeasing opposition. 7 Force or signification of words. E. शक to be able, aff. क्तिन्.
शक्तिग्रह: शक्तिग्रह m. (-हः) 1 A name of ŚIVA. 2 KĀRTTIKEYA. 3 A spearman, a lancer. E. शक्ति a spear, and ग्रह who holds.
शक्तितस्: शक्तितस् ind. According to power or ability. E. शक्ति, and तसि aff.
शक्तित्रय: शक्तित्रय n. (-यं) The three ingredients of regal power; or king, minister, and vigour. E. शक्ति, and चय triad.
शक्तिधर: शक्तिधर m. (-रः) 1 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 A spearman, a lancer. E. शक्ति a spear, and धर the holder.
शक्तिपर्ण: शक्तिपर्ण m. (-र्णः) A tree, (Echites scholaris.) E. शक्ति strength, (giving it,) and पर्ण a leaf.
शक्तिपाणि: शक्तिपाणि m. (-णिः) 1 KĀRTTIKEYA, the Hindu MARS. 2 A spearman. E. शक्ति a spear, and पाणि the hand.
शक्तिभृत्: शक्तिभृत् m. (-भृत्) 1 KĀRTTIKEYA, see the last. 2 A soldier armed with a spear. E. शक्ति a spear, and भृत् who holds.
शक्तिमत्: शक्तिमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) Powerful, mighty. E. शक्ति, and मतुप् poss. aff.
शक्तिवैकल्य: शक्तिवैकल्य n. (-ल्यं) Inability, deficiency of power or strength. E. शक्ति, and वैकल्य imperfection.
शक्तिहीन: शक्तिहीन mfd. (-नः-ना-नं) Powerless, impotent. E. शक्ति, and हीन abandoned.
शक्तिहेतिक: शक्तिहेतिक m. (-कः) A spearman, a lancer, a soldier armed with an iron lance. E. शक्ति a spear, हेति a weapon, and कन् added.
शक्तु: शक्तु mn. (-क्तुः-क्तु) according to some authorities only m. plu. (शक्तवः) The powder or flour of barley and other grain, first fried and then ground. E. शच to go, &c. तुन् aff.; also read सक्तु.
शक्तुफला: शक्तुफला f. (-ला) The Śami tree, (Mimosa suma, Rox.) E. शक्त farina, and फल fruit; also शक्तुफली, and सक्तुफला.
शक्त्यपेक्ष: शक्त्यपेक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षा-क्षं) Being according to, or having reference to, ability, power, &c. E. शक्ति, and अपेक्षा regard to.
शक्न: शक्न mfn. (-क्नः-क्ना-क्नं) Speaking civilly or pleasingly: see the next.
शक्नु: शक्नु mfn. (-क्नुः-क्नुः-क्नु) Speaking civilly or kindly. E. शक to be able, (to please by speaking,) aff. क्नु; also with the vowel rejected शक्न, and with क्ल aff. शक्ल.
शक्मन्: शक्मन् m. (-क्मा) Power, strength. E. शक to be able, मनिन् Uṇādi aff.
शक्य: शक्य mfn. (-क्यः-क्या-क्यं) Possible, practicable, to be effected or done. E. शक to be able, aff. यत्.
शक्यता: शक्यता f. (-ता) Possibility. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, शक्यत्वं.
शक्यप्रतीकार: शक्यप्रतीकार m. (-रः) A possible remedy or counteragent. E. शक्य, and प्रतीकार remedy.
शक्र: शक्र m. (-क्रः) INDRA, the chief of the inferior gods, and ruler of Svarga or paradise. 2 A plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.) 3 A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) E. शक to possess power, Uṇādi aff. रक्.
शक्रक्रीडाचल: शक्रक्रीडाचल m. (-लः) Mount Meru. E. शक्र INDRA, क्रीडा sport, pleasure, and अचल a mountain.
शक्रगोप: शक्रगोप m. (-पः) An insect of a red colour, (Coccinella or ladybird of various species.) E. शक्र INDRA, गो light, &c. and पा to preserve, aff. क.
शक्रज: शक्रज m. (-जः) A crow. E. शक्र INDRA, and ज born.
शक्रजात: शक्रजात m. (-तः) A crow. E. शक्र INDRA, and जात born.
शक्रजित्: शक्रजित् m. (-जित्) The son of RĀVAṆA. E. शक्र INDRA, and जित् victor.
शक्रधनुस्: शक्रधनुस् n. (-नुः) The bow of INDRA, the rain-bow. E. शक्र INDRA, and धनुस् the bow.
शक्रध्वज: शक्रध्वज n. (-जं) A pole or flag set up in honour of INDRA. E. शक्र, and ध्वज a flag.
शक्रनन्दन: शक्रनन्दन m. (-नः) ARJUNA. E. शक्र INDRA, and नन्दन son.
शक्रपादप: शक्रपादप m. (-पः) A sort of pine, (P. devadaru, Rox.) E. शक्र INDRA, and पादप a tree.
शक्रपुष्पी: शक्रपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A sort of potherb; also Viśalyā. E. शक्र the Pentaptera arjuna, and पुष्प a flower; having similar flowers.
शक्रभवन: शक्रभवन n. (-नं) Sky, heaven. E. शक्र INDRA, and भवन abode; being the god of the firmament: it also occurs शक्रभुवन, from भुवन a world.
शक्रभिद्: शक्रभिद् m. (-भिद्) The son of RĀVAṆA. E. शक्र INDRA, and भिद् defeater.
शक्रमूर्द्ध्वन्: शक्रमूर्द्ध्वन् m. (-र्द्ध्वा) An ant hill, a hillock. E. शक्र INDRA, मूर्द्ध्वन् the head.
शक्रवाहन: शक्रवाहन m. (-नः) A cloud. E. शक्र INDRA, and वाहन vehicle.
शक्रशरासन: शक्रशरासन n. (-नं) The rain-bow. E. शक्र INDRA, शरासन a bow.
शक्रशाला: शक्रशाला f. (-ला) A place prepared for sacrifices to be offered in. E. शक्र INDRA, and शाला a hall.
शक्रशिरस्: शक्रशिरस् n. (-रः) An ant hill E. शक्र. INDRA, and शिरस् the head.
शक्रसारथि: शक्रसारथि m. (-थिः) The charioteer of INDRA. E. शक्र, and सारथि a coachman.
शक्रसुत: शक्रसुत m. (-तः) 1 The monkey king BALI. 2 ARJUNA. E. शक्र INDRA, and सुत the son.
शक्रसुधा: शक्रसुधा f. (-धा) The resin of the Boswellia thurifera, or gum olibanum. E. शक्र INDRA, and सुधा ambrosia.
शक्रसृष्टा: शक्रसृष्टा f. (-ष्टा) Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) E. शक्र INDRA, सृष्ट created; springing originally, it is said, from the ground on which INDRA spilt a drop of nectar as he was drinking.
शक्राणी: शक्राणी f. (-णी) SACĪ, the wife of INDRA. E. शक्र INDRA, ङीष् aff. and आनुक् inserted.
शक्राशन: शक्राशन m. (-नः) A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.) E. शक्र INDRA, अशन food: created by him; springing from the drops of Amṛta, which fell on the ground from the bodies of the monkies slain in the war with RĀVAṆA, and who were restored to life by INDRA by a shower of Amṛta, or the liquor of immortality.
शक्रोत्सव: शक्रोत्सव m. (-वः) A festival in honour of INDRA on the twelfth of the month Bhādra. E. शक्र INDRA, and उत्सव a festival.
शक्ल: शक्ल mfn. (-क्लः-क्ला-क्लं) Speaking civilly or kindly. E. शक to be able, (to delight simply by speaking,) and क्ल Uṇādi affix; also शक्न and शक्नु.
शक्वन्: शक्वन् m. (-क्वा) An elephant. E. शक to be powerful, and वनिप् Uṇādi aff.
शक्वर: शक्वर m. (-रः) A bull, an ox. f. (-री) 1 A finger. 2 A river. 3 A zone, a girdle. 4 A form of metre, a stanza of four lines of fourteen syllables each, and comprising many varieties according to the different feet of which the lines are composed. E. शक to be able or strong, क्वरप् aff., or वनिप् aff. with र augment, and the final rejected: the feminine form is also derived from शक्वन् with ङीप् affix, and र augment, and the word is also read शक्कर and शक्करी.
शङ्क: शङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) A draft ox. f. (-ङ्का) 1 Fear, terror, apprehension. 2 Doubt, uncertainty. 3 A species of the Daṇḍaka metre. E. शकि to fear, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
शङ्कनीय: शङ्कनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Doubtful, questionable, to be doubted or apprehended. E. शकि to fear or doubt, अनीयर् aff.; also शङ्कितव्य and शङ्क्य.
शङ्कर: शङ्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Auspicious, propitious, conferring happiness or good fortune. m. (-रः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 The name of a celebrated teacher of the Vedānta philosophy. f. (-री) Bengal madder. E. शं good fortune, कर making.
शङ्करप्रिय: शङ्करप्रिय m. (-यः) The francoline partridge. E. शङ्कर ŚIVA, and प्रिय dear, beloved.
शङ्कान्वित: शङ्कान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Apprehensive, doubtful, afraid. E. शङ्का, अन्वित possessed of.
शङ्काभियोग: शङ्काभियोग m. (-गः) Accusation or charge on suspicion. E. शङ्का, and अभियोग charge.
शङ्कामय: शङ्कामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Fearful, afraid. E. शङ्का, and मयट् aff.
शङ्कास्पद: शङ्कास्पद n. (-दं) Cause or matter of doubt or apprehension. E. शङ्का, and आस्पद site.
शङ्काहीन: शङ्काहीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Free from doubt or apprehension. E. शङ्का, and हीन free from.
शङ्कित: शङ्कित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Alarmed, frightened. 2 Weak, unsteady. 3 Doubtful, uncertain. E. शङ्का fear, इतच् aff.
शङ्कितवर्णक: शङ्कितवर्णक m. (-कः) A thief. E. शङ्कित frightened, वर्ण a caste, कन् aff.
शङ्कु: शङ्कु m. (-ङ्कुः) 1 The trunk of a lopped tree. 2 A javelin. 3 A pin, a stake, a pale. 4 The gnomon of a dial, usually twelve fingers long. 5 A long thin column in front of a pagoda. 6 The penis. 7 A number. 8 The small fibres of a leaf. 9 The scate fish, (Raia Sankur, HAM.) 10 A sort of perfume, commonly Nakhi. 11 A goose. 12 An ant hill. 13 A goblin, a demon. 14 A Gandharba attached to ŚIVA. 15 A name of ŚIVA. 16 KĀMA. 17 Sin. 18 Fear, terror. E. शकि to doubt or apprehend, aff. उ.
शङ्कुकर्ण: शङ्कुकर्ण m. (-र्णः) An ass. E. शङ्कु a javelin, and कर्ण the ear.
शङ्कुतरु: शङ्कुतरु m. (-रुः) The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. शङ्कु a stake, and तरु a tree.
शङ्कुवृक्ष: शङ्कुवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Śāl tree. E. शङ्कु a pin or stake, and वृक्ष tree.
शङ्कुर: शङ्कुर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Formidable, fearful, frightful. E. शङ्कु fear, रा to give or cause, aff. ड.
शङ्कुला: शङ्कुला f. (-ला) A pair of nippers, used to cut the betel nut into small pieces.
शङ्कोच: शङ्कोच m. (-चः) A scate fish; also शङ्कु, शङ्कुचि, and शङ्कोचि.
शङ्क्य: शङ्क्य mfn. (-ङ्क्यः-ङ्क्या-ङ्क्यं) To be feared or doubted. E. शकि to fear. यत् aff.
शङ्ख: शङ्ख mn. (-ङ्खः-ङ्खं) The conch shell used by the Hindus, in two ways especially; offering libations with it, or when perforated at one end blowing it as a horn at sacrifices: used in this manner also, frequent, mention of it occurs in the battle pieces of the poets, each hero being provided with a Conch as his horn. m. (-ङ्खः) 1 One of KUVERA'S treasures. 2 The temple or temporal bone, sometimes comprising however the frontal bone also. 3 A perfume, commonly Nakhi, apparently a dried shell fish. 4 A military drum. 5 One of the eight chiefs of the Nāgas or serpents of Pātāla, described as of a yellow colour. 6 An elephant's cheek. 7 A large number, ten or a hundred billions. 8 The name of a saint and legislator. 9 A poet, one of the nine gems, &c. E. शम to pacify, &c. Uṇādi aff. ख.
शङ्खक: शङ्खक n. (-कं) A bracelet, (often made of the conch shell.) mn. (-कः-कं) 1 The conch shell. 2 Pain, and heat with a puffiness in the temples and forehead. 3 The temples. E. कन् added to the last.
शङ्खकार: शङ्खकार m. (-रः) A worker in shells. E. शङ्ख a conch, and कार maker.
शङ्खचरी: शङ्खचरी f. (-री) Sandal marks on the forehead. E. शङ्ख the forehead, and चर to go, aff. टच् and ङीष्.
शङ्खचर्ची: शङ्खचर्च्ची f. (-र्च्ची) Sandal marks made across the forehead. E. शङ्ख the forehead, चर्च to anoint, affs. अच् and ङीष्.
शङ्खचर्च्ची: शङ्खचर्च्ची f. (-र्च्ची) Sandal marks made across the forehead. E. शङ्ख the forehead, चर्च to anoint, affs. अच् and ङीष्.
शङ्खज: शङ्खज m. (-जः) A large pearl, of the shape of a pigeon's egg. E. शङ्ख a shell, and ज born.
शङ्खध्म: शङ्खध्म m. (-ध्मः) A shell blower. E. शङ्ख a conch, and घ्म who blows.
शङ्खनख: शङ्खनख m. (-खः) 1 A small shell. 2 A perfume, commonly नखी. E. शङ्ख a conch, and नख the nail.
शङ्खपाल: शङ्खपाल m. (-लः) 1 The sun. 2 A Nāga or serpent of Pātāla. E. शङ्ख a conch, &c., and पाल who nourishes.
शङ्खपुष्पी: शङ्खपुष्पी f. (-ष्पी) A sort of grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.) E. शङ्ख a conch, पुष्प a flower, ङीप् aff. implying resemblance.
शङ्खप्रस्थ: शङ्खप्रस्थ m. (-स्थः) Spots in the moon. E. शङ्ख a shell, and प्रस्थ pre-eminent.
शङ्खभृत्: शङ्खभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) Having a conch or shell. m. (-भृत्) VIṢṆU. E. शङ्ख a conch, and भृत् who possesses.
शङ्खमुख: शङ्खमुख m. (-खः) An alligator. E. शङ्ख a conch, and मुख face.
शङ्खिका: शङ्खिका f. (-का) A kind of grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.) E. शंख a shell, कन् implying resemblance, fem. form.
शङ्खिन्: शङ्खिन् mfn. (-ङ्खी-ङ्खिनी-ङ्खि) Possessing or having a conch or shell, &c. m. (-ङ्खी) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 The ocean. 3 A shell blower. 4 A worker in shells. f. (-नी) 1 A sort of grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.) 2 A plant, (Cissampelos hexandra.) 3 A description of woman, one of the four classes into which females are divided in erotic writings: the Śaṅkhinī is described as tall, with long hair, neither stout nor thin, of irascible disposition and strong passions. 4 A goddess or Śakti worshipped by the Bauddhas. 5 A female spirit or goblin. E. शङ्ख a shell, इनि aff.
शङ्खिनीवास: शङ्खिनीवास m. (-सः) A small tree, (Trophis aspera.)
शच: शच r. 1st cl. (शचते) To speak articulately, to say or tell. (इ,) शचि r. 1st cl. (शंचते) To go, to move.
शचि: शचि f. (-चिः or ची) 1 The wife of INDRA. 2 A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.) 3 The astronomical Karaṇa or period named Viṣṭi. E. शच to speak articulately, aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added; also सचि, and सची.
शचीपति: शचीपति m. (-तिः) INDRA. E. शची the wife of the deity, and पति husband.
शट: शट r. 1st cl. (शटति) 1 To be diseased or sick. 2 To divide, to pierce or separate. 3 To go. 4 To be low spirited, to be weary or dejected. r. 10th cl. (शाटयति) To flatter, to praise.
शट mfn. (-टः-टा-टं) Sour, astringent, acid. E. शट to pain, aff. अच्.
शटा: शटा f. (-टा) An ascetic's clotted hair: see सटा.
शटी: शटी f. (-टिः or -टी) Zedoary, (Curcuma zerumbet,) otherwise considered as a synonym of the Ambahaldi, or Curcuma Amhaldi, the mango-smelling ginger, so termed because the fresh root possesses the smell of a green mango. E. शट to divide (remove disease), aff. इन, and ङीष optionally added.
शठ: शठ r. 1st cl. (शठति) 1 To cheat, to defraud or deceive. 2 To kill or hurt. 3 To suffer pain. r. 10th cl. (शाठयति) 1 To finish. 2 To leave unfinished. 3 To go or move. (शठयति) 1 To speak ill. 2 To speak well. 3 To abstain from speaking. (शाठयते) To flatter, to coax, to praise.

शठ mfn. (-ठः-ठा-ठं) Wicked, depraved, perverse, dishonest. m. (-ठः) 1 An umpire, a mediator, an arbitrator. 2 A rogue, a knave. 3 A blockhead, a fool. 4 An idler. 5 A false husband or lover, one who pretends affection to one female whilst his heart is fixed on another. 6 Thorn apple, (Datura metel.) n. (-ठं) 1 A sort of root, commonly Tagara. 2 Saffron. 3 Iron. E. शठ to be wicked, aff. अच्.
शठता: शठता f. (-ता) Wickedness, depravity. E. शट wicked, तल् aff.; also शठत्व n. (-त्वं.)
शड: शड (इ) शडि r. 1st cl. (शंडते) 1 To disease or disorder. 2 To hurt or wound. 3 To collect, to heap together.
शण: शण r. 1st cl. (शणति) 1 To give. 2 To move.
शण n. (-णं) 1 Hemp, (Cannabis sativa.) 2 Bengal Saṇ, a plant from which a kind of hemp is prepared, (Crotolaria juncea and other kinds.) 3 An arrow. E. शण to give, aff. अच्.
शणतन्तु: शणतन्तु f. (-न्तुः) The thread or string made of the flax of the Crotolaria juncea. E. शण, and तन्तु string.
शणतान्तव: शणतान्तव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Made of Saṇ string. E. शणतन्तु, and अण् aff.
शणपर्णी: शणपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A tree, (Pentaptera tomentosa.) E. शण Saṇ, and पर्ण a leaf, having similar leaves.
शणपुष्पिका: शणपुष्पिका f. (-का) Crotolaria of several species. E. शण the Saṇ, पुष्प a flower, aff. ङीष्, and कन् added, fem. form, implying resemblance; also शणपुष्पी, &c.
शणसूत्र: शणसूत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 The fibre or flax of the Saṇ plant, or string made from it. 2 A net made of hemp or of Saṇ, or the thread of the Crotolaria juncea. 3 Cordage, twine. E. शण hemp, &c. सूत्र a thread.
शणीर: शणीर n. (-रं) 1 A rock or small island in the midst of the river Śoṇa. 2 An insular spot inclosed by the branches of the Serjū, where it falls into the Ganges above Cūprah, at Bhṛgurāśrama or Bageressan; called also, the bank of the Dardarī.
शण्ड: शण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A bull at liberty. 2 A eunuch. n. (-ण्डं) A multitude of lotus flowers. E. शण or षण to give, aff. ड, hence also षण्ड, and differently derived, शण्ठ or षण्ट the more usual form.
शण्डता: शण्डता f. (-ता) 1 The state of a bull let loose or at liberty. 2 Emasculation. E. शण्ड a bull at liberty, &c. तल् aff.
शण्डिल: शण्डिल m. (-लः) The name of a Muni, and ancestor of a particular family of Brahmans. E. शण्ड a eunuch, and इलच् Uṇādi aff.
शण्ढ: शण्ढ m. (-ण्ढः) 1 A eunuch. 2 A eunuch or emasculated attendant, as employed in a Haram or seraglio. 3 An impotent man. 4 A bull at liberty. 5 A mad man or a drunken man. E. शम to bear or endure, Uṇādi aff. ढ; also षण्ढ and शण्ड, &c.
शतक: शतक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A hundred. m. (-कः) A century, a cento, a collection of one hundred stanzas, &c. E. शत a hundred, and कन् aff.
शतकीर्ति: शतकीर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) A Jina or Jaina pontiff of the last age. E. शत a hundred, and कीर्त्ति fame.
शतकीर्त्ति: शतकीर्त्ति m. (-र्त्तिः) A Jina or Jaina pontiff of the last age. E. शत a hundred, and कीर्त्ति fame.
शतकुम्भ: शतकुम्भ n. (-म्भं) Gold. m. (-म्भः) The name of a mountain. f. (-म्भा) A plant, (Phyalis flexuosa.) E. शत a hundred, and कुम्भ a water jar.
शतकोटि: शतकोटि m. (-टिः) INDRA'S thunderbolt. E. शत a hundred, and कोटि edge.
शतक्रतु: शतक्रतु m. (-तुः) INDRA. E. शत a hundred, क्रतु sacrifice; a hundred Aśvamedhas or sacrifices of an unbroken horse, elevating the sacrificer to the place and title of INDRA.
शतगु: शतगु mfn. (-गुः-गुः-गु) Possessed of a hundred cows, with as many, &c. E. शत and गु for गो a cow.
शतगुण: शतगुण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) A hundred times, a hundred fold. E. शत, and गुण a time.
शतघ्नी: शतघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) 1 A weapon; it is generally supposed to be a sort of fire arms, or the ancient Indian rocket, but it is also described as a stone set round with iron spikes. 2 A female scorpion. 3 A plant, (Galedupa arborea.) 4 A disease of the throat, apparently enlargement of the tonsils. E. शत a hundred, हन to kill, aff. अण् and ङीष्, and the radical letters changed.
शतच्छद: शतच्छद m. (-दः) The wood-pecker. E. शत a hundred, च्छद a feather.
शततम: शततम mfn. (-मः-मी-मं) Hundredth. E. शत a hundred, तमट् aff.
शततारा: शततारा f. (-रा) The constellation Śatabhiṣā, q. v. E. शत a hundred or many, and तारा a star.
शतद्रु: शतद्रु f. (-द्रुः) The Setlej river, which rises in the Himālaya mountains, in the vicinity it is supposed of the Rāvanhrad or lake, and running to the S. W. unites in the Pañjāb with the Beyah or Vipāśā, when it forms the Hyphasis of the Greeks, and falls into the Indus below Multan. E. शत a hundred (fold, or in a hundred branches), द्रु to flow, Uṇādi aff. कु.
शतद्वार: शतद्वार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Hundred-gated, having a hundred or a number of doors or outlets. E. शत, and द्वार a door.
शतधा: शतधा f. (-घा) Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.) ind. In a hundred ways, a hundredfold. E. शत a hundred (blossoms), धा to have, क and टाप् affs. or शत the same, and घाच् aff.
शतधामन्: शतधामन् m. (-मा) VIṢṆU. E. शत a hundred, (i. e. many,) घामन् body; being multiplied in as many shapes as the creation exhibits.
शतधार: शतधार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Flowing in many streams. 2 Having many edges, &c. n. (-रं) The thunderbolt. E. शत a hundred, घारा an edge, टच् added.
शतधृति: शतधृति m. (-तिः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 INDRA. E. शत a hundred, and धृति sacrifice.
शतपत्र: शतपत्र n. (-त्रं) A lotus in general, (Nelumbium speciosum or Nymphæa nelumbo). m. (-त्रः) 1 A peacock. 2 The Sāras or Indian crane. 3 A wood-pecker. 4 A parrot, the king parrot or Loory. f. (-त्रा) A woman. E. शत a hundred, पत्र a leaf or feather.
शतपत्रक: शतपत्रक m. (-कः) The wood-pecker. E. कन् added to the last, q. v.
शतपथिक: शतपथिक mf. (-कः-की-कं) Following a variety of paths or doctrines. E. शत a hundred, पथिन् a road and figuratively a doctrine, aff. षिकन्.
शतपदी: शतपदी f. (-दी) A centipede, jaulus. E. शत a hundred, and पद a foot, ङीष् aff.
शतपद्म: शतपद्म n. (-द्मं) The white lotus. E. शत a hundred (leaves), and पद्म a lotus.
शतपर्वन्: शतपर्व्वन् m. (-र्व्वा) A bambu. E. शत a hundred or many, पर्व्वन् a joint or knot.
शतपर्व्वन्: शतपर्व्वन् m. (-र्व्वा) A bambu. E. शत a hundred or many, पर्व्वन् a joint or knot.
शतपर्वा: शतपर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) 1 Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.) 2 Orris root. 3 The wife of ŚUKRA. 4 Day of full moon in the month Āśvina. E. शत a hundred, पर्व्वन् a joint or period, ङीप् aff.
शतपर्व्वा: शतपर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) 1 Bent grass, (Panicum dactylon.) 2 Orris root. 3 The wife of ŚUKRA. 4 Day of full moon in the month Āśvina. E. शत a hundred, पर्व्वन् a joint or period, ङीप् aff.
शतपर्विका: शतपर्व्विका f. (-का) 1 Bent grass or Dūb. 2 Orris root. 3 Barley. E. कन् fem. form, added to the last.
शतपर्व्विका: शतपर्व्विका f. (-का) 1 Bent grass or Dūb. 2 Orris root. 3 Barley. E. कन् fem. form, added to the last.
शतपर्वेश: शतपर्व्वेश m. (-शः) The planet VENUS or its regent. E. शतपर्व्वा the wife of ŚUKRA, and ईश lord or husband.
शतपर्व्वेश: शतपर्व्वेश m. (-शः) The planet VENUS or its regent. E. शतपर्व्वा the wife of ŚUKRA, and ईश lord or husband.
शतपाद्: शतपाद् f. (-पाद् or -पात्) A centipede. E. शत a hundred, and पाद् a foot.
शतपादिका: शतपादिका f. (-का) 1 A medicinal root, commonly Kākoli. 2 A centipede. E. शत a hundred, पाद a foot or root, कन् aff. fem. form.
शतपुष्प: शतपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) The poet BHĀRAVI, the author of the Kirātārjunīya. f. (-ष्पा) A sort of dill or fennel, (Anethum sowa.) E. शत a hundred, and पुष्प a flower.
शतपुष्पिका: शतपुष्पिका f. (-का) Anethum, (sowa.) E. कन् fem. form, added to the last.
शतपोनक: शतपोनक m. (-कः) Fistula in ano with many external openings. E. कन् added to the last.
शतपोरक: शतपोरक m. (-कः) A kind of sugar cane.
शतप्रास: शतप्रास m. (-सः) A flower, (Nerium odorum.) E. शत a hundred, and प्रास a dart, to which the leaves are compared.
शतभिषज्: शतभिषज् f. (-षक्) One of the lunar asterisms, see the next. E. शत a hundred, भिषज् a physician.
शतभिषा: शतभिषा f. (-षा) The twenty-fifth of the Nakṣatras or lunar mansions, containing 100 stars, one of which is λ Aquarii. E. शत a hundred, भिषज् to cure, aff. ड; requiring many physicians; as the Hindus say DHANVANTARI himself cannot cure any person affected with disease, whilst the moon is in this asterism.
शतभीरु: शतभीरु f. (-रुः) Arabian jasmine, (J. zambac.) E. शत a hundred (dangers), भीरु timid.
शतमख: शतमख m. (-स्वः) INDRA. E. शत a hundred, and मख a sacrifice: the performance of a hundred Aśvamedhas obtaining this situation.
शतमन्यु: शतमन्यु m. (-न्युः) INDRA. E. शत a hundred, and मन्यु a sacrifice; see the last.
शतमान: शतमान mn. (-नः-नं) 1 A Pala of silver. 2 An ĀḌhaka or measure so termed. E. शत a hundred, and मान measure.
शतमारिन्: शतमारिन् m. (-री) A man who has killed a hundred others. E. शत, and मारिन् a killer.
शतमार्ज: शतमार्ज m. (-र्जः) An armourer, a cutler. E. शत a hundred, (many, weapons,) and मार्ज who cleans.
शतमुख: शतमुख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) 1 Having a hundred mouths. 2 Having a hundred openings or outlets. E. शत, and मुस्व mouth.
शतमूली: शतमूली f. (-ली) A plant, (Asparagus racemosus.) E. शत a hundred or many, मूल a root, fem. aff. ङीष्; also with कन् added शतमूलिका.
शतयष्टिक: शतयष्टिक m. (-कः) A necklace of 100 strings. E. शत a hundred, यष्टि a string, कन् added.
शतलक्ष: शतलक्ष n. (-क्षं) A hundred Lakhs, ten millions. E. शत, and लक्ष a hundred thousand.
शतलुम्पक: शतलुम्पक m. (-कः) A name of the poet BHĀRAVI.
शतवर्ष: शतवर्ष mfn. (-र्षः-र्षा-र्षं) Of a hundred years, a century old. n. (-र्षं) A century. E. शत, and वर्ष a year.
शतवीर्या: शतवीर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) White Dūb grass, (Panicum dactylon with white blossoms.) E. शत a hundred, वीय्य seed.
शतवीर्य्या: शतवीर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) White Dūb grass, (Panicum dactylon with white blossoms.) E. शत a hundred, वीय्य seed.
शतवेधिन्: शतवेधिन् m. (-धी) A sort of dock or sorrel, (Oxalis monadelpha or Rumex vesicarius.) E. शत a hundred, व्यध to pierce, aff. णिनि.
शतशस्: शतशस् ind. By hundreds, a hundred fold. E. शत, and शसि aff.
शतशाख: शतशाख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) 1 Having many branches. 2 Multiform, various. E. शत, and शाखा a branch.
शतसहस्र: शतसहस्र n. (-स्रं) A hundred thousand. E. शत, and सहस्र a thousand.
शतसहस्रशस्: शतसहस्रशस् ind. By myriads. E. शस् added to the last.
शतसाहस्र: शतसाहस्र mfn. (-स्रः-स्री-स्रं) Having a hundred thousand, bought with, consisting of, &c. E. शतसहस्र, and अण् aff.
शतह्रदा: शतह्रदा f. (-दा) 1 Lightning. 2 The thunderbolt. E. शत a hundred, ह्रद a ray of light, or ह्राद sound, and the vowel made short; read also, शतह्रादा.
शताक्ष: शताक्ष mfn. (-क्षः-क्षी-क्षं) Hundred eyed. f. (-क्षी) 1 Night. 2 A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa). 3 The goddess PĀRVATĪ. E. शत a hundred, अक्ष for अक्षि the eye.
शताङ्ग: शताङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A car, a chariot. E. शत a hundred, and अङ्ग a part.
शतानक: शतानक n. (-कं) A place where dead bodies are burnt or buried, a burial ground, a cemetery. E. शत a hundred, आनक a drum.
शतानन्द: शतानन्द m. (-न्दः) 1 BRAHMĀ. 2 VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. 3 The car of VIṢṆU. 4 The Muni GAUTAMA, the founder of the logical school of philosophy. 5 The eldest son of GAUTAMA, (according to the Rāmāyaṇa,) and Purohita or religious adviser of JANAKA of Mithila. E. शत a hundred or many, and आनन्द who delights.
शतानीक: शतानीक m. (-कः) 1 An old man. 2 The name of a sovereign, the son and successor of JANAMEJAYA. 3 The name of a saint, the pupil of VYĀSA. E. शत a hundred, आङ् before नी to obtain, कप् aff.
शतायुस्: शतायुस् m. (-युः) A man a hundred years old, an old man. E. शत, and आयुस् life.
शतार: शतार n. (-रं) The thunderbolt. E. शत a hundred, ऋ to go, aff. अण्.
शतारुस्: शतारुस् nf. (-रुः-रुषी) A leprous disease of the skin. E. शत hundred or many, and अरुस् a sore.
शतावर: शतावर m. (-रः) A fine of a hundred (Paṇas, &c.) E. शत, and अवर inferior.
शतावरी: शतावरी f. (-री) 1 A shrub, (Asparagus racemosus.) 2 The wife of INDRA. E. शत a hundred (roots), आङ् before वृ to choose, aff. अच्.
शतावर्त: शतावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) VIṢṆU. E. शत a hundred, आवर्त्त revolving.
शतावर्त्त: शतावर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) VIṢṆU. E. शत a hundred, आवर्त्त revolving.
शतावर्तिन्: शतावर्त्तिन् m. (-र्त्ती) VIṢṆU. E. शत a hundred, आवर्त्त revolving, (appearances, or in the mind of his worshippers), इनि aff.
शतावर्त्तिन्: शतावर्त्तिन् m. (-र्त्ती) VIṢṆU. E. शत a hundred, आवर्त्त revolving, (appearances, or in the mind of his worshippers), इनि aff.
शताह्वा: शताह्वा f. (-ह्वा-ह्वी) A sort of dill or fennel, (Anethum sowa.) E. शत a hundred, and आह्ना name, appellation.
शतिक: शतिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Indicative of a hundred, (as a sign or omen.) 2 Doing or effecting any thing with a hundred. 3 Bearing tax or interest per hundred. 4 Bought with a hundred. 5 Changed with or for a hundred, &c. 6 Relating or belonging to a hundred. E. शत a hundred, and ठक or ठञ् or ठन् aff.; also with यत् aff. शत्य in the same acceptations.
शतेर: शतेर m. (-रः) 1 An enemy. 2 Injury, detriment, hurt. E. शद to decay, to go, Uṇādi aff. एरक, and द changed to त.
शतेश: शतेश m. (-शः) The ruler or head man of a hundred (villages). E. शत, and ईश sovereign.
शत्त्रि: शत्त्रि m. (-त्त्रिः) An elephant. E. शद to go, त्त्रिप् Uṇādi aff.
शत्य: शत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) Bought with a hundred, &c. see शतिक.
शत्रु: शत्रु m. (-त्रः) 1 An enemy, a foe, an adversary. 2 A political enemy, a neighbouring prince as being one with whom disputes are likely to occur. E. शद to go, Uṇādi aff. त्रुन्.
शत्रुंसह: शत्रुंसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Bearing or patient with an enemy. E. शत्रु, सह to bear, खच् aff.
शत्रुघात: शत्रुघात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Who beats or kills an enemy. E. शत्रु, and घात who kills.
शत्रुघ्न: शत्रुघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Killing a foe. m. (-घ्नः) The second brother of RĀMACANDRA, the son of SUMITRĀ, and uterine brother of LAKṢMAṆA. E. शत्रु an enemy, and घ्न destroyer.
शत्रुघ्नजननी: शत्रुघ्नजननी f. (-नी) SUMITRĀ, the mother of LAKṢMAṆA, and ŚATRUGHNA. E. शत्रुघ्न ŚATRUGHNA, and जननी the mother.
शत्रुञ्जय: शत्रुञ्जय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Subduing an enemy. m. (-यः) 1 The mountain Vimala, or Girnār, or a mountainous range in Guzerat. 2 An elephant. E. शत्रु a foe, जि to conquer, खच् aff.
शत्रुता: शत्रुता f. (-ता) Hostility, enmity. E. तल् added to शत्रु; also शत्रुत्वं.
शत्रुनिकाय: शत्रुनिकाय m. (-यः) A number or host of enemies. E. शत्रु, and निकाय a quantity.
शत्रुनिलय: शत्रुनिलय m. (-यः) The dwelling of a foe. E. शत्रु, and निलय abode.
शत्रुन्तप: शत्रुन्तप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Humbling or subduing enemies. E. शत्रु, तप to harass, खच् aff.
शत्रुपक्ष: शत्रुपक्ष m. (-क्षः) An antagonist, an enemy. E. शत्रु, and पक्ष side or part.
शत्रुमर्दन: शत्रुमर्द्दन m. (-नः) ŚATRUGHNA, the brother of RĀMA. E. शत्रु a foe, मर्द्दन destroyer.
शत्रुमर्द्दन: शत्रुमर्द्दन m. (-नः) ŚATRUGHNA, the brother of RĀMA. E. शत्रु a foe, मर्द्दन destroyer.
शत्वरी: शत्वरी f. (-री) Night. E. शद to go, क्वरप् aff.; fem. aff. ङीप्.
शद: शद (औ ऌ) औ शदॢ r. 1st and 6th cls. (शीयते) 1 To perish gradually, to wither or decay. 2 To fall. 3 To throw down. 4 To go, to move.
शद m. (-दः) A vegetable, any edible vegetable product, as fruits, roots, &c. E. शद to wither, aff. अच्.
शद्रि: शद्रि m. (-द्रिः) 1 A cloud. 2 An elephant. 3 ARJUNA. f. (-द्रिः) Lightning. 4 Clayed or candied sugar. E. शद to go, क्रिन् Uṇādi aff.
शद्रु: शद्रु mfn. (-द्रुः-द्रुः-द्रु) 1 Wasting, decaying. 2 Going, moving. E. शद to go, रु aff.
शनपर्णी: शनपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A medicinal plant, (Wrightea antidysenterica.)
शनि: शनि m. (-निः) The planet SATURN or its regent. E. शो to destroy, or शण to give, aff. इन्.
शनिज: शनिज n. (-जं) Black pepper. E. शनि SATURN, and ज born.
शनिप्रसू: शनिप्रसू f. (-सूः) CHĀYA, the wife of the sun. E. शनि SATURN, and प्रसू the mother.
शनिप्रिय: शनिप्रिय n. (-यं) The emerald or sapphire. E. शनि SATURN, and प्रिय dear to.
शनिवार: शनिवार m. (-रः) Saturday. E. शनि the planet, and वार in this and similar compounds, a day.
शनैश्चर: शनैश्चर m. (-रः) The planet SATURN or its mythological personification. E. शनैस् slowly, and चर who goes.
शनैस्: शनैस् ind. 1 Slowly, tardily. 2 Independantly, at will. E. शण to give, (to produce,) aff. ऐम्, and the consonant changed.
शप्: शप् ind. A particle and prefix of assent or acceptance, as शप्करोति he accepts.
शप: शप r. 1st cl. (शपति-ते) r. 4th cl. (शप्यति-ते) 1 To revile, to wish evil or imprecations on, to curse, to swear. 2 To take an oath.
शप m. (-पः) 1 An oath. 2 An imprecation, a curse, cursing. 3 A corpse; also शव. E. शप to curse, aff. अच्.
शपथ: शपथ m. (-थः) 1 An oath, asseveration by oath or ordeal. 2 An imprecation, a curse. 3 Cursing, wishing ill to. E. शप to swear, Uṇādi aff. अथ.
शपन: शपन n. (-नं) An oath, confirmation of the truth by oath or ordeal. 2 Abuse, imprecation, cursing, malediction. E. शप to curse, aff. ल्युट्.
शपमान: शपमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Revilling, imprecating. 2 Swearing. E. शप to curse, शानच् aff.
शप्त: शप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) 1 Cursed, anathematised. 2 Sworn, taken as an oath. m. (-प्तः) A sort of grass, (Saccharum cylindricum). E. शप to curse, aff. क्त.
शफ: शफ mn. (-फः-फं) 1 A hoof in general. 2 The root of a tree. 3 The hoof of a horse. E. शम to be tranquil, aff. अच्, and the final changed to फ.
शफर: शफर mf. (-रः-री) A small fish, (Cyprinus Sophore, HAM.) E. शफ a hoof, रा to give, (to resemble,) aff. क.
शफराधिप: शफराधिप m. (-पः) The Ilisha or Hilsa fish, (Ilisha clupanodon.) E. शफर a carp, and अधिप chief.
शब्द: शब्द r. 10th cl. (शब्दयति) To sound, to make or utter sound; with the prefixes प्र, प्रति, or वि, as well as uncompounded, this root means also:. 1 To promise. 2 To make clear or manifest, to explain. 3 To speak.
शब्द m. (-ब्दः) 1 Sound in general. 2 A sound, a word. 4 (In grammar,) A declinable word, as noun, pronoun, &c. E. शब्द to sound, aff. अच्.
शब्दकार: शब्दकार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Making sound, sounding, sonorous. E. शब्द sound, &c. कृ to make, अण् aff.
शब्दग्रह: शब्दग्रह m. (-हः) 1 The ear. 2 Receiving or catching sound. 3 A fabulous arrow. E. शब्द sound, ग्रह what receives.
शब्दचोर: शब्दचोर m. (-रः) A plagiary. E. शब्द, and चोर a thief.
शब्दन: शब्दन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sounding, sonorous. (-नं) Sounding, uttering sounds. E. शब्द to sound, aff. युच्.
शब्दब्रह्मन्: शब्दब्रह्मन् n. (-ह्म) Inspired writ, the Vedas as uncreated and identifiable with the supreme spirit. E. शब्द, and ब्रह्मन् the supreme.
शब्दभेदिन्: शब्दभेदिन् m. (-दी) 1 A name of ARUṆA. 2 The anus. E. शब्द sound, noise, and भेदिन् breaking.
शब्दयोनि: शब्दयोनि f. (-निः) A root, a radical word. E. शब्द, and योनि place of origin.
शब्दवेधिन्: शब्दवेधिन् m. (-धी) ARJUNA. E. शब्द sound, and वेधिन् piercing; terrifying his enemies by his shouts.
शब्दशक्ति: शब्दशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Force or signification of words. E. शब्द, and शक्ति power.
शब्दशासन: शब्दशासन n. (-नं) The rules of grammar. E. शब्द, and शासन regulating.
शब्दशास्त्र: शब्दशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) Philology, grammar, &c. E. शब्द, and शास्त्र a science, &c.
शब्दसंग्रह: शब्दसंग्रह m. (-हः) A vocabulary, a lexicon. E. शब्द, and संग्रह collection.
शब्दादि: शब्दादि m. (-दिः) The objects of sense, as sound, form, scent, juice, contact; or what affords matter for the exercise of hearing, seeing, smelling, tasting and touching. E. शब्द, and आदि other.
शब्दाधिष्ठान: शब्दाधिष्ठान n. (-नं) The ear. E. E. शब्द sound, अधिष्ठान receptacle.
शब्दानुरूप: शब्दानुरूप n. (-पं) 1 Conformity or proportion to the sound. 2 Imitation of sound. E. शब्द, and अनुरूप conformity.
शब्दानुशासन: शब्दानुशासन n. (-नं) The acceptation or sense of words. E. शब्द, and अनुशासन government.
शब्दायमान: शब्दायमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sounding. E. शब्द sound, nominal verb, शानच् aff.
शब्दार्थ: शब्दार्थ m. (-र्थः) 1 The sense or meaning of words. 2 Words and sense. E. शब्द, and अर्थं sense.
शब्दालङ्कार: शब्दालङ्कार m. (-रः) Rhetorical use of words; verbal figure, as alliteration, &c. E. शब्द, and अलङ्कार ornament.
शब्दित: शब्दित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sounded. 2 Uttered, articulated. 3 Explained, made public or manifest. 4 Converted into a noun, &c. शब्द to sound, क्त aff.; or शब्द, and इतच् aff.
शम: शम r. 4th cl. (इर् उ) इरशमु (शाम्यति) 1 To be pacified, to be calmed or appeased. 2 To pacify, to calm. 3 To be tranquil, to have the passions tamed and quiescent. r. 10th cl. (शमयते) To look, to look at or inspect. (शमयति) To allay, to appease. (शामयति) To display. With उप prefixed, To tranquillize, to allay, to tame. With नि, 1 To hear. 2 To restrain or prevent. With प्र, 1 To destroy. 2 To be very tranquil.

शम m. (-मः) 1 Quiet of mind, stoicism, indifference, the absence of passion, as one of the qualities of the Vedāntī or follower of the Vedānta doctrine; it is defined to be the exclusion of every idea not derived from the precepts of that philosophy, and is so far synonymous with abstract meditation on BRAHMĀ, or GOD. 2 Quiet, tranquillity, rest, calm, (in general.) 3 Final happiness, emancipation from human existence. 4 Cure, convalescence, alleviation of pain or disease. 5 Abuse, imprecation, malediction. 6 The hand. E. शम to be pacified or calm, aff. घञ्, and the vowel not made long.
शमक: शमक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Pacifier, pacificator, tranquillizing. E. शम to be tranquil, ण्वुल् aff., of attributive agency.
शमथ: शमथ m. (-थः) 1 Quiet, tranquillity, (see the last.) 2 A counsellor, a minister. E. शम to be calm, Uṇādi aff. अथ.
शमन: शमन n. (-नं) 1 Killing animals for sacrifice, immolation. 2 Mental tranquillity, calmness, indifference. 3 Abuse, malediction. 4 Hurt, injury. 5 Chewing. m. (-नः) 1 YAMA, the ruler of Tartarus. 2 An antelope. f. (-नी) Night. E. शम to be tranquil, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.
शमनस्वसृ: शमनस्वसृ f. (-सा) Yamunā or Jumna the personified river. E. शमन YAMA, and स्वसृ the sister.
शमनीषद: शमनीषद m. (-दः) A Rākṣasa, an evil spirit, a goblin. E. शमन night, षद who goes.
शमयत्: शमयत् mfn. (-यन्-यन्ती-यत्) 1 Appeasing. allaying. 2 Terminating, stopping. E. शम to pacify, शतृ aff.
शमल: शमल n. (-लं) Fœces, ordure. E. शम to be quiet, Uṇādi aff. कल,
शमान्तक: शमान्तक m. (-कः) The deity KĀMA or love. E. शम mental or devotional tranquillity, and अन्तक destroyer.
शमि: शमि f. (-मिः-मी) A legume or pod. f. (-मी) 1 The Śami tree, (Acacia suma, Rox.) 2 A shrub, (Serratula anthelmintica.) E. शम to pacify (sickness,) aff. इन्, ङीष् added.
शमित: शमित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Pacified, appeased. 2 Quiet, tranquil, sedate, calm. 3 Alleviated, relieved. 4 Tempered, moderated 5 Relaxed, intermitted. E. शम to be pacified or calm, aff. क्त.
शमिन्: शमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Tranquil, pacific, tranquillized. E. शम to be tranquil, aff. घिनुण्.
शमिर: शमिर m. (-रः) A variety of the Śami tree. E. शमी the Śami tree, रा to get, (to resemble,) aff. क, and the vowel made short; also शमीर.
शमिरोह: शमिरोह m. (-हः) ŚIVA. E. शमि for शमी the Śami tree, and रोह who ascends.
शमीगर्भ: शमीगर्भ m. (-र्भः) 1 A man of the sacerdotal class, a Brahman. 2 A name of AGNI or fire. E. शमी the mimosa, (the wood of which is essential for certain sacrifices, &c.) and गर्भ embryo.
शमीधान्य: शमीधान्य n. (-न्यं) Pulse, grain which grows in legumes or pods. E. शमी a legume, and धान्य grain.
शमीपत्री: शमीपत्री f. (-त्री) A sort of Sensitive plant, (Mimosa pudica.) E. शमी Acacia Suma, and पत्र the leaf; having a similar leaf.
शमीर: शमीर m. (-रः) A small variety of the Mimosa Suma. E. शमी the Śami tree, and र aff. of diminution; also sometimes read शमिर.
शम्पा: शम्पा f. (-म्पा) Lightning. E. शम् happiness, पा to drink, क, and टाप् aff.; destroying pleasure by its awful appearance.
शम्पाक: शम्पाक m. (-कः) 1 A kind of Cassia, (C. fistula.) 2 Bringing to maturity or ripeness, cooking, maturing. 3 The lac pigment. E. शम् pleasure, and पाक what matures; also सम्पाक.
शम्ब: शम्ब r. 1st cl. (शम्बति) To go. r. 10th cl. (शम्बयति) To accumulate, to collect or heap together.

शम्ब mfn. (-म्बः-म्बा-म्बं) Happy, fortunate. m. (-म्बः) 1 INDRA'S thunderbolt. 2 The iron head of a pestle. 3 An iron chain worn round the loins. 4 The second ploughing of a field. E. शम् happiness, and ब possessive aff., or शम्ब to accumulate, aff. अच्: it is also read संव, शंव, and सम्ब.
शम्बर: शम्बर n. (-रं) 1 Water. 2 A religious observance. 3 Wealth. m. (-रः) 1 A Daitya. 2 A sort of deer. 3 A mountain. 4 A fish in general. 5 War. 6 Best, excellent. 7 A Bauddha. f. (-री) 1 A drug or medicinal plant, (Anthericum tuberosum.) 2 A female juggler. E. शम्ब to accumulate, अरन् aff., or शं happiness, वृ to choose, aff. अप्; also read शंवर, and सम्बर or संवर.
शम्बरसूदन: शम्बरसूदन m. (-नः) A name of KĀMA. E. शम्बर the Daitya, and सूदन destroyer.
शम्बरारि: शम्बरारि m. (-रिः) KĀMA, the Hindu deity of love. E. शम्बर the Daitya, and अरि the foe.
शम्बल: शम्बल mn. (-लः-लं) 1 Provender for a journey, stock for travelling expences. 2 A bank, a shore. 3 Envy, impatience or dislike of another's success. f. (-ली) A procuress, a bawd. E. शम्ब to go, to collect, अलच् aff.; also शंवल, and सम्बल or संवल.
शम्बाकृत: शम्बाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Twice ploughed, (a field.) E. शम्ब a second ploughing, कृत made, and डाच् augment.
शम्बु: शम्बु m. (-म्बुः) A bivalve shell. E. see शम्बूक below.
शम्बुक: शम्बुक m. (-कः) A bivalve shell: see शम्बूक.
शम्बुक्क: शम्बुक्क m. (-क्कः) A bivalve shell: see the next, शम्बूक.
शम्बूक: शम्बूक mf. (-कः-का) A bivalve shell. m. (-कः) 1 A conch shell. 2 A snail. 3 A Śūdra, who had become a devotee in the time of RĀMACANDRA, and was slain by him. 4 The edge of the frontal protuberance of the elephant. 5 The name of a  Daitya. E. शम to be tranquil, ऊकन् aff., and वुक् augment; also with the vowel short, शम्बुक, and the final consonant then rejected, शम्बु; it is also read, शम्बुक्क, and with the first vowel long, शाम्बूक, &c.
शम्भ: शम्भ m. (-म्भः) 1 INDRA'S thunderbolt. 2 The iron bound head of a club or pestle. 3 A happy man. E. शम् particle of auspiciousness, भा to shine, aff. क.
शम्भली: शम्भली f. (-ली) A bawd, a procuress. E. शम् pleasure, भल to describe, अच् and ङीष् affs.
शम्भु: शम्भु m. (-म्भुः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 BRAHMĀ. 3 A Jina or Jaina sanctified teacher. 4 A Siddha, a demi-divine being. 5 A sage, a venerable man. 9 A kind of Asclepias. E. शम् auspicious particle, भू to be, डु aff.
शम्भुतनय: शम्भुतनय m. (-यः) 1 KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 GAṆEŚA. E. शम्भु ŚIVA, and तनय son.
शम्भुनन्दन: शम्भुनन्दन m. (-नः) 1 A name of GAṆEŚA. 2 A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. शम्भु ŚIVA, and नन्दन son.
शम्भुप्रिया: शम्भुप्रिया f. (-या) Emblic myrobalan. 2 An epithet of DURGĀ. E. शम्भु ŚIVA, and प्रिया beloved.
शम्या: शम्या f. (-म्या) 1 The pin of a yoke. 2 A sacrificial vessel. 3 A stick, a staff. E. शम to be kept quiet, य aff., fem. aff. टाप्.
शम्यापात: शम्यापात m. (-तः) The cast of a stick. E. शम्या, and पात alighting.
शय: शय mfn. (-यः-या-यी-यं) Asleep, sleeping. m. (-यः) 1 A hand. 2 A snake, (Boa constrictor.) 3 Sleep, sleeping. 4 A bed, a couch. 5 Abuse, imprecation. E. शी to sleep, aff. घ, or टच् or अच्.
शयण्ड: शयण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डी-ण्डं) Asleep, sleeping. E. शी to sleep, अण्डच् Uṇādi aff.
शयथ: शयथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) Asleep, sleeping. m. (-थः) 1 Death, dying. 2 A sort of snake, the Boa. E. शी to sleep, अथच् Uṇādi aff.
शयन: शयन n. (-नं) 1 Sleep. 2 A bed, a couch. 3 Copulation. E. शी to sleep, ल्युट् aff.
शयनगृह: शयनगृह n. (-हं) A bed chamber. E. शयन, and गृह house.
शयनागार: शयनागार m. (-रः) A bed chamber. E. शयन, and आगार house.
शयनीय: शयनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Fit for or suitable to sleep, to be slept on, &c. n. (-यं) A bed, a couch. E. शी to sleep, अनीयर् aff. of the future participle; also with कन् added शयनीयक n. (-कं)
शयनैकादशी: शयनैकादशी f. (-शी) The eleventh day of the light half of Āṣārha, on which VIṢṆU'S sleep commences. E. शयन, and एकादशी eleventh lunation.
शयान: शयान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sleeping, asleep. E. शी to sleep, शानच् aff.
शयानक: शयानक m. (-कः) 1 A snake. 2 A chamæleon, a lizard. E. शी to sleep, आनक् Uṇādi aff.
शयालु: शयालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Sleepy, slothful, sluggish. m. (-लुः) 1 A snake, the Boa. 2 A dog. 3 A Shakāl. E. शी to sleep, आलुच् aff.; implying disposition or habit.
शयित: शयित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Asleep. m. (-तं) A plant, (Cordia myxa). n. (-तं) Sleep, sleeping. E. शी to sleep, aff. क्त.
शयितवत्: शयितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sleeping, asleep. E. शीङ् to sleep, क्तवतु aff.
शयित्वा: शयित्वा ind. Having slept. E. शी to sleep, क्त्वा aff.
शयु: शयु m. (-युः) A large snake, (Boa.) E. शी to sleep, and उ Uṇādi aff.
शयुन: शयुन m. (-नः) A large kind of snake, (Boa.) E. शीङ् to sleep, Uṇādi aff. उनन्.
शय्या: शय्या f. (-य्या) 1 A bed, a couch, a sofa. 2 Tying in knots, stringing. E. शी to sleep, क्यप् aff., and अयङ् substituted for the vowel.
शर: शर m. (-रः) 1 A sort of reed or grass, (Saccharum sara.) 2 An arrow. 3 The upper part or cream of slightly curdled milk. 4 Mischief, injury, hurt. n. (-रं) 1 Water. 2 Versed sine of an arc. E. शॄ to hurt, aff. अप्, also सर.
शरकाण्ड: शरकाण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 The stem of the Saccharum. 2 The shaft of an arrow. E. शर, and काण्ड stem.
शरच्चन्द्र: शरच्चन्द्र m. (-न्द्रः) The autumnal moon. E. शरट्, and चन्द्र moon.
शरज: शरज n. (-जं) Butter made from new milk or milk one day old. E. शर cream, and ज born.
शरजन्मन्: शरजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) A name of KĀRTTIKEYA. E. शर a sort of grass, and जन्मन् birth: having been brought up in thickets of that grass.
शरट: शरट m. (-टः) 1 A lizard, a chamæleon. 2 Safflower, the plant. E. शॄ to hurt, अटन् aff.; also सरट.
शरण: शरण n. (-णं) 1 A house. 2 A preserver, a protector, what or who protects or preserves. 3 Preservation, protection, defence. 4 Killing, slaying. f. (-णी) A plant, (Celtis orientalis.) E. श to injure, aff. ल्युट्.
शरणागत: शरणागत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Refugee, appellant, one who comes for protection or refuge. E. शरण protection, and आगत come.
शरणापन्न: शरणापन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Taken refuge. E. शरण, and आपन्न obtained.
शरणार्थिन्: शरणार्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Unfortunate, wretched, involved in calamity or ruin, and dependant on others for protection or aid. E. शरण protection, and अर्थिन् soliciting, requiring.
शरणार्पक: शरणार्पक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Unfortunate, calamitous, distressed, ruined, (see the last.) E. शरण protection, aid, and अर्पक who causes to be afforded.
शरणि: शरणि mf. (-णिः-णी) A road, a path, a way. E. शॄ to hurt, अनि aff., more usually सरणि.
शरणैषिन्: शरणैषिन् mfn. (-षी-षिणी-षि) Seeking for an asylum or protection. E. शरण, and एषिन् who wishes.
शरण्ड: शरण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 A bird in general. 2 A lizard, a chamæleon. 3 A kind of ornament. 4 A rogue, a cheat. 5 A libertine, a lecher. E. शॄ to injure, (fruit, &c.) अण्डन् Uṇādi aff.; also सरण्ड.
शरण्य: शरण्य mfn. (-ण्यः-ण्या-ण्यं) To be protected or aided, poor, miserable, helpless. n. (-ण्यं) 1 A protection, a protector, that which or who affords refuge and defence. 2 A house. 3 Protection, defence. 4 Injury, hurt. E. शॄ to hurt, Uṇādi अन्य; or शरण protection, and यत् aff. of fitness.
शरण्यु: शरण्यु m. (-ण्युः) 1 A cloud. 2 Wind, air. 3 A protector, a defender. E. शॄ to injure, अन्यु aff.; also सरण्यु.
शरत्कामिन्: शरत्कामिन् m. (-मी) A dog. E. शरट् autumn, and कामिन् desirous.
शरत्काल: शरत्काल n. (-लं) The autumnal season. E. शरत्, and काल time.
शरत्कालीन: शरत्कालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Autumnal. E. शरत्काल, and ख aff.
शरत्पर्वन्: शरत्पर्व्वन् n. (-र्व्व) A festival, on the full moon of Āśvina, (September-October:) see कोजागर. E. शरट् autumn, and पर्व्वन् a holiday.
शरत्पर्व्वन्: शरत्पर्व्वन् n. (-र्व्व) A festival, on the full moon of Āśvina, (September-October:) see कोजागर. E. शरट् autumn, and पर्व्वन् a holiday.
शरद्: शरद् f. (-रत् or रट्) 1 The season of autumn or the sultry season; the two months succeeding the rains; according to the Vaidikas, comprising the months Bhādra and Āśvina,  and according to the Paurāṇikas, Āśvina and Kārttika, fluctuating thus from August to November. 2 A year. E. शॄ to injure, अदि Uṇādi aff.; also with टाप् added शरदा.
शरदा: शरदा f. (-दा) 1 A year. 2 The sultry season. E. see the last.
शरदिज: शरदिज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Autumnal, produced in Śarat or the season of autumn. E. शरट् as above in the 7th case, and ज born.
शरधि: शरधि m. (-धिः) A quiver. E. शर an arrow, धा to have or contain, aff. कि.
शरन्मुख: शरन्मुख n. (-खं) Commencement of the spring season. E. शरट्, and मुख beginning.
शरपात: शरपात m. (-तः) An arrow's fall or flight. E. शर, and पात alighting.
शरपातस्थान: शरपातस्थान n. (-नं) A bowshot, an arrow's flight. E. शरपात, and स्थान place.
शरपुङ्खा: शरपुङ्खा f. (-ङ्खा) The feathers of an arrow. E. शर an arrow, and पुङ्ख the feathered part of it.
शरफल: शरफल n. (-लं) The blade or barb of an arrow. E. शर, and फल blade.
शरभ: शरभ m. (-भः) 1 A fabulous animal, supposed to have eight legs, and to inhabit particularly the snowy mountains. 2 A young elephant. 3 A monkey in RAMA'S army. 4 A camel. 5 A grasshopper. 6 A locust. E. श to injure, Uṇādi aff. अभच् or शर an arrow, भा to shine, aff. क.
शरभू: शरभू m. (-भूः) KĀRTTIKEYA. E. शर the grass, and भू born; being reared in this grass.
शरमय: शरमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of or consisting of Śara grass, &c. E. शर the grass, and मयट् aff. implying in this and other compounds change of form for any purpose except food or clothing.
शरमल्ल: शरमल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A small bird, considered a sa variety of the SArika or Maina, (Turdus gosalica, BUC. Mss.) E. शर the Śara grass, and मल्ल to hold or occupy, aff. अङ्; some authorities have शरमन्द.
शरयु: शरयु f. (-युः-यू) The Seryu or Serjū river; it is preferably, and more usually written सरयु, q. v.
शरल: शरल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Upright, honest. 2 Crooked, fraudulent. m. (-लः) A tree, a sort of pine. E. सृ to go, कलच् aff.; and स changed to श; whence the word is preferably read सरल.
शरलता: शरलता f. (-ता) Uprightness, sincerity. E. तल् added to शरल; also with त्व, शरलत्व; also सरलता.
शरव: शरव m. (-वः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A lid, a cover.
शरवणोद्भव: शरवणोद्भव m. (-वः) 1 KĀRTTIKEYA. E. शर saccharum, वन a thicket or jungle, and उद्भव born: see शरजन्मन्, &c.
शरवर्ष: शरवर्ष m. (-र्षः) A flight or shower of arrows. E. शर, and वर्ष rain.
शरवर्षिन्: शरवर्षिन् mfn. (-र्षी-र्षिणी-र्षि) Raining or shooting arrows. E. शर, and वर्षिन् showering.
शरवाणि: शरवाणि m. (-णिः) 1 The head of an arrow. 2 A foot soldier, an archer. 3 A maker of arrows. E. शर an arrow, वण to sound, aff. इन्.
शरवृष्टि: शरवृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) A heavy fall or shower of arrows. E. शर, and वृष्टि rain.
शरव्य: शरव्य n. (-व्यं) A mark, a butt. E. शरु a weapon, and यत् aff.
शराघात: शराघात m. (-तः) Shooting, (with a bow.) E. शर an arrow, and आघात striking.
शराटि: शराटि f. (-टि) A sort of bird, (Turdus ginginianus.) E. शर water or mischief, अट to go, aff. इन्; or from अत to go, शराति; and otherwise derived also शराडि and शरालि.
शराडि: शराडि f. (-डिः) A bird: see शरालि.
शराति: शराति f. (-तिः) A bird: see शराटि, &c.
शराभ्यास: शराभ्यास m. (-सः) Archery, practice with the bow and arrow. E. शर an arrow, अभ्यास exercise.
शरारि: शरारि f. (-रिः) A sort of bird, commonly the Āli or Śarāli, (Turdus ginginianus.) E. शर water or mischief, ऋ to go, aff. इ; also ल being substituted, शरालि, &c.
शरारीमुखी: शरारीमुखी f. (-खी) Scissars. E. शरारी, मुख mouth or beak, ङीष् aff.
शरारु: शरारु mfn. (-रुः-रुः-रु) Mischievous, noxious, hurtful. E. शृ to hurt, आरु aff.
शरारोप: शरारोप m. (-पः) A bow. E. शर an arrow, आरोप a receptacle.
शरालि: शरालि f. (-लिः-ली) Śarāli A kind of bird, (Turdus ginginianus.) E. शर an arrow, अल to be equal to, (in speed,) aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added; also शरारि, शराडि, शराटि, &c., and with कन् added, fem. form शरालिका.
शराव: शराव m. (-वः) 1 A lid, a cover. 2 A shallow cup or dish. 3 A platter. 4 A measure equal to two Kuḍavas. E. शर mischief, (from it,) अव to preserve, aff. अण् or अच्.
शरावती: शरावती f. (-ती) A river so named. E. शर a sort of grass, मतुप् aff. fem. form, and the final of the first word made long.
शराश्रय: शराश्रय m. (-यः) A quiver. E. शर an arrow, and आश्रय receptacle.
शरासन: शरासन n. (-नं) 1 A bow. 2 Shooting arrows. E. शर an arrow, अस to throw, aff. ल्युट्.
शराहत: शराहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Struck by an arrow. E. शर, and आहत struck.
शरिमन्: शरिमन् m. (-मा) Bearing, bringing forth. E. शॄ to hurt, इमनिच् Uṇādi aff.
शरीर: शरीर n. (-रं) The body. E. शॄ to injure, to be injured, Uṇādi aff. ईरन्.
शरीरक: शरीरक n. (-कं) 1 A small or delicate body. 2 The body. E. शरीर, and कन् diminutive, or pleonastic aff.
शरीरकर्षण: शरीरकर्षण n. (-णं) Emaciating or afflicting the body. E. शरीर, and कर्षण attracting.
शरीरज: शरीरज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Born or produced by the body, &c. m. (-जः) 1 Sickness, disease. 2 The deity KĀMA or love. 3 A son. E. शरीर the body, and ज born.
शरीरजन्मन्: शरीरजन्मन् mfn. (-न्मा-न्मा-न्म) Born or produced of or from the body. E. शरीर, and जन्मन् birth.
शरीरपाक: शरीरपाक m. (-कः) Decay, emaciation. E. शरीर, and पाक a ripening.
शरीरबन्धक: शरीरबन्धक m. (-क) A hostage. E. शरीर, and बन्धक a pledge.
शरीरभाज्: शरीरभाज् mfn. (-भाक्) Embodied, corporeal, having body. E. शरीर, and भाज् who shares.
शरीरयात्रा: शरीरयात्रा f. (-त्रा) Subsistence, support. E. शरीर, and यात्रा going.
शरीरयोग: शरीरयोग m. (-गः) Bodily union. E. शरीर, and योग union.
शरीरशुश्रूषा: शरीरशुश्रूषा f. (-षा) Personal attendance. E. शरीर, and शुश्रूषा service.
शरीरशोषण: शरीरशोषण n. (-णं) 1 Drying up, withering. 2 Emaciating the body. E. शरीर, and शोषण drying.
शरीरसंस्कार: शरीरसंस्कार m. (-रः) Purification of the body by various ceremonies at conception, birth, initiation, death, &c. n. (-रं) Decoration or adorning the person. E. शरीर, and संस्कार making perfect.
शरीरावरण: शरीरावरण n. (-णं) The skin. E. शरीर the body, and आवरण enclosing.
शरीरिन्: शरीरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Embodied, corporeal, having body. m. (-री) An animal or sentient being. n. (-रि) Life or soul connected with the body, or incorporate. E. शरीर body, and इनि aff.
शरु: शरु m. (-रुः) 1 Passion, anger. 2 The thunderbolt of INDRA. 3 An arrow. 4 Any weapon. E. शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. उ.
शरेष्ट: शरेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) The mango tree. E. शर an arrow, and इष्ट desired; the blossoms of the mango being amongst those which tip the darts of CUPID.
शर्करा: शर्करा f. (-रा) 1 A potsherd, the fragment of a broken pot. 2 A stony nodule, or gravel. 3 A soil or spot abounding in stony or gritty fragments. 4 Clayed or candid sugar. 5 A part, a piece. 6 Gravel, (the disease.) E. शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. करन्.
शर्कराप्रभा: शर्कराप्रभा f. (-भा) The hell of gravel according to the Jainas, the second division of Tartarus. E. शर्करा gravel, and प्रभा illustrious.
शर्करावत्: शर्करावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Gritty, gravelly, full of stony particles. E. शर्करा gravel, and मतुप् aff.
शर्करिक: शर्करिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Stony, gravelly. E. शर्क्करा gravel, &c., and ठञ् aff.
शर्करिल: शर्करिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Abounding in stony or gravelly particles, (a spot, a place.) E. शर्करा gravel, and इलच् aff.
शर्घ: शर्घ r. 1st cl. (शर्घति) To wound or kill.
शर्द्ध: शर्द्ध m. (-र्द्धः) Farting, a fart. E. शृध to fart, aff. घञ्.
शर्द्धञ्जह: शर्द्धञ्जह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Causing flatulence. m. (-हः) Any leguminous grain or pulse, as beans, &c. E. शर्द्ध farting, and हा to let go or loose, aff. खश्.
शर्ब: शर्ब्ब r. 1st cl. (शर्ब्बति) 1 To go. 2 To hurt, to injure.
शर्ब्ब: शर्ब्ब r. 1st cl. (शर्ब्बति) 1 To go. 2 To hurt, to injure.
शर्मद: शर्म्मद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Conferring prosperity, making happy, propitious. E. शर्म्मन्, and द who or what gives.
शर्म्मद: शर्म्मद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Conferring prosperity, making happy, propitious. E. शर्म्मन्, and द who or what gives.
शर्मन्: शर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Happy, glad. n. (-र्म्म) Happiness, pleasure. m. (-र्म्मा) A name or appellation common to and proper for Brahmans. E. शॄ to injure or destroy, (ill fortune,) मनिन् Uṇādi aff.
शर्म्मन्: शर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Happy, glad. n. (-र्म्म) Happiness, pleasure. m. (-र्म्मा) A name or appellation common to and proper for Brahmans. E. शॄ to injure or destroy, (ill fortune,) मनिन् Uṇādi aff.
शर्मवत्: शर्म्मवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Lucky, auspicious. E. शर्म्मन्, and मतुप् aff.
शर्म्मवत्: शर्म्मवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Lucky, auspicious. E. शर्म्मन्, and मतुप् aff.
शर्मर: शर्म्मर m. (-रः) A sort of garment or cloth. f. (-रा) A species of Curcuma, (C. zanthorhizon.) E. शर्म्म pleasure, रा to give, aff. क.
शर्म्मर: शर्म्मर m. (-रः) A sort of garment or cloth. f. (-रा) A species of Curcuma, (C. zanthorhizon.) E. शर्म्म pleasure, रा to give, aff. क.
शर्या: शर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Night. E. शॄ to injure, यत् aff.
शर्य्या: शर्य्या f. (-र्य्या) Night. E. शॄ to injure, यत् aff.
शर्व: शर्व्व r. 1st cl. (शर्व्वति) To hurt, to injure or kill.
शर्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) ŚIVA. E. शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. व; also सर्व.
शर्व्व: शर्व्व r. 1st cl. (शर्व्वति) To hurt, to injure or kill.
शर्व्व m. (-र्व्वः) ŚIVA. E. शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. व; also सर्व.
शर्वरी: शर्व्वरी f. (-री) 1 Night. 2 A woman. 3 Turmeric. E. शॄ to injure, अरच् Uṇādi aff.
शर्व्वरी: शर्व्वरी f. (-री) 1 Night. 2 A woman. 3 Turmeric. E. शॄ to injure, अरच् Uṇādi aff.
शर्वला: शर्व्वला f. (-ला or ली) An iron crow. E. शर्व to go, कलच् aff.; also सर्व्वला.
शर्व्वला: शर्व्वला f. (-ला or ली) An iron crow. E. शर्व to go, कलच् aff.; also सर्व्वला.
शर्वाणी: शर्व्वाणी f. (-णी) A name of PĀRVATĪ. E. शर्व्व ŚIVA, ङीष् aff., and आनुक् augment; the wife of SARVA; also सर्वाणी.
शर्व्वाणी: शर्व्वाणी f. (-णी) A name of PĀRVATĪ. E. शर्व्व ŚIVA, ङीष् aff., and आनुक् augment; the wife of SARVA; also सर्वाणी.
शर्वरीक: शर्व्वरीक m. (-कः) 1 A low or vile man, a rogue, a wretch. 2 A cruel or mischievous man. E. शॄ to injure, ईकन् Uṇādi aff., रक् augment, and the root repeated.
शर्व्वरीक: शर्व्वरीक m. (-कः) 1 A low or vile man, a rogue, a wretch. 2 A cruel or mischievous man. E. शॄ to injure, ईकन् Uṇādi aff., रक् augment, and the root repeated.
शल: शल r. 1st cl. (शलते) 1 To move, to shake, to tremble or stir. 2 To cover. (-शलति) To go, to move to or towards. r. 10th cl. (शालयति) To praise.
शल mn. (-लः-लं) The quill of a porcupine. m. (-लः) 1 A name of BHṚṄGI, ŚIVA'S attendant. 2 BRAHMĀ. 3 A kind of field. 4 A dart, a spear. 5 A stake. E. शल to go, aff. अच्.
शलक: शलक m. (-कः) A spider. E. शल to go, aff. वुन्.
शलङ्ग: शलङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A king. 2 A sort of salt. E. शल to go, Uṇādi aff. अङ्गच्.
शलभ: शलभ m. (-भः) 1 A grasshopper. 2 A locust. E. शल to go, अभच् Uṇādi aff.: see शरभ.
शलल: शलल nf. (-लं-ली) The quill of a porcupine. E. शल to go, to project, aff. कलच्, fem. aff. ङीष्.
शलाका: शलाका f. (-का) 1 A javelin, a dart. 2 An arrow. 3 A porcupine. 4 The rib of an umbrella, the bar of a cage, &c. or any such small stake, rod, peg, or pin: it is applied also in common use, to a thin slip of bambu, serving when tipped with sulphur for a match; to a round pointed piece of wood or bambu serving as a toothpick, to a similar piece employed as a tent or probe, or to a larger one used as a ruler, &c. 5 A bone. 6 An oblong quadrangular piece of ivory or bone used in playing a particular game, a domino. 7 A fibrous stick used as a brush or pencil. 8 A thorny shrub, (Vangueria spinosa.) 9 The Sārika, (Turdus Gosalica, BUC.) E. शल to go, Uṇādi aff. आकन्.
शलाकापरि: शलाकापरि ind. Beat at a game played with pieces of stick. E. शलाका a match, &c., and परि implying in this and similar compounds, reverse.
शलाकापुरुष: शलाकापुरुष m. plu. (-षाः) Sixty-three persons considered by the Jainas as sacred and divine, viz. the 24 Jinas, 12 Cakravartīs, 9 Vāsudevas, 9 Baladevas, and 9 Prativāsudevas.
शलाट: शलाट m. (-टः) A cart load, considered as twenty times one hundred Palas. E. शॄ to injure, aff. आटन्, and the र changed to ल.
शलाटु: शलाटु mfn. (-टुः-टुः-टु) Unripe, moist, (as fruit.) m. (-टुः) A kind of root. E. शल to go, आटु aff.
शलालु: शलालु n. (-लु) A sort of perfume.
शलालुक: शलालुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Purchased with or procured for the substance termed Śalālu. E. शलालु as above, and ष्टन् aff.; also with ठक् aff. शालालुक, &c.
शल्क: शल्क n. (-ल्कं) 1 A part, a portion. 2 Bark, rind. 3 The scale of a fish. E. शल to go, Uṇādi aff. कन्.
शल्कल: शल्कल n. (-लं) 1 The scale of a fish. 2 Bark, rind. E. शल to go, कलच् aff.
शल्कलिन्: शल्कलिन् m. (-ली) A fish. E. शल्कल a scale, and इनि aff.
शल्किन्: शल्किन् m. (-ल्की) A fish. E. शल्क a scale, and इनि aff.
शल्भ: शल्भ r. 1st cl. (शल्भते) 1 To praise, to flatter or coax. 1 To talk, to boast.
शल्मलि: शल्मलि mf. (-लिः-ली) The silk-cotton tree: see शाल्मलि.
शल्य: शल्य mn. (-ल्यः-ल्यं) A dart, a javelin. n. (-ल्यं) 1 A bambu rod or stake. 2 Any stake or thorn. 3 An arrow. 4 An iron crow. 5 Sin, crime. 6 Difficulty, embarrassment, distress. 7 An arrow, a thorn, or other extraneous substance which has lodged in the body. 8 Abuse, defamation. 9 Poison. m. (-ल्यः) 1 A thorny shrub, (Vangueria spinosa.) 2 A porcupine. 3 A hedgehog. 4 A peg, a pin, &c. 5 A boundary. 6 A king, the maternal uncle of YUDHIṢṬHIRA. E. शल to go, aff. यत् or य Uṇādi aff.
शल्यक: शल्यक m. (-कः) 1 A stake, a thorn. 2 A dart, a pike. 3 A porcupine. 4 A hedgehog. 5 A thorny shrub, (Vangueria spinosa.) E. शल्य as above, and कन् added.
शल्यकण्ठ: शल्यकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) A porcupine. E. शल्य a stake, and कण्ठ the throat.
शल्यक्रिया: शल्यक्रिया f. (-या) The extraction of extraneous substances lodged in the body. E. शल्य, and क्रिया act.
शल्यवत्: शल्यवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Shooting arrows. 2 Set with stakes. 3 Harassed with difficulties, &c. E. शल्य, and मतुप् aff.
शल्यवारङ्ग: शल्यवारङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The part by which an arrow or the like lodged in the body is to be laid hold of for its extraction. E. शल्य, and वारङ्ग the place of seizure.
शल्यशास्त्र: शल्यशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) That part of Surgery which treats of the extraction of extraneous substances lodged in the body. E. शल्य, and शास्त्र science.
शल्यारि: शल्यारि m. (-रिः) YUDHIṢṬHIRA. E. शल्य the prince, and अरि an enemy.
शल्योद्धार: शल्योद्धार m. (-रः) 1 Extraction of foreign substances from the body. 2 Cleansing or purifying a new house. E. शल्य, and उद्घार taking out or away.
शल्ल: शल्ल m. (-ल्लः) A frog. n. (-ल्लं) Bark, rind. E. शल to go, लच् aff.
शल्लक: शल्लक m. (-कः) 1 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) n. (-कं) Bark, rind. f. (-की) 1 A porcupine. 2 The gum Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.) E. शल to go, aff. क्वुन्, deriv. irr.
शल्लकीद्रव: शल्लकीद्रव m. (-वः) Incense, Olibanum. E. शल्लकी the Boswellia thurifera, and द्रव exudation.
शल्व: शल्व m. (-ल्वः) A country so named in the north of India. E. शल to go, क्वन् aff., more usually शाल्व.
शव: शव r. 1st cl. (शवति) 1 To go or approach. 2 To alter, to change.
शव mn. (-वः-वं) A dead body, a corpse. n. (-वं) Water. E. शव to go, अच् aff.
शवकाम्य: शवकाम्य m. (-म्यः) A dog. E. शव a corpse, and काम्य desirous.
शवदाह: शवदाह m. (-हः) Burning a corpse. E. शव, and दाह burning.
शवदाहिन्: शवदाहिन् m. (-ही) A person who burns a corpse. E. शव, and दाहिन् who burns.
शवयान: शवयान n. (-नं) The litter or bed on which a dead body is carried to be burnt. E. शव a corpse, and यान a vehicle.
शवर: शवर m. (-रः) 1 A barbarian, one inhabiting the mountainous districts of India, and wearing the feathers of the peacock, &c. as decorations. 2 Water. 3 A name of ŚIVA. 4 The hand. 5 A Śāstra, a sacred treatise. E. शव a corpse, रा to take, aff. क and टाप्.
शवराल: शवराल m. (-लः) A sort of Lodh.
शवरालय: शवरालय m. (-यः) The abode of an outcaste or low tribe. E. शवर a barbarian, and आलय abode.
शवरावास: शवरावास m. (-सः) The abode of an outcaste or barbarous tribe. E. शवर a barbarian, and आवास abode.
शवल: शवल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Variegated, of a variegated colour. 2 Imitative. 3 Articulate. m. (-लः) A variegated colour. f. (-ला-ली) 1 A brindled cow. 2 The cow of plenty, KĀMADHENU. n. (-लं) 1 Water. 2 A religious observance peculiar to the Bauddhas. E. शव to curse, कल aff., and प changed to व.
शवलता: शवलता f. (-ता) Variegation, variety of colour. E. शवल, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शवलत्वं.
शवलीकृत: शवलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Variegated. E. शवल, and कृत made, with च्चि augment.
शवसाधन: शवसाधन n. (-नं) A mystical and magical ceremony performed with a dead body. E. शव, and साधन implement.
शवसान: शवसान m. (-नः) A traveller, (in the dialect of the Vedas.) n. (-नं) A cemetery. E. शव to go, with असानच् aff.
शश: शश r. 1st cl. (शशति) To jump, to leap, to move by springing or leaping.

शश m. (-शः) 1 A hare or rabbit. 2 The Lodh tree, (Symplocos racemosa.) 3 Gum myrrh. 4 A man of mild and virtuous character, but uxorious and woman-led, one of the four characters in which men are classed by erotic writers. 5 The spots on the moon, supposed to resemble the figure of a hare. E. शश to go by leaps or jumps, aff. अच.
शशक: शशक m. (-कः) A hare. E. कन् added to the last.
शशत्: शशत् mfn. (-शन्-शन्ती-शत्) Leaping, jumping. E. शश to leap, शतृ aff.
शशधर: शशधर m. (-रः) The moon. E. शश a hare, and धर having; either as an emblem on his banners, or fancifully, as the spots on the moon's face.
शशप्लुतक: शशप्लुतक n. (-कं) A mark or scratch of the finger nail. E. शश a hare, प्लुतक jumping.
शशबिन्दु: शशबिन्दु m. (-न्दुः) 1 VIṢṆU, or KṚṢṆA. 2 A sovereign. 3 The moon. E. शश a bare, and बिन्दु a spot.
शशभृत्: शशभृत् m. (-भृत्) The moon. E. शश a hare, and भृत् who cherishes: see शशधर.
शशमात्र: शशमात्र mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं) As large as or of the size of a hare. E. शश, and मात्रच् aff.
शशलाञ्छन: शशलाञ्छन m. (-नः) The moon. E. शश, and लाञ्छन mark.
शशलोमन्: शशलोमन् n. (-म) The skin of the hare or rabbit. E. शश a hare or rabbit, and लोमन् hair.
शशविषाण: शशविषाण n. (-णं) The horn of a hare; any thing improbable or extraordinary. E. शश, and विषाण a horn.
शशस्थली: शशस्थली f. (-ली) The Doab, the country between the Ganges and Yamunā rivers. E. शश a hare, स्थल place, site.
शशाङ्क: शशाङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) The moon. E. शश a hare, and अङ्क a mark or spot.
शशाङ्कलेखा: शशाङ्कलेखा f. (-खा) A digit of the moon. E. शशाङ्क, and लेखा a streak.
शशादन: शशादन m. (-नः) A hawk or falcon. E. शश a hare or rabbit, and अदन what eats.
शशिदेव: शशिदेव m. (-वः) A sovereign, named also रन्तिदेव.
शशिन्: शशिन् m. (-शी) 1 The moon. 2 The emblem of one of the Jinas. E. शश a hare, इनि aff.
शशिपाद: शशिपाद m. (-दः) A moon-beam. E. शशि, and पाद a ray; also similar compounds, as शशिकर, शशिकिरण, शशिमयूख, शशिरश्मि, &c.
शशिप्रभ: शशिप्रभ n. (-भं) The white esculent water-lily. f. (-भा) Moonlight. E. शशि the moon, and प्रभ shining, (blossoming,) or प्रभा lustre, light.
शशिलेखा: शशिलेखा f. (-खा) 1 A digit of the moon. 2 A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) 3 A metre, a variety of the line of the Atijagatī stanza of thirteen syllables, or of the Atisaceari of fifteen syllables. E. शशि the moon, and लेखा a line or mark.
शशिवदना: शशिवदना f. (-ना) 1 A woman with a face like the moon. 2 A species of the Gāyatrī metre. E. शशि, and वदन face.
शशिशेखर: शशिशेखर m. (-रः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 One of the Jaina pontiffs. E. शशि the moon, and शेखर a crest.
शशीश: शशीश m. (-शः) A name of ŚIVA. E. शशि, and ईश lord.
शशोर्ण: शशोर्ण n. (-र्णं) The hair of the hare or rabbit. E. शश a hare, &c., and ऊर्णा wool.
शश्वत्: शश्वत् ind. Again and again, frequently, repeatedly, perpetually. E. शश to go by jumps, वति aff.
शष: शष r. 1st cl. (-शषति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.
शष्कुल: शष्कुल m. (-लः) A plant, (Galedupa arborea, Rox.) f. (-ली) 1 The outer ear or opening of the external auditory passage. 2 Rice or barley water, &c. 3 A sort of pie.
शष्प: शष्प n. (-ष्पं) 1 Young grass. 2 Loss of intellect or confidence. E. शस to hurt, Uṇādi aff. प, and स changed to ष; also शस्य.
शस: शस (इ) and the preposition आङ् always prefixed आशसि r. 1st cl. (आशंसते) 1 To bless, to wish good to, to confer a benediction. 2 To wish, to desire. 3 To speak. (उ) शसु r. 1st cl. (शसति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill. With अभि, To intreat.
शसन: शसन n. (-नं) Immolation, offering an animal in sacrifice. E. शस to hurt, aff. ल्युट्; also शमन.
शस्त: शस्त (इ) शस्ति r. 2nd cl. (शंस्ति) To sleep, (peculiar to the Vedas.)
शस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) 1 Happy, well, right. 2 Praised, eulogised. 3 Best, excellent. n. (-स्तं) 1 Happiness, excellence. 2 The body. E. शस to bless, aff. क्त.
शस्तक: शस्तक n. (-कं) A defence for the finger of an archer. E. कन् added to the last.
शस्तकेशक: शस्तकेशक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Having much or beautiful hair. E. शस्त excellent, केश hair, कन् aff.
शस्त्र: शस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) 1 A weapon in general. 2 Iron. 3 Steel. m. (-स्त्रः) A sword, a scymitar. f. (-स्री) A knife. E. शस to hurt, aff. ष्ट्रन.
शस्त्रक: शस्त्रक n. (-कं) 1 Iron. 2 Steel. E. शस्त्र a weapon, and कन् aff.
शस्त्रकार: शस्त्रकार m. (-रः) An armourer. E. शस्त्र, and कार who makes.
शस्त्रग्रह: शस्त्रग्रह m. (-हः) Taking arms. E. शस्त्र, and ग्रह taking.
शस्त्रग्राहिन्: शस्त्रग्राहिन् m. (-ही) A man armed. E. शस्त्र, and ग्राहिन् who takes
शस्त्रघुष्टकर: शस्त्रघुष्टकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Clanging. E. शस्त्र, and धुष्ट sounded, कर what makes.
शस्त्रजाल: शस्त्रजाल n. (-लं) A quantity of weapons. E. शस्त्र, and जाल a heap.
शस्त्रजीविन्: शस्त्रजीविन् m. (-वी) A soldier by profession. E. शस्त्र a weapon, and जीविन् who lives by.
शस्त्रत्याग: शस्त्रत्याग m. (-गः) Throwing away a weapon. E. शस्त्र, and त्याग abandoning.
शस्त्रधर: शस्त्रधर m. (-रः) An armed man or soldier. E. शस्त्र, and धर who has.
शस्त्रपाणि: शस्त्रपाणि mfn. (-णिः-णिः-णि) A warrior armed, having weapons in the hand. E. शस्र, and पाणि the hand.
शस्त्रपात: शस्त्रपात m. (-तः) The stroke of a weapon. E. शस्र, and पात falling.
शस्त्रपूत: शस्त्रपूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Purified by arms, absolved from guilt by dying in the field of battle. E. शस्र, and पूत purified.
शस्त्रप्रहरण: शस्त्रप्रहरण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Taking arms. E. शस्र, and प्रहरण taking.
शस्त्रभृत्: शस्त्रभृत् m. (-भृत्) An armed man, a soldier. E. शस्र a weapon, and भृत् having.
शस्त्रमार्ज: शस्त्रमार्ज m. (-र्जः) An armourer. E. शस्र a weapon, and भाज cleaning.
शस्त्रवृत्ति: शस्त्रवृत्ति m. (-त्तिः) A soldier, a man at arms. E. शस्र, and वृत्ति profession.
शस्त्रसंहति: शस्त्रसंहति f. (-तिः) 1 A quantity or number of weapons. 2 An arsenal, an armoury. E. शस्र, and संहति assemblage.
शस्त्रसमूह: शस्त्रसमूह n. (-हं) 1 A quantity or number of weapons. 2 An arsenal, an armoury. E. शस्र, and ममूह a heap.
शस्त्रहत: शस्त्रहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Struck or killed by a weapon. E. शस्र, and हत hurt.
शस्त्रहस्त: शस्त्रहस्त m. (-स्तः) A man carrying arms. E. शस्र a weapon, and हस्त the hand.
शस्त्राजीव: शस्त्राजीव m. (-वः) A soldier. E. शस्त्र a weapon, and आजीव who lives by.
शस्त्राभ्यास: शस्त्राभ्यास m. (-सः) Military exercise or practice. E. शस्त्र a weapon, and अभ्यास practice.
शस्त्रास्त्र: शस्त्रास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) Use of weapons. E. शस्त्र, and अस्त्र a weapon, or means of offence or defence.
शस्त्रास्त्रभृत्: शस्त्रास्त्रभृत् m. (-भृत्) A soldier, a warrior. E. शस्त्रास्त्र, and भृत who has.
शस्त्रास्त्रभृत्त्व: शस्त्रास्त्रभृत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) The military profession, the use of arms. E. शस्त्रास्त्रभृत्, and त्व aff.
शस्त्रिन्: शस्त्रिन् mfn. (-स्त्री-स्त्रिणी-स्त्रि) Armed, having weapons. E. शस्त्र, and इनि aff.
शस्त्रोत्थापन: शस्त्रोत्थापन n. (-नं) Raising a weapon, (as to strike.) E. शस्त्र, and उत्थापन taking up.
शस्त्रोद्यम: शस्त्रोद्यम m. (-मः) Lifting up a weapon, (as to strike.) E. शस्त्र, and उद्यम lifting up.
शस्त्रोपजीविन्: शस्त्रोपजीविन् m. (-वी) A soldier, a man at arms. E. शस्त्र, and उपजीविन् living by.
शस्प: शस्प n. (-स्पं) 1 Young grass. 2 Loss of confidence or understanding. E. शस to injure, प aff., and the sibilant unchanged.
शस्य: शस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 1 Excellent, best. 2 To be hurt or injured. 3 Desirable, to be wished. n. (-स्यं) 1 Fruit. 2 Corn, grain in general. 3 Good quality, merit. E. शस to hurt, aff. यत्; or शसि to wish, क्यप् aff.
शस्यक्षेत्र: शस्यक्षेत्र n. (-त्रं) A corn field. E. शस्य, and क्षेत्र a field.
शस्यध्वंशिन्: शस्यध्वंशिन् m. (-शी) A timber tree, commonly Toon, (Cedrela tunna.) E. शस्य fruit, and ध्वंसिन् injurious.
शस्यभक्षक: शस्यभक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Graminivorous. E. शस्य, and भक्षक what eats.
शस्यभक्षण: शस्यभक्षण n. (-णं) Feeding upon grain. E. शस्य, and भक्षण eating.
शस्यमञ्जरी: शस्यमञ्जरी f. (-री) 1 The ear or spike of corn. 2 The fruit stalk. E. शस्य, and मञ्जरी pedicle.
शस्यरक्षक: शस्यरक्षक m. (-कः) A watchman over a field of corn. E. शस्य, and रक्षक who protects.
शस्यशूक: शस्यशूक n. (-कं) The beard of corn. E. शस्य corn, and शूक beard.
शस्यसम्बर: शस्यसम्बर m. (-रः) The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. शस्य fruit, and सम्बर surrounding.
शस्यारु: शस्यारु m. (-रुः) A small variety of the Mimosa suma.
शांशप: शांशप mfn. (-पः-पी-पं) Made of Śiśu wood, &c. E. शिंशपा the Śiśu, अण् aff., and आङ् substituted for the first vowel.
शाक: शाक mn. (-कः-कं) A potherb in general, any leaf, flower, fruit, stalk, root, &c. used as a vegetable. m. (-कः) 1 One of the seven Dvīpas or divisions of the world; the sixth, surrounded by the sea of milk or white sea. 2 Power, strength. 3 The Sirisha tree, (Acacia sirisa.) 4 The Teak tree, (Tectona grandis.) 5 An era, a period usually commencing with some celebrated prince, as YUDHIṢṬHIRA, VIKRAMĀDITYA, ŚĀLIVĀHANA, &c. thence denominated ŚĀKEŚVARAS, &c.; the term in ordinary use is applied especially to the era of ŚĀLIVĀHANA, commencing 76 or 78 years after the Christian era. E. शक to be able, घञ् aff.
शाकट: शाकट mfn. (-टः-टी-टं) Relating to a cart, (a cart-load, a carthorse, &c.) m. (-टः) A draught ox. E. शकट a cart, अण् aff.
शाकटिक: शाकटिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Going in or on a cart. E. शकट a cart, and ठक् aff.
शाकटीन: शाकटीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Belonging or relating to a cart. m. (-नः) A cart-load as a measure of weight or value. E. शकट a cart, ख aff.
शाकतरु: शाकतरु m. (-रुः) A plant, (Capparis trifoliata.) E. शाक a potherb, and तरु a tree.
शाकपण: शाकपण m. (-णः) A handful or similar quantity, as a measure of potherbs. E. शाक, and पण price.
शाकरी: शाकरी f. (-री) One of the dialects of dramatic Prākṛta, that spoken by the Sakāra. E. शकार, अण् and ङीष् aff.
शाकवालेय: शाकवालेय m. (-यः) A plant, commonly Bamanaiṭhi; also वालेयशाक.
शाकम्भरी: शाकम्भरी f. (-री) 1 DURGĀ. 2 A city, supposed to be the modern Sāmbher. E. शाक a potherb, भृ to nourish, aff. खश्, fem. aff. ङीष्.
शाकम्भरीय: शाकम्भरीय n. (-यं) A fossile salt brought from a lake in the vicinity of Sāmbher, a town in Ajmere. E. शाकम्भरी the city, and छ aff.
शाकलिक: शाकलिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Having a piece or part. E. शकल a part, ठञ् aff.
शाकविल्व: शाकविल्व m. (-ल्वः) The egg-plant, (Solanum melongena.) E. शाक a potherb, विल्व the Bel fruit; also with कन् added शाकविल्वक.
शाकवीर: शाकवीर m. (-रः) A potherb, (Chenopodium album.) E. शाक a potherb, and वीर eminent.
शाकवृक्ष: शाकवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The Teak tree. E. शाक the same, and वृक्ष a tree.
शाकशाकट: शाकशाकट n. (-टं) A field of vegetables, a kitchen garden. E. शाक a potherb, and शाकट aff. in this sense.
शाकशाकिन: शाकशाकिन n. (-नं) A field cultivated for esculent plants, a field of vegetables, a kitchen garden. E. शाक a vegetable, and शाकिन aff. in this sense.
शाकश्रेष्ठ: शाकश्रेष्ठ m. (-ष्ठः) A potherb, (Chenopodium album.) E. शाक a potherb, and श्रेष्ठ best.
शाकाख्य: शाकाख्य m. (-ख्यः) The Teak tree. E. शाक the same, and आख्या appellation.
शाकाङ्ग: शाकाङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) Pepper. E. शाक a potherb, and अङ्ग a part.
शाकिनी: शाकिनी f. (-नी) A female divinity of an inferior character, attendant especially on ŚIVA and DURGĀ.
शाकुन: शाकुन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) 1 Of or relating to birds. 2 Ominous, portentous. E. शाकुन, and अण् aff.
शाकुनिक: शाकुनिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or relating to birds, omens, &c. m. (-कः) A fowler, a bird-catcher. n. (-कं) Interpretation of omens, dreams, &c. E. शकुन a bird, and ठञ् aff.
शाकुन्तलेय: शाकुन्तलेय m. (-मः) BHARATA, the sovereign of India. E. शकुन्तला the nymph, and ढक् aff.; being the son of ŚAKUNTALĀ and DUṢYANTA.
शाकुलिक: शाकुलिक m. (-कः) A fisherman. E. शकुल a fish, and ठक् aff.
शाक्कर: शाक्कर m. (-रः) An ox. n. (-रं) A form of metre. E. शक्कर, and अञ् aff.
शाक्त: शाक्त m. (-क्तः) A worshipper of the female principle. E. शक्ति the divine energy in its feminine personification, and अण् aff.
शाक्तीक: शाक्तीक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Speared, spearing, relating to or done with a spear. m. (-कः) A spearman, a lancer. E. शक्ति a spear, aff. ईकक्.
शाक्त्य: शाक्त्य m. (-क्त्यः) A worshipper of the female principle or Śakti. E. शक्ति the personified energy of a divinity, and यञ् aff.
शाक्य: शाक्य m. (-क्यः) 1 BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha religion. 2 The name of a tribe. E. शक to be able, ण्यत् aff.
