शाक्यमुनि: शाक्यमुनि m. (-निः) A name of BUDDHA, the real or supposed founder of the Bauddha religion. E. शाक्य said to be the name of a family or tribe, originating with one of the race of Ikṣvāku, condemned to take up his abode in a forest of Sāka trees, and मुनि a saint.
शाक्यसिंह: शाक्यसिंह m. (-हः) A name of BUDDHA. E. शाक्य the name of his tribe, and सिंह chief.
शाख: शाख (ऋ) शाखृ r. 1st cl. (शाखते) To pervade.

शाख m. (-खः) A plant, (Galedupa arborea.) f. (-खा) 1 A branch, the branch of a tree. 2 A branch or subdivision of the Vedas, consisting of the several Saṃhitās or collections of prayers in each Veda, as received in different schools, modified more or less either in the arrangement of the whole text, or in particular portions of it. 3 An arm. 4 A sect, a faction, a party. 5 Any subdivision. 6 Any part of an animal not endowed with sensibility, as a horn, &c. E. शाख to pervade, aff. अच्.
शाखानगर: शाखानगर n. (-रं) A suburb. E. शाखा a branch or subdivision, and नगर a city.
शाखापुर: शाखापुर n. (-रं) A suburb. E. शाखा a branch, and पुर a city.
शाखाभेद: शाखाभेद m. (-दः) Difference of school or doctrine. E. शाखा, and भेद difference.
शाखामृग: शाखामृग m. (-गः) 1 A monkey, an ape. 2 A squirrel. E. शाखा the branch of a tree, and मृग a deer.
शाखारण्ड: शाखारण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A Brahman who has changed his Śākhā or peculiar school of the Vedas for another. E. शाखा a branch of the Vedas, रम to sport, ड aff.
शाखाशिफा: शाखाशिफा f. (-फा) A root proceeding from a branch, as in the Indian fig, the branches of which shoot downwards to the ground and take fresh root there. E. शाखा a branch, and शिफा a fibrous root.
शाखिन्: शाखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) Branched, branching, having branches, (literally or figuratively.) m. (-खी) 1 A tree. 2 A Veda. 3 An inhabitant of the northern districts bordering on India,  a Turk or Tartar. 4 The name of a king. E. शाखा a branch, aff. इनि.
शाखोट: शाखोट m. (-टः) A small tree, (Trophis aspera;) also with कन् added शाखोटकः.
शाख्य: शाख्य mfn. (-ख्यः-ख्या-ख्यं) Branching, ramifying. E. शाखा a branch, (literally or figuratively,) and य aff.
शाङ्कर: शाङ्कर m. (-रः) A bull. n. (-रं) A form of metre. E. शङ्कर ŚIVA, and अण् aff.; also read शाक्कर.
शाङ्करि: शाङ्करि m. (-रिः) 1 KĀRTTIKEYA. 2 GAṆEŚA. 3 Fire. 4 A Muni. E. शङ्कर ŚIVA, and इञ् patronymic aff.
शाङ्कुची: शाङ्कुची f. (-ची) The scate fish; also शंकुची, &c.
शाङ्ख: शाङ्ख n. (-ङ्खं) The sound of the conch shell. E. शङ्ख the shell, and अण् aff.
शाङ्खिक: शाङ्खिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Made from, relating to, &c. the Śaṅkha or conch. m. (-कः) 1 A shell cutter, a worker in shells. 2 A player on the Śaṅkha, a shell blower. E. शङ्ख the conch shell, and ठक् aff.
शाटक: शाटक mn. (-कः-कं) A petticoat. E. शट to go, (round the limbs,) ण्वुल् aff.
शाटी: शाटी mf. (-टः-टी) A petticoat. E. शट to praise or flatter, to go, &c. aff. ण, fem. aff. ङीष्.
शाट्य: शाट्य n. (-ट्यं) Wickedness, villainy. E. शठ wicked, ष्यञ् aff.
शाड: शाड (ऋ) शाडृ r. 1st cl. (शाडते) 1 To flatter, to praise, to coax. 2 To boast. 3 To float or swim.
शाड्वल: शाड्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Abounding in fresh grass, green, verdant. E. शाद young grass, ड्वलच् aff., and the final changed, also शाड्वल.
शाण: शाण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) Made of or from Bengal flax or Śaṇa. mf. (-णः-णी) 1 A touchstone. 2 A whet or grindstone. 3 A weight of four Māṣas. 4 A saw. n. (-णं) Coarse cloth, sack cloth, canvas. f. (-णी) 1 Ragged or torn raiment. 2 A new unseamed and single breadth of cloth, given to the religious student at his investiture for his upper garment. 3 A ragged garment given to the Jaina ascetic at his initiation. 4 A small tent or screen, used especially as a retiring room for actors, and tumblers, &c. 5 Gesture, gesticulation, making signs with the hands or eyes, &c. E. शण to give, aff. घञ्; or शो to sharpen, and ण aff.; or शण Saṇ, and अण् aff. of derivation.
शाणाजीव: शाणाजीव m. (-वः) An armourer. E. शाण a whetstone, आजीव who lives by.
शाणि: शाणि m. (-णिः) A plant from the fibres of which a coarse cloth is prepared, (Corchorus olitorius.) E. शण Bengal Śaṇ, and ईञ् aff. implying descent or resemblance.
शाण्डिल्य: शाण्डिल्य m. (-ल्यः) 1 A tree, (Ægle marmelos.) 2 A Muni from whom one of the three principal families of the Kanouj or Kanyākubja Brahmans is said to be descended. 3 A form of AGNI or fire. E. शण्डिल a saint, यञ् aff. of descent, &c.
शात: शात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Happy, well, prosperous. 2 Feeble, thin. 3 Sharpened, whetted, sharp. 4 Handsome, bright. n. (-तं) Joy, pleasure, happiness. E. शो to reduce or diminish, aff. क्त.
शातकुम्भ: शातकुम्भ n. (-म्भं) Gold. m. (-म्भः) A plant, (Nerium odorum.) E. शतकुम्भ said to be the name of a mountain, and अण् aff. implying production.
शातकौम्भ: शातकौम्भ n. (-म्भं) Gold. E. अण् pleonasm, added to the last.
शातन: शातन n. (-नं) Withering, decaying, becoming thin or small. E. शो to wither, aff. ल्युट्, form irr.
शातपत्रकी: शातपत्रकी f. (-की) Moonlight. E. शतपत्र a lotus, कन् added, and अण् aff.
शातमन्यव: शातमन्यव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Relating to INDRA. E. शतमन्यु, and अण् aff.
शातमान: शातमान mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Bought with the measure of one hundred. E. शत a hundred, मान measure, and अण् aff.
शातशिख: शातशिख mfn. (-खः-खी-खं) Sharp pointed, (as the nails, &c.) E. शात, and शिखा crest.
शातोदरी: शातोदरी f. (-री) A woman with a small belly or waist. E. शात, and उदर the belly, ङीप् aff.
शात्रव: शात्रव m. (-वः) An enemy. n. (-वं) 1 Enmity, hostility. 2 A multitude of enemies. E. शत्रु an enemy, and अण् pleonasm, or aff. of quality or number.
शात्रवीय: शात्रवीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Hostile, inimical, belonging or relating to an enemy. E. शात्रव, and छ aff.
शाद: शाद m. (-दः) 1 Mud. 2 Young grass. E. शो to wither, द Uṇādi aff.
शादहरित: शादहरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Green or fresh with young grass. E. शाद young grass, and हरित green
शाद्वल: शाद्वल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Abounding in fresh or green grass. E. शाद young grass, द्वलच् aff.
शान: शान r. 1st cl. intensitive form (शिशांसति-ते) To whet, to sharpen.
शान m. (-नः) 1 A touchstone. 2 A grindstone. f. (-नी) A sort of cucumber. E. शो to make small or sharpen, aff. ल्युट्. also शाण.
शान्त: शान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Calm, tranquil, pacified. 2 Allayed, alleviated. 3 Meek, humble. 4 Purified, cleansed, freed from, (as soil.) 5 Stilled, hushed, (as wind, &c.) m. (-न्तः) 1 An ascetic, one whose passions are subdued and who is engrossed by meditating on the deity. 2 One of the Rasas or conditions of feeling, delineated in poetry or the drama, tranquillity or tranquil devotion, quietism, the assiduous exercise of meditation, &c. and indifference to all objects of pleasure or pain. n. (-न्तं) Appeasing, pacifying. ind. (शान्तम) A prohibitive particle or interjection, implying negation, aversion, disgust, (fie! for shame! Heaven forbid!) E. शम to be appeased, aff. क्त.
शान्तचेतस्: शान्तचेतस् mfn. (-ताः-ता-तः) Composed, calm, unanxious. E. शान्त, and चेतस् mind.
शान्तता: शान्तता f. (-ता) Quietness, calmness, meekness. E. शान्त, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शान्तत्वं.
शान्तनव: शान्तनव m. (-वः) BHĪṢMA, the reputed great uncle of the Pāṇḍavas. E. शान्तनु a prince, and अण् aff. of descent.
शान्तनु: शान्तनु m. (-नुः) The 21st sovereign of the lunar dynasty in the third age, the father of BHĪṢMA by Gaṅgā, or the Ganges personified. E. शं good fortune, (personified,) तनु the body, and the first vowel made long by special rule.
शान्तमल: शान्तमल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Exempt from soil, literally or figuratively. E. शान्त cleansed, and मल dirt.
शान्तरय: शान्तरय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Slackened in speed. E. शान्त, and रय rapidity.
शान्तविवाद: शान्तविवाद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Reconciled, appeased. E. शान्त, and विवाद dispute.
शान्तात्मन्: शान्तात्मन् mfn. (-त्मा-त्मा-त्म) Calm, composed, of resigned or composed spirit. E. शान्त, and आत्मन् self.
शान्तार्चिस्: शान्तार्च्चिस् mfn. (-र्च्चिः-र्च्चिः-र्च्चि) Extinguished, put or gone out. E. शान्त, and अर्च्चिस् flame.
शान्तार्च्चिस्: शान्तार्च्चिस् mfn. (-र्च्चिः-र्च्चिः-र्च्चि) Extinguished, put or gone out. E. शान्त, and अर्च्चिस् flame.
शान्ति: शान्ति f. (-न्तिः) 1 Quiet, tranquillity, stoicism, the absence of passion, and indifference to objects of pleasure or pain; it is especially applied to the tranquillity of devotion, or quietism, by which the mind is wholly fixed on the subject of its meditation or worship, and is utterly disregardless of external impressions. 2 Good fortune, auspiciousness, felicity. 3 Rest, repose. 4 Expiatory or propitiatory rites to avert any evil. 5 Preliminary ceremonies to avert inauspicious accidents at any religious celebration. 6 Remission, alleviation. m. (-न्तिः) 1 The sixteenth Jina or Jaina deified sage of the present era. 2 One of the Jaina emperors of the universe. E. शम to be appeased, aff. क्तिन्.
शान्तिक: शान्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Propitiatory, expiatory. 2 Producing ease or quiet, &c. 3 Relating to quiet, &c. E. शान्ति and ठक् aff.
शान्तिकर: शान्तिकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Tranquillising, calming, appeasing, &c. E. शान्ति, and कर who or what makes.
शान्तिकर्तृ: शान्तिकर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-त्री-र्त्तृ) Conferring tranquillity, calming, appeasing. m. (-र्त्ता) Any divinity who averts evil. E. शान्ति, and कर्त्तृ who makes.
शान्तिकर्त्तृ: शान्तिकर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-त्री-र्त्तृ) Conferring tranquillity, calming, appeasing. m. (-र्त्ता) Any divinity who averts evil. E. शान्ति, and कर्त्तृ who makes.
शान्तिकाम: शान्तिकाम m. (-मः) Desire of tranquillity and exemption from calamity. E. शान्ति peace, and काम desire.
शान्तिगृह: शान्तिगृह n. (-हं) A private apartment near the place of sacrifice. E. शान्ति devotion, गृह a house.
शान्तिद: शान्तिद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Tranquillising, calming, allaying. E. शान्ति, and द who or what gives.
शान्तिहोम: शान्तिहोम m. (-मः) Burnt offerings, to prevent or avert threatening or possible evils. E. शान्ति, and होम burnt offering.
शान्त्युद: शान्त्युद n. (-दं) Water offered at sacrifices for propitiation. E. शान्ति, and उद water; also शान्त्युदकं.
शान्त्युदकुम्भ: शान्त्युदकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A vessel holding lustral water. E. शान्त्युद, and कुम्भ a jar.
शान्त्व: शान्त्व r. 10th cl. (शान्त्वयति) To console, to comfort.
शान्त्व n. (-न्त्वं) 1 Conciliation. 2 Comforting, consoling. E. शम to appease or allay (opposition), deriv. irr.; or शान्त्व to console, aff. अच्; also सान्त्व.
शाप: शाप m. (-पः) 1 Oath, affirmation by oath or ordeal. 2 Curse, imprecation. 3 Abuse. E. शप to swear, aff. घञ्.
शापग्रस्त: शापग्रस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Having incurred or suffering under a curse. E. शाप, and ग्रस्त seized.
शापज: शापज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Arising from a curse, being the effect of one. E. शाप, and ज born.
शापमुक्त: शापमुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Freed from a curse. E. शाप, and मुक्त released.
शापान्त: शापान्त n. (-न्तं) The end of a curse or period of an imprecation. E. शाप, and अन्त end.
शापास्त्र: शापास्त्र m. (-स्त्रः) A Muni, a saint. E. शाप a curse, and अस्त्र a weapon; a curse denounced by such a personage, being formidable even to the deities.
शापित: शापित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sworn, made to take an oath. E. शप to swear, causal v., क्त aff.
शापोद्धार: शापोद्धार m. (-रः) Deliverance from a curse or its effects. E. शाप, and उद्धार extricating.
शाफरिक: शाफरिक m. (-कः) A fisherman. E. शफर a kind of fish, put for any, and ठक् aff.
शाब्द: शाब्द mfn. (-ब्दः-ब्दी-ब्दं) 1 Sonorous, sounding. 2 Nominal, (as inflection.) f. (-ब्दी) SARASVATĪ, goddess of speech and eloquence. E. शब्द sound or a word, and अण् attributive aff.
शाब्दिक: शाब्दिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to sounds or words. m. (-कः) A proficient in the senses and forms of nouns or words. E. शब्द a sound, and ठक् aff.
शामन्: शामन् n. (-म) Conciliation, appeasing, reconciling. E. शम to appease, aff. मनिन्, and the vowel made long; also शामन.
शामन: शामन n. (-नं) 1 Killing, slaughter. 2 Tranquillity, peace. E. शम to be pacified, causal form, ल्युट् aff.
शामित्र: शामित्र n. (-त्रं) 1 Sacrificing. 2 Tying cattle. 3 A sacrificial vessel. E. शम to appease, इत्रन् aff.
शाम्बरी: शाम्बरी f. (-री) A female juggler. E. शम्बर a demon, अण् added, and ङीष् fem. aff.
शाम्बविक: शाम्बविक m. (-कः) A worker in shells. E. शम्बु, a shell, ठक् aff.
शाम्बुक: शाम्बुक m. (-कः) A bivalve shell. E. अण् pleonasm added to शम्बु; also read शाम्बूक, &c.
शाम्भव: शाम्भव n. (-वः) 1 A sort of poison. 2 A worshipper of ŚIVA. The son of ŚAMBHU or ŚIVA. f. (-वी) PĀRVATĪ. E. शम्भु a name of ŚIVA, and अण् aff.
शायक: शायक m. (-कः) 1 An arrow. 2 A sword. E. शो to destroy, ण्वुल् aff.; also सायक.
शायिका: शायिका f. (-का) Sleeping. E. शी to sleep, ण्वुल् aff.
शायिन्: शायिन् mfn. (-यी-यिनी-यि) Lying down. E. शी to sleep, णिनि aff.
शार: शार r. 10th cl. (शारयति) 1 To be weak. 2 To weaken.

शार mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Variegated, (in colour,) 2 Yellow. m. (-रः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A piece or man at chess, backgammon, &c. 3 Hurting, injuring. 4 A mixture of blue and yellow, a green. 5 Spotting, variegating. f. (-री) Kuśa grass. E. शॄ to injure, अण् aff.
शारङ्ग: शारङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Of a variegated colour. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The Cātaka (Cuculus melanoleucos.) 2 A deer. 3 An elephant. 4 A bee. 5 A peacock. f. (-ङ्गी) A musical instrument, a stringed instrument played with a bow, a sort of fiddle. E. शार injuring or variegated, गम to go, or get, aff. खच्; more usually, सारङ्ग.
शारता: शारता f. (-ता) 1 Variegation of colour. 2 Yellowness. E. तल added to शार.
शारद: शारद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) 1 Modest, diffident. 2 New. 3 Produced in the sultry season. 4 Autumnal. m. (-दः) 1 A year. 2 Grain or rice ripening in the sultry season. 3 A sort of kidney bean, yellow Mūṅg. 4 Autumnal sickness. 5 Sunshine, (in autumn.) f. (-दा) 1 A name of SARASVATĪ. 2 A title of DURGĀ. 3 A musical instrument, a sort of lute or guitar. f. (-दी) A plant, (Jussieua repens.) 2 A tree, (Echites scholaris.) 3 Day of full  moon in the month Kārttika (October-November.) E. शरट् the autumn, and अण् aff.
शारदिक: शारदिक n. (-कं) A particular obsequial ceremony, an annual or autumnal Śrāddha. m. (-कः) 1 Autumnal sickness. 2 Heat or sunshine in autumn. E. शारद autumn, and ठञ् aff.
शारदिन्: शारदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Autumnal. E. शारद, and इनि aff.
शारदीय: शारदीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Autumnal. E. शारद, and छ added.
शारि: शारि m. (-रिः) 1 A piece or man at chess, draughts, Chauper, &c. 2 An elephant's housings or armour. 3 Fraud, trick. mf. (-रिः-री) A bird: see the next. E. शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. इञ्.
शारिका: शारिका f. (-का) 1 A bird, the proper or hill Maina, (Gracula religiosa;) it is also applied to the small bird usually called Maina in Bengal, (Turdus salica, BUC.) of which several varieties are distinguished by the Hindus. 2 A bow or stick that may be used for playing the Vīṇā or any stringed instrument. E. शॄ to injure, aff. वुन्.
शारित: शारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Variegated, coloured. E. शार, and इतच् aff.
शारिफल: शारिफल n. (-लं) A chequered cloth or table for playing draughts, &c. E. शारि a piece, फल fruit; also with कन् added शारिफलक mn. (-कः-कं.)
शारिवा: शारिवा f. (-वा) A plant: as synonymous with Śyāma, (Echites frutescens), but more usually considered synonymous with Anantamūla, (Asclepias pseudosarsa,) the broad leaved variety, the root of which has been used as a substitute for Sarsaparilla, &c. E. शारि injuring, from शॄ with इञ् aff., and वन added.
शारिशृङ्खला: शारिशृङ्खला f. (-ला) A sort of die or dice, used for playing with. E. शारि a man or piece, and शृङ्खला a chain.
शारीर: शारीर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Corporeal, bodily, belonging to or produced from the body. 2 Spiritual in connexion with the body, incorporate. n. (-रं) 1 The soul or spirit whilst incorporate. 2 A drug(?) 3 Excrement, excretion. m. (-रः) Personal chastisement, corporeal punishment. E. शरीर the body, and अण् aff.
शारीरक: शारीरक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) 1 Corporeal, relating to what is corporeal. 2 Incorporate. E. कन् added to the last.
शारीरिक: शारीरिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to the body, corporeal. 2 Contained in the body, incorporate. E. शरीर, and ठञ् aff.
शारुक: शारुक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Mischievous, noxious, injurious. E. शॄ to hurt, उकण aff.
शार्क: शार्क m. (-र्कः) Clayed or candied sugar. E. शॄ to injure, aff. क.
शार्कक: शार्कक m. (-कः) 1 The froth of milk, syllabub, cream. 2 A lump or ball of meat, &c. 3 Clayed or candied sugar. E. कन् added to the last.
शार्कर: शार्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Stony, gravelly. 2 Sugary. m. (-रः) The froth or skim of milk. E. शर्करा sugar, gravel, &c. aff. अण्.
शार्करक: शार्करक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Gravelly, stony, &c. E. शार्कर the same, and कक् added; also from शर्कर with ठक् aff. शार्करिक.
शार्करीय: शार्करीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Stony, gravelly, &c. E. शर्करा gravel, &c., and छ attributive aff.
शार्ङ्ग: शार्ङ्ग mfn. (-र्ङ्गः-र्ङ्गी-र्ङ्गं) Horny, made of horn, &c. n. (-र्ङ्गं) 1 A bow in general. 2 The bow of VIṢṆU. E. शृङ्ग a horn, अण् aff.
शार्ङ्गिन्: शार्ङ्गिन् m. (-र्ङ्गी) 1 A bowyer, an archer. 2 VIṢṆU. E. शाङ्ग a bow, इनि poss. aff.
शार्दूल: शार्दूल m. (-लः) 1 A tiger. 2 Another animal. 3 A Rākṣasa. 4 A sort of bird. 5 (In composition,) Pre-eminent, excellent. 6 A form of metre, a variety of the class Dhṛti, or stanza of four lines of 18 syllables each; also of the class Atidhṛti, in which there are 19 syllables in the line. E. शॄ to injure, टूलच् aff.
शार्दूलललित: शार्दूलललित m. (-तः) A species of the Dhṛti metre, of 4 lines of 18 syllables each.
शार्दूलवाहन: शार्दूलवाहन m. (-नः) A Jaina teacher. E. शार्दूल a tiger, and वाहन a vehicle.
शार्दूलविक्रीडित: शार्दूलविक्रीडित m. (-तः) A form of metre, a variety of the class Atidhṛti or stanza, of 4 lines of 19 syllables each.
शार्वर: शार्वर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Murderous, mischievous. 2 Nocturnal. n. (-रं) Darkness, gloom. f. (-री) Night. E. शर्वरी night, अण् aff.
शाल: शाल (ऋ) शालृ r. 1st cl. (शालते) 1 To flatter, to praise. 2 To boast.

शाल m. (-लः) 1 A kind of fish, (Ophiocephalus wrahl, HAM.) 2 The celebrated sovereign SĀLIVĀHANA. 3 The name of a river. f. (-ला) 1 A house. 2 A hall. 3 A large branch of a tree. E. शल to go, घञ् aff. or शाल to praise, aff. अच्; in several of the meanings it is also written, साल.
शालङ्कायन: शालङ्कायन m. (-नः) 1 The name of a saint. 2 ŚIVA'S attendant NANDI.
शालङ्कायनजीवसू: शालङ्कायनजीवसू f. (-सूः) The mother of VYĀSA.
शालज: शालज m. (-जः) A kind of fish, the Śāl or Sol, (Ophicephalus wrahl, HAM.)
शालनिर्यास: शालनिर्य्यास m. (-सः) Resin, the resinous exudation of the Śāl or Shorea robusta. E. शाल the Śāl tree, and निर्य्यास exudation.
शालनिर्य्यास: शालनिर्य्यास m. (-सः) Resin, the resinous exudation of the Śāl or Shorea robusta. E. शाल the Śāl tree, and निर्य्यास exudation.
शालपर्णी: शालपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) E. शाल the Śāl, and पर्ण a leaf, aff. ङीष्, having similar leaves; also सालपर्णी.
शालभञ्जिका: शालभञ्जिका f. (-का) 1 A doll, a puppet. 2 A whore, a harlot. E. कन् added to the following.
शालभञ्जी: शालभञ्जी f. (-ञ्जी) A doll, a puppet. E. शाल Śāl wood, भञ्ज to rub, (to plane, &c., in order to make dolls,) affs. अच्, and ङीष्; also with कन् added शालभञ्जिका.
शालवेष्ट: शालवेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) Resin, the resin of the Śāl tree, used as incense, &c. E. शाल the Śāl tree, and वेष्ट exudation.
शालसार: शालसार m. (-रः) 1 A tree. 2 Asafætida; also सालसार.
शालाकिन्: शालाकिन् m. (-की) 1 A surgeon. 2 A barber. 3 A spearman, &c. E. शलाका a probe, a dart, &c. अण् aff. of reference, and इनि poss. aff. added.
शालाङ्की: शालाङ्की f. (-ङ्की) A doll, a puppet. E. शाला a hall, अकि to go, affs. अच्, and ङीष्.
शालाजिर: शालाजिर mn. (-रः-रं) A hollow earthen cup or saucer. E. शाला a house, जॄ to become old, अच् aff.
शालाञ्चि: शालाञ्चि f. (-ञ्चिः) A creeping plant, the leaves of which are used as a vegetable, (Achyranthes triandra.) E. शाला a house, अञ्च to go, aff. इन्.
शालानी: शालानी f. (-नी) A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) E. शाल the Śāl tree, आङ् before नी to get, (to resemble in the leaf,) aff. क्विप्.
शालामृग: शालामृग m. (-गः) A Shakal. E. शाला a house, and मृग a deer.
शालार: शालार n. (-रं) 1 A ladder, a flight of stairs or steps. 2 A birdcage. 3 The claw of an elephant. E. शाला a house, ऋ to go, aff. अच्.
शालावृक: शालावृक m. (-कः) 1 A monkey. 2 A dog. 3 A Shakal. 4 A deer. 5 A cat. E. शाला a house, वृक a wolf.
शालि: शालि n. (-लि) 1 Rice in general, but especially in two classes; one like white rice growing in deep water, and the other a red sort, requiring only a moist soil: there are a great many varieties of this grain. 2 The civet or pole cat. E. शाड to float or swim, aff. इन, and ड changed to ल.
शालिक: शालिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating or belonging to a hall, the Śāl tree, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A weaver. 2 A village of artificers. 3 A toll, a tax. f. (-का) A shrub, (Hedysarum gangeticum.) E. शाल the Śāl tree, कन् fem. form, aff. of comparison; or शाला a hall, ठक् aff.
शालिञ्च: शालिञ्च m. (-ञ्चः) A creeper, the leaf of which is used as a vegetable, (Achyranthes triandra, Rox.)
शालिता: शालिता f. (-ता) 1 Possessing, having. 2 Confidence in, relying upon. E. शालिन्, and तल् aff. or with त्व, शालित्वं.
शालिन्: शालिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) 1 Belonging to a house, domestic, &c. 2 Possessing, having. 3 Shining or resplendent with. E. शाल a house, and इनि aff.; in the second form it is the same as शील; the इ being changed to आ when used in composition.
शालिपिष्ट: शालिपिष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Crystal. E. शालि rice, and पिष्ट ground.
शालिवाहन: शालिवाहन m. (-नः) A sovereign of India, whose capital was Pratiṣṭhāna in the Dekhin, and institutor of the era now called Śakā, beginning 76 or 78 years after CRIST. E. शालि from शाल the Śāl tree, or a proper name, that of a Yakṣa transformed to a lion, on which the prince rode when an infant, and वाहन vehicle.
शालिहोत्र: शालिहोत्र m. (-त्रः) A horse. E. शालि rice, corn, and होत्र an oblation; also with इनि added शालिहोत्रिन् m. (-त्री)
शालीन: शालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Ashamed, bashful. 2 Like, resembling. m. (-नः) An opulent householder, one who devotes his attention to worldly affairs. E. शाला a house, ख aff. (fit or worthy to enter it.)
शालीनत्व: शालीनत्व n. (-त्वं) Modesty. E. त्व added to the last, also with तल्, शालीनता.
शालीनत्वविवर्ज्जित: शालीनत्वविवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Immodest. E. शालीनत्व, and विवर्ज्जित devoid of.
शालु: शालु m. (-लुः) 1 An astringent substance. 2 A sort of perfume, commonly called Cor. 3 A frog. n. (-लु) The root of the water lily. E. शॄ to hurt, उ aff., and र changed to ल.
शालुक: शालुक n. (-कं) The root of a lotus: see the next.
शालूक: शालूक n. (-कं) The esculent root of the different kinds of Nymphæa or water lily. E. शल to go, to shake, Uṇādi aff. ऊकन्; also with a short vowel शालुक.
शालूर: शालूर m. (-रः) A frog. E. शल to go, ऊलच् aff. and the radical vowel made long; also शालुर.
शालेय: शालेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Fit for rice, (a field, &c.) m. (-यः) A sort of fennel, (Anethum sowa.) E. शालि rice, and ढंक् aff.
शालोत्तरीय: शालोत्तरीय m. (-यः) A name of PĀṆINI, the inspired grammarian. E. शाला a house, the house of his preceptor, उत्तरीय latter, last; having been expelled it for stupidity, and acquiring his subsequent science by his worship of ŚIVA.
शाल्मल: शाल्मल m. (-लः) 1 The silk cotton tree. 2 One of the Dvīpas to divisions of the continent. 3 The gum of the silk cotton tree. E. see the next.
शाल्मलि: शाल्मलि mf. (-लिः-ली) 1 The silk cotton tree, (Bombax heptaphyllum.) 2 One of the seven Dvīpas, islands or great divisions of the known continent; denominated from the tree first mentioned, said to grow there: it is surrounded by the sea of Ghee or clarified butter. E. शल to go, causal form, क्विप् aff. शाल् exuding, emitting, मल to hold, aff. इन्, and ङीष् optionally added; also with अच् aff. शाल्मल, and with the first vowel short, शल्मलि, &c.
शाल्मलिन्: शाल्मलिन् m. (-ली) GARUḌA, the bird and vehicle of VIṢṆU, f. (-लिनी) The silk cotton tree.
शाल्मलीवेष्ट: शाल्मलीवेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) The gum of the silk cotton tree. E. शाल्मलि the tree, and वेष्ट exudation; also with कन् added शाल्मलीवेष्टक.
शाल्व: शाल्व m. plu. (-ल्वाः) The inhabitants of one of the central divisions of India.
शाव: शाव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) 1 Tawny, (of that colour.) 2 Relating to the purification of defilement from the contact or consanguinity of a corpse, &c. 3 Relating to a dead body. m. (-वः) 1 Tawny, (the colour.) 2 The young of any animal, see the next. E. शष a dead body, and अण् aff.; or शव to go, aff. घञ्.
शावक: शावक m. (-कः) The young of any animal. E. शाव, and कन् added.
शावर: शावर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) Low, vile. m. (-रः) 1 Fault, offence. 2 Sin, wickedness. 3 The Lodh tree, (Symplocos racemosus.) f. (-री) 1 Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) 2 A sort of Prākṛta, that spoken by barbarians. E. शवर a man of low or degraded caste, and अण् aff.
शावरभेदाख्य: शावरभेदाख्य n. (-ख्यं) Copper. E. शावर relating to a low race, भेद class, and आख्य appellation.
शावाशौच: शावाशौच n. (-चं) Impurity from the demise of a relation. E. शाव, and अशौच impurity.
शाश्वत: शाश्वत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Eternal, perpetual. m. (-तः) 1 A name of VYĀSA. 2 ŚIVA. 3 The sun. n. (-तं) Heaven, ether. f. (-ती) The earth. E. शश्वत् perpetually, अण् aff.
शाष्कुल: शाष्कुल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Eating flesh or fish. E. शुष्कुली flesh, अण् aff. form irr.: see शौष्कुल.
शाष्कुलिक: शाष्कुलिक n. (-कं) A multitude of pies. E. शष्कुली a sort of pie, ठक् aff.
शास: शास (उ,) शासु r. 2nd cl. (शास्ति) 1 To instruct, to inform. 2 To order, to direct, to enact. 3 To rule, to govern. (शास्ते) 1 To wish or desire: with आङ् prefixed, r. 1st cl. (आशासते) r. 2nd cl. (आशास्ते) To wish well to, to bless.
शासन: शासन n. (-नं) 1 An order, an edict, a command. 2 A royal grant of land or of privileges, a charter, &c. usually inscribed on stone or copper. 3 A writing, a deed, a written contract or agreement. 4 A Śāstra or scripture. 5 Devotion, or devotional tranquillity, the government of the passions. 6 Governing, ruling, government. E. शास to order or direct, aff. ल्युट.
शासनपत्र: शासनपत्र n. (-त्रं) A plate of copper, a stone or sheet of paper, &c. on which an edict or grant is inscribed. E. शासन, and पत्र leaf.
शासनहर: शासनहर m. (-रः) A royal messenger, one bearing an edict or grant. E. शासन an edict, and हर who takes.
शासनीय: शासनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be governed or directed. E. शास to rule, अनीयर् aff.; also शासितव्य and शास्य.
शासित: शासित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Governed, ruled. E. शास to rule, aff. क्त.
शासितृ: शासितृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Ordering, commanding, a governor or commander. E. शास to order, तृच् aff. with इट् augment.
शास्ति: शास्ति f. (-स्तिः) 1 A command, an order. 2 Governing, ruling, ordering. 3 A sceptre. 4 Correction, punishment. E. शास to govern, aff. क्तिन् or ति Uṇādi aff.
शास्तृ: शास्तृ mfn. (-स्ता-स्ती-स्तृ) 1 A ruler, one who rules or governs. 2 A teacher, teaching, instructing. m. (-स्ता) A Buddha or Jina, or the deified teacher of one or both those sects. E. शास to govern, &c. aff. तृच्, and the augment omitted.
शास्त्र: शास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) 1 An order or command. 2 Scripture, science, institutes of religion, law or letters, especially considered as of divine origin or authority: used singly, it implies works of literature or science in general, and it is therefore customarily connected with some other word to limit its application, as the Vedānta Śāstras, or treatises of philosophical theology; the Dharma Śāstras, books of law, &c.: it is also applied to less important branches of knowledge, as the Kāvya Śāstras, or poetical works; Śilpi Śāstras, works on the mechanical arts; and Kāma Śāstras, or erotic compositions; in the singular number it is also used comprehensively to signify the body of all that has been written on the subject, as Dharma Śāstra, the institutes or code of law; Kāvya Śāstra, poetry; Alaṅkāra Śāstra, rhetoric, &c. 3 A book in general. E. शास to govern or teach, aff. ष्ट्रन्.
शास्त्रकृत्: शास्त्रकृत् m. (-कृत्) 1 A Ṛṣi, a holy personage of divine character. 2 An author in general. E. शास्त्र a Śāstra or scripture, &c., and कृत् the author; the principal compositions in Hindu religion, law, and literature, being attributed to sanctified and superhuman personages.
शास्त्रगण्ड: शास्त्रगण्ड m. (-ण्डः) A general and superficial scholar.
शास्त्रचक्षुस्: शास्त्रचक्षुस् n. (-क्षुः) Grammar. E. शास्त्र science, and चक्षुस् the eye.
शास्त्रज्ञ: शास्त्रज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Acquainted with the Śāstras, skilled in the knowledge of law and religion especially. E. शास्त्र a sacred work, and ज्ञ who knows.
शास्त्रज्ञता: शास्त्रज्ञता f. (-ता) Knowledge of the Śāstras. E. शास्त्रज्ञ, and तल् aff.; also शास्त्रज्ञत्वं.
शास्त्रज्ञान: शास्त्रज्ञान n. (-नं) Knowledge derived from the study of sacred works. E. शास्त्र, and ज्ञान knowledge.
शास्त्रतत्त्व: शास्त्रतत्त्व n. (-त्त्वं) The truth or true knowledge taught in sacred works. E. शास्त्र, and तत्त्व truth.
शास्त्रतत्त्वज्ञ: शास्त्रतत्त्वज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Understanding the works of sacred science. m. (-ज्ञः) An astrologer, an astronomer. E. शास्त्र sacred or astronomical science, तत्त्व the truth, and ज्ञ who knows.
शास्त्रतस्: शास्त्रतस् ind. After or according to the Śāstras. E. शास्त्र, and तसि aff.
शास्त्रदर्शिन्: शास्त्रदर्शिन् mfn. (-र्शी-र्शिनी-र्शि) Skilled in sacred science. E. शास्त्र Śāstra, and दर्शिन् who inspects.
शास्त्रनिन्दा: शास्त्रनिन्दा f. (-न्दा) Revilling or denying the authority of sacred works. E. शास्त्र, and निन्दा reviling.
शास्त्रप्रसङ्ग: शास्त्रप्रसङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The subject of the Śāstras. 2 Discussing works of sacred literature. E. शास्त्र, and प्रसङ्ग attaching to.
शास्त्रवत्: शास्त्रवत् ind. Conformably or according to written authority. E. शास्त्र and वति aff.
शास्त्रवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Having or following sacred institutes, &c. E. शास्त्र, and मतुप् aff.
शास्त्रविट्: शास्त्रविट् mfn. (-विट्) Understanding or conversant with the scriptures, skilled in sacred science. E. शास्त्र a Śāstra, and विट् who knows.
शास्त्रविधान: शास्त्रविधान n. (-नं) Sacred ritual, ceremonial precept. E. शास्त्र, and विधान direction; also शास्त्रविधि.
शास्त्रविप्रतिषिद्ध: शास्त्रविप्रतिषिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Contrary to law or religion, illegal, forbidden. E. शास्त्र a Śāstra, and विप्रतिषिद्ध prohibited.
शास्त्रविप्रतिषेध: शास्त्रविप्रतिषेध n. (-धं) Any act contrary to the legal and religious institutes of the Hindus. E. शास्त्र an institute, and वि and प्रति contra-indicative prefixes before षिद्ध to accomplish, aff. घञ्.
शास्त्रविरुद्ध: शास्त्रविरुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Contrary to law or religion. E. शास्त्र, and विरुद्ध opposed to.
शास्त्रविरोध: शास्त्रविरोध m. (-धः) 1 Opposition or deviation from sacred authority. 2 Contradiction or incompatibility of different systems. E. शास्त्र, and विरोध contrariety.
शास्त्रशिल्पिन: शास्त्रशिल्पिन plu. m. (-नः) The people of Kashmir. E. शास्त्र a treatise, and शिल्पिन an artificer.
शास्त्रसिद्ध: शास्त्रसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Established or proved by sacred institutes or divine works. E. शास्त्र, and सिद्ध established.
शास्त्राचरण: शास्त्राचरण m. (-णः) 1 Versed in the scriptures, well read in the works of sacred science, a Paṇḍita. 2 A follower of the Vedas, one whose conduct is regulated by their precepts. E. शास्त्र a sacred treatise, and आचरण who goes through or studies.
शास्त्रातिक्रम: शास्त्रातिक्रम m. (-मः) Behaving ill or immorally, transgressing, acting contrary to the Śāstras. E. शास्त्र, and अतिक्रम surpassing.
शास्त्रानुष्ठान: शास्त्रानुष्ठान n. (-नं) Following the Śāstras, conforming to the law or ritual, &c. E. शास्त्र, and अनुष्ठान conforming.
शास्त्रानुष्ठित: शास्त्रानुष्ठित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Who or what obeys or follows sacred institutes, &c. 2 Established or authorised by the Śāstras. E. शास्त्र, and अनुष्ठित following.
शास्त्रानुसार: शास्त्रानुसार m. (-रः) Conformity to sacred ordinances. E. शास्त्र, and अनुसार following.
शास्त्राभिज्ञ: शास्त्राभिज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) Learned, versed in the Śāstras. E. शास्त्र, and अभिज्ञ who knows.
शास्त्रिन्: शास्त्रिन् m. (-स्त्री) A Paṇḍita, a teacher of holy science, or one skilled in it. E. शास्त्र as above, and इनि aff.
शास्त्रीय: शास्त्रीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Scriptural, authorised by or conformable to sacred institutes. E. शास्त्र, and छ aff.
शास्त्रोक्त: शास्त्रोक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Said or declared in a work of sacred authority. E. शास्त्र, and उक्त said.
शास्य: शास्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) 1 To be regulated or ordained, to be enforced, to be provided for by any act of government or judicature. 2 Punishable, deserving punishment. E. शास to govern, aff. यत्.
शि: शि (ञ,) शिञ् r. 5th cl. (शिनोति शिनुते) 1 To make thin or small. 2 To whet, to sharpen.
शि m. (-शिः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 Auspiciousness, good fortune. 3 Peace, composure, calm. E. शि to whet, or शो to destroy, aff. कि.
शिंशपा: शिंशपा f. (-पा) A tree, (Dalbergia Sisu.) 2 The Asoka tree. E. शीघ्र quick, or शीर्ष the head or top; पा to cherish, or पत to fall, &c, aff. क or ड, deriv. irr.
शिक्कु: शिक्कु mfn. (-क्कुः-क्कुः-क्कु) Idle, lazy, following no business or profession.
शिक्थ: शिक्थ n. (-क्थं) Bee's wax; also शिक्थकं and सिक्थकं.
शिक्य: शिक्य nf. (-क्यं-क्या) 1 The string or loop suspended from either end of a pole or yoke to receive the burthen. 2 The burthen so carried. 3 The strings of a balance. E. श्रंस to fall, Uṇādi aff. यत्; शि substituted for the root, and कुट् augment.
शिक्याधार: शिक्याधार m. (-रः) The hook or eye at each end of a pole or beam, to which the strings of a yoke or balance are fastened. E. शिक्या as above, and आधार receptacle.
शिक्यित: शिक्यित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Suspended or carried in a sort of loop. E. शिक्य a loop, and इतच् aff.
शिक्ष: शिक्ष r. 1st cl. (शिक्षते) To learn, to acquire science.
शिक्षक: शिक्षक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) A learner, a teacher. E. शिक्ष to learn, ण्वुल् aff.
शिक्षणीय: शिक्षणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be taught or learnt. E. शिक्ष to learn, अनीयर् aff.
शिक्षा: शिक्षा f. (-क्षा) 1 One of the six Vedāṅgas or sciences attached to the Vedas: the proper pronunciation of the vocal sounds which occur in them, as explained by PĀṆINI. 2 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) 3 Learning, study, the acquisition of knowledge. 4 Modesty, humility. E. शिक्ष to learn, affs. अङ् and टाप्.
शिक्षाकर: शिक्षाकर m. (-रः) 1 VYĀSA. 2 An instructor. E. शिक्षा the science of pronunciation, and कर making.
शिक्षाशक्ति: शिक्षाशक्ति f. (-क्तिः) Dexterity, skill. E. शिक्षा discipline, and शक्ति power.
शिक्षित: शिक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Skilful, clever, conversant. 2 Modest, diffident. 3 Disciplined, exercised. 4 Tame, trained, (as an animal.) 5 Docile. 6 Studied, learned. E. शिक्षा studying, इतच् aff. or शिक्ष to study, aff. क्त.
शिक्षितव्य: शिक्षितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be taught or learnt. E. शिक्ष to learn, and तव्य aff.
शिक्षिताक्षर: शिक्षिताक्षर m. (-रः) A pupil, a scholar. E. शिक्षित studied, (by whom,) and अक्षर a letter.
शिक्ष्य: शिक्ष्य mfn. (-क्ष्यः-क्ष्या-क्ष्यं) 1 To be taught, teachable. E. शिक्ष to learn, यत् aff.
शिख: शिख (इ) r. 1st cl. (शिङ्खति) To go, to move or approach.
शिखण्ड: शिखण्ड m. (-ण्डः) 1 The tail of a peacock. 2 Locks left on the crown or the sides of the head, at the period of tonsure in children: see the next. E. शिखिन् a peacock or any crested object, अम to be or belong to, ड aff., and the form irr.
शिखण्डक: शिखण्डक m. (-कः) Locks of hair left at the time of tonsure; three or five locks left in children in general, or especially those of the military class, in which latter case, the hair is left in a semicircular patch on each side of the head, covering rather more than the temporal bones, and following much the same outline: see काकपक्ष. 2 The crest or lock of hair left on the crown of the head. 3 A peacock's tail. E. शिखा a crest, अण्ड an egg, and कन् pleonasm, or aff. of comparison; also शिखाण्डक and शिखण्ड.
शिखण्डिक: शिखण्डिक m. (-कः) A cock. f. (-का) A lock of hair on the crown of the head. E. शिखण्ड a crest, &c. aff. ठक् or कन् in the fem. form.
शिखण्डिन्: शिखण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी) 1 A peacock. 2 A peacock's tail. 3 A cock. 4 An arrow. 5 A Ṛṣi, either of the seven represented by the stars of the greater bear: see चित्रशिखण्डिन्. 6 The son of DRUPADA, by metamorphosis: see below. f. (-नी) 1 A kind of jasmine, (J. auriculatum.) 2 A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.) 3 The daughter of DRUPADA, afterwards changed to a male. E. शिखण्ड a crest, and इनि poss. aff.
शिखर: शिखर mn. (-रः-रं) 1 The peak or summit of a mountain. 2 The top of a tree. 3 Point, end, top in general. 4 Horripilation. 5 The armpit. 6 A piece of a ruby or a gem, described as of the colour of the ripe pomegranate seed or a bright red. 7 The edge or point of a sword. f. (-रा) A plant, from the fibres of which bow-strings were made, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) E. शिखा a crest, and रच् poss. aff., and the vowel made short.
शिखरवासिनी: शिखरवासिनी f. (-नी) DURGĀ. E. शिस्वर the peak, (of the Himālaya.) and वासिनी abiding.
शिखरिन्: शिखरिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) Crested, peaked, pointed. m. (-री) 1 A mountain. 2 A tree. 3 A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) 4 A strong-hold, a hill-fort. 5 The lapwing. f. (-रिणी) 1 A form of metre, a species of the class Atyaṣṭi or verse of four lines of 17 syllables each. 2 A dish of curds and sugar with spices. 3 An excellent woman. 4 Arabian jasmine. 5 A line of hair extending across the navel. E. शिस्वर a point or peak, and इनि aff.
शिखलोहित: शिखलोहित m. (-तः) A plant, commonly Kukurmurā.
शिखा: शिखा f. (-खा) 1 Point, top in general. 2 A crest. 3 A peacock's crest. 4 A lock of hair on the crown of the head. 5 Flame. 6 A radicating branch. 7 Any branch. 8 A plant, commonly Lāṅgalīya. 9 Chief, principal. 10 Fever, proceeding from libidinous excitement or love. 11 A ray of light. E. शीङ् to sleep, Uṇādi aff. ख, and the vowel made short.
शिखाण्डक: शिखाण्डक (-कः) Hair left on each side of the head: see शिखण्डक.
शिखातरु: शिखातरु m. (-रुः) A candlestick or lampstand. E. शिखा flame, and तरु a tree.
शिखाधर: शिखाधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Crested, pointed. 2 Having a top knot. m. (-रः) 1 A peacock. 2 A Jaina deified saint. E. शिखा a crest, and धर who has.
शिखाधार: शिखाधार m. (-रः) A peacock. E. शिखा a crest, and धार who has.
शिखामूल: शिखामूल n. (-लं) A carrot, a turnip, or any root with a tuft of leaves growing from it. E. शिखा a crest, and मूल a root.
शिखावत्: शिखावत् m. (-वान्) A name of AGNI or fire. 2 The personified descending node. 3 A lamp. f. (-वती) A plant, (Sanseviera zeylanica.) E. शिखा a crest, and मतुप् poss. aff.
शिखावर: शिखावर m. (-रः) The jack fruit tree, (Artocarpus integrifolia.)
शिखावल: शिखावल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Crested, pointed. m. (-लः) A peacock. f. (-ला) A flower, (Celosia cristata.) E. शिखा a crest, and वलच् aff.
शिखावृक्ष: शिखावृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The stand of lamp. E. शिखा flame, and वृक्ष a tree.
शिखावृद्धि: शिखावृद्धि f. (-द्धिः) Usurious interest payable daily. शिक्षा a tuft of hair, and वृद्धि interest; growing constantly.
शिखिग्रीव: शिखिग्रीव n. (-वं) Blue vitriol. E. शिखि for शिखिन् a peacock, ग्रीवा the neck, अच् added, being of the same colour.
शिखिध्वज: शिखिध्वज m. (-जः) 1 Smoke. 2 The deity KĀRTTIKEYA. E. शिखि a peacock, or fire, and ध्वज an emblem.
शिखिन्: शिखिन् mfn. (-खी-खिनी-खि) 1 Crested. 2 Having a lock of hair on the top of the head. m. (-खी) 1 Fire. 2 A peacock. 3 A bull. 4 An arrow. 5 A tree. 6 A cock. 7 KETU, the personified descending node. 8 A horse. 9 A mountain. 10 A Brahman. 11 A lamp. 12 A religious mendicant. E. शिखा a crest, and इनि aff.
शिखिपुच्छ: शिखिपुच्छ n. (-च्छं) A peacock's tail. E. शिखि a peacock, and पुच्छ a tail.
शिखिमण्डल: शिखिमण्डल m. (-लः) A tree, (Tapia cratæva.) E. शिखि a peacock, and मण्डल district.
शिखिवर्द्धक: शिखिवर्द्धक m. (-कः) A pumpkin gourd. E. शिखि a peacock, and वर्द्धक increasing.
शिखिवाहन: शिखिवाहन m. (-नः) KĀRTTIKEYA. E. शिखि a peacock, and वाहन a vehicle, the deity being mounted on this bird.
शिखिशिखा: शिखिशिखा f. (-खा) 1 Flame. 2 A peacock's crest. E. शिखिन्, and शिखा a crest, &c.
शिखिशेखर: शिखिशेखर n. (-रं) A peacock's crest. E. शिखिन्, and शेखर a crest.
शिग्रु: शिग्रु m. (-ग्रुः) 1 A tree, (Morunga guilandina and hyperanthera.) 2 A potherb in general. E. शि to sharpen, रुक् aff., and ग augment.
शिग्रुज: शिग्रुज n. (-जं) The seed of the Morunga. E. शिग्रु, and ज produced.
शिग्रुमूल: शिग्रुमूल n. (-लं) The pungent root of the Morunga. E. शिग्रु, and मूल the root.
शिग्रुवीज: शिग्रुवीज n. (-जं) The seed of the Morunga. E. शिग्रु, and वीज seed.
शिघ: शिघ (इ) शिघि r. 1st cl. (शिंघति) To smell.
शिङ्घाण: शिङ्घाण n. (-णं) 1 Any glass vessel. 2 The mucus of the nose. 3 Rust of iron. E. शिघि to smell, आणक Uṇādi affix, and the final optionally rejected; also शिंघाणक and शिंहाणक.
शिङ्घाणक: शिङ्घाणक m. (-कः) Phlegm. mn. (-कः-कं) The mucus of the nose. E. शिघि to smell, aff. आणक.
शिङ्घित: शिङ्घित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Smelled. E. शिघि to smell, aff. क्त.
शिच्: शिच् f. (शिक्) The string of a pole for carrying burdens. E. श्रंस to fall, deriv. irr.: see शिक्य.
शिज: शिज (इ) शिजि r. 2nd cl. (शिंक्ते) 1 To make an inarticulate sound. 2 To tinkle.
शिञ्ज: शिञ्ज mf. (-ञ्जः-ञ्जा) The tinkling sound of silver and other metallic ornaments worn round the waist, arm, or ancles, &c. f. (-ञ्जा) A bow string. E. शिजि to make an inarticulate sound, aff. अङ् and टाप्: also शिञ्जिनी, &c.
शिञ्जञ्जिका: शिञ्जञ्जिका f. (-का) A chain worn round a man's loins.
शिञ्जित: शिञ्जित n. (-तं) The tinkling of metallic ornaments worn as rings, chains, &c. E. शिञ्जा inarticulate sound, इतच् aff.
शिञ्जिन्: शिञ्जिन् mfn. (-ञ्जी-ञ्जिनी-ञ्जि) Tinkling, making a tinkling sound. f. (-ञ्जिनी) 1 A bow-string. 2 Metallic rings worn round the toes, an ornament of the feet. E. शिञ्जा a tinkling, and इनि aff.
शिट: शिट r. 1st cl. (शेटति) To disregard, to treat with disrespect.
शित: शित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Thin, emaciated, wasted, declined. 2 Weak, feeble. 3 Sharpened, whetted. E. शि to sharpen, or शो to pare or whet, aff. क्त.
शितता: शितता f. (-ता) Sharpness. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, शितत्वं.
शितद्रु: शितद्रु f. (-द्रुः) The Śatadru or Setlej river. E. शित weakened, द्रु to flow, aff. कुः see शतद्रु.
शितधार: शितधार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Sharp-edged. E. शित, and धारा an edge.
शितशूक: शितशूक m. (-कः) 1 Barley. 2 Wheat. E. शित sharpened, शूक the beard.
शिताग्र: शिताग्र mfn. (-ग्रः-ग्रा-ग्रं) Sharp-pointed. m. (-ग्रः) A thorn. E. शित, and अग्र point.
शितास्त्रभृत्: शितास्त्रभृत् m. (-भृत्) Armed with sharp weapons. E. शित, अस्त्र a weapon, भृत् who has.
शिति: शिति mfn. (-तिः-ती-ति) 1 Black. 2 White. m. (-तिः) The Bhojpatra or birch. E. शि to sharpen, क्तिन् or क्तिच् aff.; or शत to go, Uṇādi aff. इन्, and इ substituted for the radical vowel; also सिति.
शितिकण्ठ: शितिकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A gallinule. 3 A peacock. E. शिति black, and कण्ठ the throat.
शितिचार: शितिचार m. (-रः) A potherb, (apparently Marsilea dentata, Rox.)
शितिच्छद: शितिछद m. (-दः) A goose. E. शिति white, छद a feather; also सितछद.
शितिछद: शितिछद m. (-दः) A goose. E. शिति white, छद a feather; also सितछद.
शितिपक्ष: शितिपक्ष m. (-क्षः) A goose. E. शिति white, पक्ष a wing; also सितपक्ष.
शितिरत्न: शितिरत्न n. (-त्नं) A sapphire. E. शिति, and रत्न a gem.
शितिसारक: शितिसारक m. (-कः) A sort of ebony, (Diospyros glutinosa.) E. शिति black, and सार essence, resin, कन् added; yielding a strong black resin that is used for caulking boats, &c.
शितेषु: शितेषु m. (-षुः) A sharp arrow. E. शित, and इषु an arrow.
शिथिल: शिथिल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Loose, lax, flaccid, flabby. 2 Languid, inert, feeble. 3 Ineffective, unenergetic. 4 Relaxed, slackened. 5 Not rigidly observed. 6 Loosely retained or possessed. 7 Abandoned, got rid of, shaken off. E. श्रथ to be lax or loose, Uṇādi aff. किरच्, the form irr.
शिथिलता: शिथिलता f. (-ता) Relaxation, looseness, being unfastened, &c. E. शिथिल, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शिथिलत्वं.
शिथिलित: शिथिलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Let go, loosed, released. 2 Relaxed, loosened. E. शिथिल, and इतच् aff.
शिथिलबल: शिथिलबल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Weakened, relaxed. E. शिथिल, and बल strength.
शिथिलवसु: शिथिलवसु mfn. (-सुः-सुः-सु) 1 Reduced in wealth. 2 Shining with diminished rays. E. शिथिल, and वसु wealth, &c.
शिथिलशक्ति: शिथिलशक्ति mfn. (-क्तिः-शिः-क्ति) Impaired in strength or power. E. शिथिल, and शक्ति power.
शिथिलीकरण: शिथिलीकरण n. (-णं) 1 Loosening, unfastening. 2 Impairing, weakening, reducing. E. शिथिल, and करण doing, च्चि augment.
शिथिलीकृत: शिथिलीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Unbound, unfastened. slackened. 2 Reduced, impaired, weakened. 3 Let loose. E. शिथिल, and कृत made, च्चि augment.
शिनि: शिनि m. (-निः) A proper name, a chief of the Kṣatriya tribe. E. शि to make thin or small, Uṇādi aff. नि.
शिनेर्नप्तृ: शिनेर्नप्तृ m. (-प्ता) A name of SĀTYAKI, one of the chiefs of the Pāṇḍus. E. शिनि a proper name, and नप्तृ grandson.
शिपि: शिपि m. (-पिः) A ray of light. f. (-पिः) Skin, leather.
शिपिविष्ट: शिपिविष्ट m. (-ष्टः) 1 A bald man. 2 A man naturally void of prepuce. 3 ŚIVA. 4 VIṢṆU. 5 A leper. E. शिपि a ray of light, and विष्ट entered; also शिपविष्ट and शिविपिष्ट.
शिफा: शिफा f. (-फा) 1 A fibrous root. 2 Spikenard, (Valeriana jatamansi.) 3 A river. 4 A mother. 5 Turmerick. 6 The root of a water lily. E. शी to sleep, फक् aff., and the form irr.
शिफाकन्द: शिफाकन्द mn. (-न्दः-न्दं) The root of a water lily. E. शिफा a fibrous root, and कन्द a root.
शिफाधर: शिफाधर m. (-रः) A branch. E. शिफा a fibrous root, and धर what has.
शिफारुह: शिफारुह m. (-हः) The Indian fig tree. E. शिफा a fibrous root, and रुह what grows.
शिम्ब: शिम्ब m. (-म्बः) A sort of large shrub, (Cassia alata.) f. (-म्बा) A legume, a pod; also सिम्बा. E. शि to make small, deriv. irr.; also शिम्बि.
शिम्बि: शिम्बि f. (-म्बिः-म्बी) A legume, a pod. E. शि to make small or sharpen, deriv. irr.; also शिम्बा, and सिम्बा.
शिम्बिक: शिम्बिक m. (-कः) A sort of kidney-bean, (Phaseolus max.) f. (-का) A legume, a pod. E. कन् added to the last; also शिम्बा, &c.
शिम्बिपर्णी: शिम्बिपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus trilobus.) E. शिम्बि a pod, and पर्ण leaf, aff. ङीष्; also with कन् added fem. form शिम्बिपर्णिका.
शिर: शिर n. (-रं) 1 The head. 2 The root of the pepper plant. f. (-रा) Any vessel of the body, really, or supposed to be, of a tubular form, as a nerve, a tendon, a gut, &c. E. शॄ to injure, क aff.: see शिरस.
शिरःकपालिन्: शिरःकपालिन् m. (-ली) A devotee carrying a human scull as his emblem. E. शिरस् the head, कपाल the scull, and इनि aff.
शिरःपीडा: शिरःपीडा f. (-डा) Pain of the head, head-ache. E. शिरस्, and पीडा pain.
शिरःफल: शिरःफल m. (-लः) The cocoa-nut tree. E. शिरस् the head, and फल fruit.
शिरःस्नात: शिरःस्नात mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Having the head bathed. E. शिरस् and स्नात bathed.
शिरज: शिरज m. (-जः) The hair of the head. E. शिर the head, and ज born.
शिरस्: शिरस् n. (-रः) 1 The head. 2 The top of a tree. 3 The van of an army. 4 Chief, principal, head. E. श्रि to honour, in the passive form, to be honoured, (by the other members,) असुन् Uṇādi aff., and the form irr.
शिरसिज: शिरसिज m. (-जः) The hair of the head. E. शिरसि seventh case, in the head, ज born.
शिरसिरुह्: शिरसिरुह् m. (-रुट्) The hair of the head. E. शिरसि on the head, रुह् what grows.
शिरस्क: शिरस्क n. (-स्कं) 1 A helmet. 2 A turban, a hat or cap. f. (-स्का) A litter, a palanquin. E. शिरस् the head, and कप् added.
शिरस्तापिन्: शिरस्तापिन् m. (-पी) An elephant. E. शिरस् the head, तप to inflame, णिनि aff.
शिरस्त्र: शिरस्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) 1 A helmet. 2 A cap, a turban, &c. E. शिरस् the head, and त्रै to protect, aff. क.
शिरस्त्राण: शिरस्त्राण n. (-णं) 1 A helmet. 2 A cap, a turban, &c. E. शिरस् the head, त्राण the instrument of defence.
शिरस्य: शिरस्य mfn. (-स्यः-स्या-स्यं) Of or on the head. n. (-स्यं) Clean unentangled hair. E. शिरस् the head, यत् aff.
शिरस्स्थ: शिरस्स्थ mfn. (-स्स्थः-स्स्था-स्स्थं) At or on the head, at the top, &c. m. (-स्थः) A chief, a leader. E. शिरस् head, chief, and स्था to stay or be, aff. क.
शिरापत्र: शिरापत्र m. (-त्रः) The elephant or wood apple, (Feronia elephantium.) E. शिरा a vein, and पत्र leaf.
शिराल: शिराल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Veiny, tendinous, skinny, showing the tendons or veins. n. (-लं) An acid fruit, (Averrhoa carambola.) E. शिरा a vein, लच् poss. aff.
शिरालक: शिरालक m. (-कः) A plant, (Cissus quadrangularis.) E. कन् added to the last.
शिरि: शिरि m. (-रिः). 1 A sword. 2 An arrow. 3 A murderer, a killer. 4 A locust. E. शॄ to injure or kill, Uṇādi aff. इ, and the radical vowel changed to इर.
शिरीष: शिरीष m. (-षः) A kind of tree, (Atracia sirisa.) E. शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. ईषन्.
शिरोगृह: शिरोगृह n. (-हं) A room on the top of the house, a turret. E. शिरस् top, and गृह house.
शिरोग्रीव: शिरोग्रीव n. (-वं) The head and neck. E. शिरस् the head, ग्रीव the neck, the compound neuter.
शिरोधरा: शिरोधरा f. (-रा) The neck. E. शिरस् the head, and धर what upholds.
शिरोधि: शिरोधि f. (-धिः) The neck. E. शिरस् the head, धा to hold, aff. कि.
शिरोमणि: शिरोमणि mf. (-णिः-णी) A gem worn in a crest, or on the top of the head. E. शिरस् the head, and मणि a jewel.
शिरोमर्मन्: शिरोमर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्म) A hog. E. शिरस् the head, and मर्म्मन् vitality.
शिरोमर्म्मन्: शिरोमर्म्मन् m. (-र्म्म) A hog. E. शिरस् the head, and मर्म्मन् vitality.
शिरोरत्न: शिरोरत्न n. (-त्नं) A gem worn in the crest. E. शिरस् the head, and रत्न a jewel.
शिरोरुजा: शिरोरुजा f. (-जा) 1 A tree, (Echites scholaris.) 2 Pain or diseased affection of the head. E. शिरस् the head, and रुजा sickness; a remedy being prepared from the leaves of the plant for head-ache.
शिरोरुह्: शिरोरुह् m. (-रुट्) Hair. E. शिरस् the head, रुह to grow, क्विप् aff.
शिरोरुह: शिरोरुह m. (-हः) The hair of the head. E. शिरस् the head, रुह to grow, क aff.; also शिरोरुह्.
शिरोरोग: शिरोरोग m. (-गः) Disease of the head. E. शिरस्, and रोग sickness.
शिरोर्ति: शिरोर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) Pain of the head, head-ache, &c. E. शिरस् the head, and आर्त्ति pain.
शिरोर्त्ति: शिरोर्त्ति f. (-र्त्तिः) Pain of the head, head-ache, &c. E. शिरस् the head, and आर्त्ति pain.
शिरोवर्तिन्: शिरोवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) At the head or top, &c. m. (-र्त्ती) A chief; one at the head of affairs or of an army. E. शिरस्, and वर्त्तिन् staying.
शिरोवर्त्तिन्: शिरोवर्त्तिन् mfn. (-र्त्ती-र्त्तिनी-र्त्ति) At the head or top, &c. m. (-र्त्ती) A chief; one at the head of affairs or of an army. E. शिरस्, and वर्त्तिन् staying.
शिरोवल्ली: शिरोवल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The crest or comb of the peacock. E. शिरस् the head, and वल्ली a creeper; it is also read शिरोत्रन्दि.
शिरोवृत्त: शिरोवृत्त n. (-त्तं) Pepper. E. शिरस् the head or top, and वृत्त surrounded.
शिरोवेष्ट: शिरोवेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) 1 A turban. 2 A cap. E. शिरस् the head, and वेष्ट what surrounds; also शिरोवेष्टन.
शिरोवेष्टन: शिरोवेष्टन n. (-नं) A turban. E. शिरस् the head, and वेष्टन enfolding.
शिरोस्थि: शिरोस्थि n. (-स्थि) A scull. E. शिरस् the head, and अस्थि a bone.
शिल: शिल n. (-लं) Gleaning ears of corn. f. (-ला) 1 A stone, a rock. 2 Arsenic. 3 A flat stone on which condiments, &c. are ground with a muller. f. (-ला-ली) 1 The timber of a door frame. 2 A transverse beam, or a beam or stone placed across the top of a post or pillar. f. (-ली) 1 A small earth worm. 2 A dart, a spike. E. शिल to glean, aff. क.
शिलाकर्णी: शिलाकर्णी f. (-र्णी) The Olibanum tree, (Boswellia thurifera.)
शिलाकुट्टक: शिलाकुट्टक m. (-कः) A stone cutter's chisel. E. शिला a stone, कुट्ट to cut, aff. वुन्.
शिलाकुसुम: शिलाकुसुम n. (-मं) Storax: see शिलाज. E. शिला and कुसुम flower.
शिलाघन: शिलाघन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Firm or hard as a stone or rock. E. शिला, and घन thick.
शिलाज: शिलाज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in a mountain or rock, fossile, mineral. n. (-जं) 1 Storax or Benzoin, the resins of the Styrax benzoinum or S. officinale, which are usually confounded by the Hindus. 2 Iron. E. शिला a rock, and ज born; the balsams being supposed to be fossile productions, and to exude from the soil of mountainous places; being confounded with bitumen or petroleum.
शिलाजतु: शिलाजतु n. (-तु) 1 Bitumen. 2 Red chalk. E. शिला a stone, and जतु lac; it is supposed to ooze from the stones of mountains in the hot weather.
शिलाजित्: शिलाजित् f. (-जित्) Bitumen. E. शिला a stone, and जित् what conquers or excels.
शिलाटक: शिलाटक m. (-कः) 1 A room on the top of a house. 2 A hole. 3 A fence, an enclosure. E. शिला a stone, अट to go, वुन् aff.
शिलातल: शिलातल n. (-लं) The surface of a rock or stone. E. शिला, and तल below.
शिलात्मज: शिलात्मज n. (-जं) Iron. E. शिला a stone, आत्मन् self, and ज born.
शिलात्मिका: शिलात्मिका f. (-का) A crucible. E. शिला a stone, आत्मन् substance, कन् aff. fem. form.
शिलादद्रु: शिलादद्रु m. (-द्रुः) Bitumen. E. शिला a stone, and दद्रु herpes.
शिलाधातु: शिलाधातु m. (-तुः) 1 Chalk. 2 Red chalk. 3 A white fossile substance; an aluminous earth of a white colour, and thence considered to be a sort of chalk. E. शिला a stone or rock, and धातु a mineral.
शिलापट्ट: शिलापट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A flat stone for grinding condiments, &c. E. शिला a stone, and पट्ट a flat surface.
शिलापुत्त्र: शिलापुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) A mullar or roller for grinding condiments, &c. on a flat stone. E. शिला a flat stone, and पुत्त्र child; also शिलापुत्त्रक.
शिलापुष्प: शिलापुष्प n. (-ष्पं) Storax or Benzoin. E. शिला a rock, and पुष्प flower.
शिलाफलक: शिलाफलक n. (-कं) A layer or table of rock or stone. E. शिला, फलक a plank.
शिलाभव: शिलाभव n. (-वं) Storax or Benzoin. E. शिला a rock, and भव born.
शिलाभेद: शिलाभेद m. (-दः) 1 A plant, (Plectranthus scutellaroides.) 2 A stone cutter's chisel. E. शिला a stone, and भेद what breaks.
शिलामय: शिलामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Made of stone. E. शिला, and मयट् aff.
शिलारस: शिलारस m. (-सः) Incense, Benjaminor Olibanum. E. शिला a stone, and रस juice.
शिलावल्का: शिलावल्का f. (-ल्का) A medicinal substance said to be of cooling and lithonthriptic properties, commonly termed Silābāk; a sort of lichen or moss. E. शिला a stone or rock, and वल्क bark; also termed शिलावल्कल, शिलात्वच्.
शिलावृष्टि: शिलावृष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Hail. E. शिला, and वृष्टि rain.
शिलाव्याधि: शिलाव्याधि m. (-धिः) Bitumen. E. शिला a rock or stone, and व्याधि sickness.
शिलासन: शिलासन n. (-नं) 1 Benzoin or Storax. 2 A stone bench or seat. E. शिला a stone or rock, and असन abiding or आसन a seat.
शिलासार: शिलासार n. (-रं) Iron. E. शिला a stone, and सार essence.
शिलि: शिलि f. (-लिः-ली) The lower timber of a door. m. (-लिः) The Bhojpatra or birch tree. E. शिल to glean, इन् aff.: see शिल and शिला, &c.
शिलीन्ध्र: शिलीन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) 1 The flower of the plaintain tree. 2 Hail. 3 A mushroom. m. (-न्ध्रः) 1 A sort of tree. 2 A kind of fish; also चित्रफलक. f. (-न्ध्री) 1 Earth, clay. 2 A small earth worm. 3 A sort of bird.
शिलीन्ध्रक: शिलीन्ध्रक n. (-कं) A mushroom, one growing out of cowdung, a fungus. E. कन् added to the preceding.
शिलीपद: शिलीपद m. (-दः) Enlarged or Tropical leg; also श्लीपद.
शिलीमुख: शिलीमुख m. (-खः) 1 A bee. 2 An arrow. 3 A fool, a blockhead. 4 War. E. शिली a dart, (a sting,) and मुख the face.
शिलेय: शिलेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Like a stone or rock, as hard, &c. n. (-यं) Storax. E. शिला a rock, ढक् aff. and the vowel unchanged.
शिलोच्चय: शिलोच्चय m. (-यः) 1 A mountain. 2 A high mountain. E. शिला a stone or rock, उत् up, चि to collect, अच् aff.
शिलोञ्छ: शिलोञ्छ m. (-च्छः) 1 Following more than one occupation. 2 Gleaning. E. शिला gleaning, उच्छ to gather or glean, aff. अच्; gleaning a subsistence.
शिलोञ्छवृत्ति: शिलोञ्छवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) 1 Livelihood gained by gleaning. 2 Extraordinary occupation. E. शिलोञ्छ, and वृति subsistence.
शिलोत्थ: शिलोत्थ mfn. (-त्थः-त्था-त्थं) Growing from or upon rock or stone. n. (-त्यं) Benzoin or Storax. E. शिला a stone, and उत्थ what grows.
शिलोद्भव: शिलोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Produced from stone or rock. n. (-वं) 1 A superior sort of Sandal wood, either the white or brass coloured sort. 2 Storax or Benzoin. E. शिला a stone or rock, and उद्भव produced.
शिलौकस्: शिलौकस् m. (-काः) GARUḌA. E. शिला a rock, and ओकस् abode.
शिल्प: शिल्प n. (-ल्पं) 1 An art, any manual or mechanical art. 2 A sort of spoon or ladle, used at sacrifices to throw the Ghee or butter into the fire. E. शिल to be clever or skilled, प Uṇādi aff., and the vowel made short.
शिल्पक: शिल्पक n. (-कं) A sort of drama: one exhibiting magical and mystical rites. E. शिल्प manual art, and कन् aff.; also read शिल्पिकं.
शिल्पकर्मन्: शिल्पकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Manual labour, handicraft. E. शिल्प, and कर्म्मन् act; also शिल्पक्रिया, &c.
शिल्पकर्म्मन्: शिल्पकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) Manual labour, handicraft. E. शिल्प, and कर्म्मन् act; also शिल्पक्रिया, &c.
शिल्पकार: शिल्पकार m. (-रः) An artisan, a mechanic. E. शिल्प a handicraft, and कार who makes.
शिल्पविद्या: शिल्पविद्या f. (-द्या) Art, mechanical or manual skill. E. शिल्प, and विद्या knowledge.
शिल्पशाल: शिल्पशाल nf. (-लं-ला) A work-shop, a manufactory. E. शिल्प art. and शाला a hall.
शिल्पिक: शिल्पिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Manual, mechanic. n. (-कं) 1 Handicraft. 2 A sort of drama; see शिल्पक. E. शिल्प, and ठक् aff.
शिल्पिन्: शिल्पिन् mfn. (-ल्पी-ल्पिनी-ल्पि) 1 An artist, an artificer or artisan. 2 Belonging or relating to a mechanical profession or art. f. (-ल्पिनी) A drug or herb, a kind of grass said to be known by the name of Lahānasipi, and described as sweet and cooling, and bearing seeds of tonic and restorative properties; also शिल्पिका, &c. E. शिल्प art, and इनि aff.
शिल्पिशाल: शिल्पिशाल nf. (-लं-ला) A work-shop, a manufactory. E. शिल्पि an artisan, and शाला a hall.
शिल्पिशास्त्र: शिल्पिशास्त्र n. (-स्त्रं) A treatise or set of treatises on works of art. E. शिल्पि an artist, and शास्त्र book.
शिव: शिव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Prosperous, happy. m. (-वः) 1 The deity ŚIVA, the most formidable of the Hindu triad, the destroyer of creation: the adoration of which he is the object, is of a more gloomy nature in general than that of the rest, and he is the particular god of the Tāntrikas or followers of the books called Tantras. 2 Final emancipation from existence, eternal happiness. 3 A pillar or post to which cattle are tied. 4 An auspicious planetary conjunction. 5 Scripture, the Vedas. 6 A drug, commonly Elavāluka. 7 A perfume, Puṇḍarīya. 8 Bdellium. 9 One of the astronomical periods termed Yogas. 10 Quicksilver. 11 The penis. 12 The phallic emblem of ŚIVA. n. (-वं) 1 Happiness, pleasure. 2 Auspiciousness, well being. 3 Water. 4 Sea or fossile salt. 5 Borax. f. (-वा) 1 The goddess DURGĀ, the wife of ŚIVA. 2 The Śami tree, (Mimosa suma, Rox.) 3 Yellow myrobalan, (Terminalia chebula.) 4 Emblic myrobalan. 5 A shakal. 6 The mother of the twenty-second Jina. E. शी to sleep, Uṇādi aff. वन्, on or in whom or which, the universe reposes.
शिवक: शिवक m. (-कः) A post to which cows or calves are tied. E. शिव the same, कन् aff.
शिवकर: शिवकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Propitious, auspicious, making happy. m. (-रः) A Jina of the last age. E. शिव good fortune, and कर who makes.
शिवकीर्तन: शिवकीर्त्तन m. (-नः) 1 An attendant on ŚIVA. 2 KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. n. (-नं) Praising or hymning ŚIVA. E. शिव ŚIVA, and कीर्त्तन celebrating.
शिवकीर्त्तन: शिवकीर्त्तन m. (-नः) 1 An attendant on ŚIVA. 2 KṚṢṆA or VIṢṆU. n. (-नं) Praising or hymning ŚIVA. E. शिव ŚIVA, and कीर्त्तन celebrating.
शिवगति: शिवगति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 1 Happy, prosperous. 2 Worshipping ŚIVA. m. (-तिः) One of the Jinas of the past age. E. शिव auspiciousness, and गति going.
शिवघर्मज: शिवघर्म्मज m. (-जः) The planet MARS. E. शिव ŚIVA, घर्म्म perspiration, and ज born.
शिवघर्म्मज: शिवघर्म्मज m. (-जः) The planet MARS. E. शिव ŚIVA, घर्म्म perspiration, and ज born.
शिवङ्कर: शिवङ्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Propitious, auspicious, conferring happiness or good fortune. E. शिव good fortune, कृ to make, aff. खच्.
शिवचतुर्दशी: शिवचतुर्दशी f. (-शी) A festival in honour of ŚIVA, on the fourteenth of the dark half of Māgha. E. शिव, and चतुर्दशी fourteenth.
शिवज्ञ: शिवज्ञ mfn. (-ज्ञः-ज्ञा-ज्ञं) 1 Knowing what is good or propitious. 2 Worshipping ŚIVA. f. (-ज्ञा) A female devotee of the Śaiva sect. E. शिव ŚIVA, and ज्ञा to know, अङ् and टाप् affs.
शिवताति: शिवताति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) Propitious, conferring happiness or fortune. E. शिव happiness, तातिल् aff.; also शिवतातिक.
शिवदत्त: शिवदत्त n. (-त्तं) The discus of VIṢṆU. E. शिव ŚIVA, and दत्त given.
शिवदारु: शिवदारु m. (-रुः) The Devadaru tree, (Pinus Deodar.)
शिवदूतिका: शिवदूतिका f. (-का) One of the Mātṛs or divine mothers. E. शिवटूती DURGĀ, and कन् aff.
शिवदूती: शिवदूती f. (-ती) DURGĀ. E. शिव ŚIVA, and टूती, from टूत a messenger, fem. aff. ङीष्.
शिवधातु: शिवधातु m. (-तुः) The milk stone, opal or chalcedony. E. शिव ŚIVA, and धातु a mineral.
शिवपुरी: शिवपुरी f. (-री) The holy city Benares. E. शिव, and पुरी the city; being sacred to ŚIVA especially.
शिवप्रिय: शिवप्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Dear to or esteemed by ŚIVA. m. (-यः) 1 The Sesbana grandiflora. 3 Crystal. f. (-या) The goddess DURGĀ. n. (-यं) The seeds of the Eleocarpus. E. शिव, and प्रिय beloved.
शिवमल्ली: शिवमल्ली f. (-ल्ली) The Sesbana grandiflora. E. शिव, and मल्ली jasmine.
शिवरस: शिवरस m. (-सः) The water of boiled rice or pulse three days old, and undergoing spontaneous fermentation. E. शिव ease, and रस juice.
शिवरात्रि: शिवरात्रि f. (-त्रिः) A celebrated festival in honour of ŚIVA on the fourteenth of the moon's wane or dark fortnight in Māgha. E. शिव, and रात्रि night.
शिववल्लभ: शिववल्लभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Loved or esteemed by ŚIVA. m. (-भः) 1 The mango tree. 2 Gigantic swallow wort. f. (-भा) The goddess PĀRVATĪ. E. शिव ŚIVA, and वल्लभ beloved.
शिववाहन: शिववाहन m. (-नः) A bull. E. शिव the deity, and वाहन vehicle.
शिववीज: शिववीज n. (-जं) Quicksilver. E. शिव ŚIVA, and वीज semen, its supposed origin.
शिवशेखर: शिवशेखर m. (-रः) 1 The Sesbana grandiflora. 2 The moon. E. शिव ŚIVA, and शेखर a crest.
शिवाक्ष: शिवाक्ष n. (-क्षं) The seed of the Eleocarpus. E. शिव ŚIVA, and अक्ष from अक्षि the eye.
शिवानी: शिवानी f. (-नी) 1 A flower, (Celtis orientalis.) 2 A name of DURGĀ. E. शिव the deity, ङीष् aff., and आनुक् augment.
शिवाप्रिय: शिवाप्रिय m. (-यः) A goat. E. शिवा DURGA, and प्रिय beloved by.
शिवाराति: शिवाराति m. (-तिः) A dog. E. शिवा a shakal, and अराति an enemy.
शिवालय: शिवालय m. (-यः) Red Tulasī or basil. n. (-यं) 1 A cemetery or place where dead bodies are burnt or buried. 2 Any temple dedicated to ŚIVA. E. शिव ŚIVA, and आलय abode.
शिवि: शिवि m. (-विः) 1 A beast of prey. 2 The Bhojpatra or birch tree. 3 A king so named.
शिविका: शिविका f. (-का) A palanquin, a litter. E. शिव nominal verb, to give pleasure or ease, aff. ण्वुल्.
शिविपिष्ट: शिविपिष्ट m. (-ष्टः) A name of ŚIVA: see शिपिविष्ट.
शिविर: शिविर n. (-रं) 1 A camp. 2 A royal camp or residence. 3 A guard or defence for the soldiers. 4 A sort of grain. E. शी to sleep or rest, किरच् Uṇādi aff. and वुक् augment.
शिवीरथ: शिवीरथ m. (-थः) A palanquin, a litter. E. शिवी for शिविका the same, and रथ a conveyance.
शिशयिषा: शिशयिषा f. (-षा) Drowsiness, sleepiness, wish to sleep. E. शी to sleep, desid. v., अङ् and टाप् aff.
शिशयिषु: शिशयिषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Sleepy, drowsy. E. शी to sleep, desid. v., उ aff.
शिशिर: शिशिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Cold, frigid, chilly, freezing. m. (-रः) Frost. mn. (-रः-रं) The cold season, comprising two months from about the middle of January to that of March. E. शश to go, (the sun, north of the equator,) किरच् Uṇādi aff. and the radical vowel changed to इ.
शिशिरकाल: शिशिरकाल n. (-लं) The dewy season; see the last. E. शिशिर, and काल time.
शिशु: शिशु m. (-शुः) 1 The young of man or any animal, a child, a calf, a pup, &c. 2 A pupil, a scholar. 3 A boy under eight years of age. 4 A lad, or boy not more than sixteen. E. शो to destroy, Uṇādi aff. उ, and the root repeated, with इ substituted for the semivowel to which the radical vowel is changed in its inflections.
शिशुक: शिशुक m. (-कः) 1 A porpoise. 2 Another fish, resembling a porpoise. 3 A child, a young animal. 4 A tree. E. कन् added to the last.
शिशुक्रन्द: शिशुक्रन्द m. (-न्दः) The weeping of an infant or child. E. शिशु a child, and क्रन्द weeping; also शिशुक्रन्दन n. (-नं).
शिशुक्रन्दीय: शिशुक्रन्दीय m. (-यः) A book or work treating of infantine or juvenile grievances. E. शिशुक्रन्द as above, and छ aff. in this sense.
शिशुत्व: शिशुत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Boyhood, pupilage, the period before sixteen. 2 Childhood, the period up to eight years of age. E. शिशु a child, त्व abstract aff.; also with तल् aff. शिशुता.
शिशुपाल: शिशुपाल m. (-लः) The sovereign of a country in the central part of India or Cedi, opposed to KṚṢṆA and slain by him: his death forms the subject of one of the Hindu epic poems, thence named Śiśupāla Badha, by MĀGHA. E. शिशु a child, and पाल who cherishes.
शिशुपालक: शिशुपालक m. (-कः) 1 A king: see the last. 2 A plant, (Nauclea cordifolia.) E. शिशु a child, पाल who or what pleases or cherishes, aff. कन्.
शिशुपालहन्: शिशुपालहन् m. (-हा) KṚṢṆA. E. शिशुपाल the king so named, and हन् destroyer.
शिशुमार: शिशुमार m. (-रः) 1 The gangetic porpoise, (Delphinus gangeticus.) 2 The heavenly porpoise, or collection of the stars and planets. 3 A name or form of VIṢṆU. E. शिशु a child, and मार what kills.
शिशुवाहक: शिशुवाहक m. (-कः) A wild goat. E. शिशु a child, वह to bear, aff. ण्वुल्.
शिशुवाह्यक: शिशुवाह्यक m. (-कः) A wild goat. E. शिशु a child, वह to bear, ण्यत् aff., and कन् added.
शिश्न: शिश्न m. (-श्नः) The penis. E. शश to move, aff. नक्, form irr.
शिश्विदान: शिश्विदान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Innocent, virtuous. 2 Guilty, sinful, wicked. E. श्वित to be white, (pure or virtuous,) आनच् Uṇādi aff., त changed to द, and the reduplicate form of the root.
शिष: शिष r. 1st cl. (शेषति) To hurt, to injure or kill. r. 1st and 10th cls. (शेषति शेषयति) 1 To leave a residue, not to use the whole. 2 (usually with षि prefixed,) To excel. (ऌ and with षि prefixed) विशिष्टृ r. 7th cl. (विषिनष्टि) To assign attributes or qualities to, to distinguish, to individualize, to specify.
शिष्ट: शिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Obedient, docile. 2 Ordered, commanded, disciplined, trained. 3 Chief, principal, eminent, select. 4 Left, remaining. m. (-ष्टः) 1 A courtier, a counsellor. 2 A chief. E. शास to order, aff. क्त, form irr., or शिष to leave, क्त aff.
शिष्टता: शिष्टता f. (-ता) 1 Good behaviour, urbanity, civility. 2 Docility. 3 The property of being left or remaining. E. शिष्टि, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शिष्टित्व.
शिष्टसभा: शिष्टसभा f. (-भा) A council of state, an assembly of chief officers. E. शिष्ट, and सभा an assembly.
शिष्टसभाचार: शिष्टसभाचार m. (-रः) History or tradition of eminent persons. E. शिष्ट, and सभाचार account.
शिष्टाचार: शिष्टाचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Well-behaved. m. (-रः) Good manners, proper behaviour. E. शिष्ट, and आचार observance.
शिष्टि: शिष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) 1 An order or command. 2 Ruling, commanding. 3 Correcting, keeping in order. 4 Personal correction or chastisement. E. शास to order, aff. क्तिन्, form irr.
शिष्ट्वा: शिष्ट्वा ind. 1 Having confessed publicly, or proclaimed. 2 Having governed, regulated, trained, &c. E. शास to rule or शिष to hurt, क्त्वा aff.
शिष्य: शिष्य (-ष्यः) 1 A pupil, a scholar. 2 Passion, anger. 3 Violence. E. शास to order, aff. क्यप्, and the vowel changed to इ.
शिष्यशिष्टि: शिष्यशिष्टि f. (-ष्टिः) Chastisement or correction of a pupil. E. शिष्य, and शिष्टि correction.
शिह्ल: शिह्ल m. (-ह्लः) Incense, benjamin or olibanum. E. ष्णिह to melt, लक् aff.; deriv. irr.; more usually सिह्ल, also with कन् added, शिह्लक.
शी: शी (ङ) शीङ् r. 2nd cl. (शेते) To sleep: with अति prefixed, to be profuse or copious, to be much or more, to exceed: with अधि to abide, to be; with सम् to doubt.
शी f. (शीः) 1 Sleep, repose. 2 Devotion, tranquillity, indifference to every thing but the object of worship. E. शी to sleep, aff. क्विप्.
शीक: शीक r. 1st cl. (ऋ) शीकृ (शेकते) To wet or moisten, to sprinkle. r. 10th cl. (शेकयति) 1 To endure patiently, to be patient. 2 To touch. 3 To wet, to moisten.
शीकर: शीकर m. (-रः) 1 Thin rain, or rain driven by wind. 2 A drop of water. n. (-रं) A sort of pine or its resin. E. शीक to sprinkle, aff. अरन्.
शीकरौघ: शीकरौघ mfn. (-घः-घा-घं) Abounding with mist, spray or thin rain. E. शीकर, and ओघ a heap.
शीघ्र: शीघ्र mfn. (-घ्रः-घ्रा-घ्रं) Quick, speedy. m. (-घ्रः) (In astronomy,) Parallax. n. adv. (-घ्रं) Quickly, swiftly. E. शिघ to smell, रक् aff. deriv. irr.
शीघ्रग: शीघ्रग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) Going quick. E. शीघ्र, and ग who goes.
शीघ्रगामिन्: शीघ्रगामिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) Going quick or expeditiously. E. शीघ्र quickly, and गामिन् who goes.
शीघ्रचेतन: शीघ्रचेतन m. (-नः) A dog. E. शीघ्र quickly, चेतन thinking, knowing.
शीघ्रजन्मन्: शीघ्रजन्मन् m. (-न्मा) A plant, (Cæsalpinia bonduccella.) E. शीघ्र quick, जन्मन् birth.
शीघ्रता: शीघ्रता f. (-ता) Quickness, speed. E. शीघ्र, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शीघ्रत्वं.
शीघ्रवेधिन्: शीघ्रवेधिन् m. (-घी) A good archer, a good shot. E. शीघ्र quick, and वेधिन् who pierces.
शीघ्रायमाण: शीघ्रायमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Becoming quick or expeditious. E. शीघ्र nominal verb to be quick, शानच् aff.
शीघ्रिय: शीघ्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Quick, fleet. m. (-यः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 The fighting of cats. E. शीघ्र quick, and घ aff.
शीत: शीत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cold, chilly, frigid. 2 Idle, lazy. 3 Cold, dull, apathetic, stupid. 4 Decocted, boiled. n. (-तं) 1 Cold, coldness. 2 Water. 3 Cold weather or the six months of the rainy, dewy and cold seasons. m. (-तः) A small tree, (Cordia myxa.) 2 A kind of ratan, (Calamus fasciculatus.) 3 A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.) 4 The Nīmb tree. 5 Camphor. f. (-ता) 1 The wife of RĀMA. 2 A furrow. E. श्यै to go, aff. क्त, the fem. form more usually occurs सीता, q. v.
शीतक: शीतक m. (-कः) 1 Cold weather or the cold season, winter. 2 A lazy man, one who is dilatory or dull. 3 One devoid of care or anxiety, a happy man. 4 A plant, (Marsilea dentata.) 5 A scorpion. E. क added to the preceding.
शीतकाल: शीतकाल n. (-लं) Cold weather, winter. E. शीत, and काल time.
शीतकालीन: शीतकालीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Produced in winter. E. शीतकाल, and ख aff.
शीतकृच्छ्र: शीतकृच्छ्र m. (-च्छ्रः) A religious penance, drinking cold water three days, cold milk three days, cold Ghee three days, and fasting three. E. शीत cold, and कृच्छ्र penance.
शीतकुम्भ: शीतकुम्भ m. (-म्भः) A flower, (Nerium odorum.) f. (-म्भा) An aquatic plant. E. शीत cold, कुम्भ a water-pot.
शीतक्षार: शीतक्षार n. (-रं) Refined Borax. E. शीत cold, and क्षार nitre.
शीतगन्ध: शीतगन्ध n. (-न्धं) White Sandal. E. शीत cold, and गन्ध smell.
शीतगु: शीतगु m. (-गुः) The moon. E. शीत cold, and गु neut. form of गो a ray of light, here forming a masc. compound.
शीतचम्पक: शीतचम्पक m. (-कः) 1 A lamp. 2 Pleasing, satisfying. 3 A mirror. E. शीत cold, cool, and चम्पक a flower.
शीतता: शीतता f. (-ता) Cold, coldness. E. शीत, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शीतत्वं.
शीतपर्णी: शीतपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A plant, (Cleome pentaphylla.) E. शीत cool, पर्ण a leaf.
शीतपल्लव: शीतपल्लव m. (-वः) A plant, (Ardisea solanacea.) E. शीत cool, and पल्लव a shoot.
शीतपाकिनी: शीतपाकिनी f. (-नी) A medicinal root, commonly Kākoli. E. शीत the cold (in a cold climate), पाक ripening, and इनि aff.
शीतपाकी: शीतपाकी f. (-की) 1 A medicinal root, commonly Kākoli. 2 A plant, (Sida cordifolia.) E. शीत cold, (in cold weather, &c.) पाक a ripening, ङीप् fem. aff.
शीतपुष्प: शीतपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) The Sirisha tree. n. (-ष्पं) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. शीत cold, (in the cold weather, &c.) and पुष्प a flower.
शीतपुष्पक: शीतपुष्पक n. (-कं) Storax or Benzoin. E. शीत cold (in the snowy mountains), पुष्प a flower, कन् aff.
शीतप्रभ: शीतप्रभ m. (-भः) Camphor. E. शीत cool, and प्रभ shining.
शीतभानु: शीतभानु m. (-नुः) The moon. E. शीत cool, and भानु the sun.
शीतभीरु: शीतभीरु f. (-रुः) Arabian jasmine, (Jasminum zambac.) E. शीत the cold, and भीरु afraid.
शीतभोजिन्: शीतभोजिन् mfn. (-जी-जिनी-जि) Eating cold viands. E. शीत, भुज to eat, णिनि aff.
शीतमयूख: शीतमयूख m. (-खः) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. E. शीत cool, मयूख a ray of light.
शीतमरीचि: शीतमरीचि m. (-चिः) The moon. E. शीत cool, मरीचि a ray.
शीतमूलक: शीतमूलक n. (-कं) The root of the Andropogon muricatum. E. शीत cool, and मूलक a root.
शीतरम्य: शीतरम्य m. (-म्यः) A lamp. E. शीत cool, and रम्य agreeable.
शीतरुच्: शीतरुच् m. (-रुक्) The moon. E. शीत, and रुच् light.
शीतल: शीतल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Cold, chilly, frigid. n. (-लं) 1 Green vitriol. 2 Storax. 3 Sandal. 4 White Sandal. 5 A lotus. 6 A pearl. 7 Cold, coldness. 8 The root of the Andropogon muricatum. m. (-लः) 1 A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.) 2 A Jina or Jaina teacher, the 10th of the twenty-four Tīrthakaras. 3 A religious ceremony observed upon the sun's entering Aries. 4 The moon. 5 A small tree, (Cordia myxa.) 6 The Champaca, (Michelia champaca.) 7 A sort of camphor. 8 Turpentine. f. (-ला-ली) 1 A plant, perhaps intending the Phrynium dichotymum, from the split stems of which a smooth, cool mat is made, thence termed Sitalpāti. 2 Small-pox. 3 The goddess presiding over or inflicting small-pox. E. शीत cool, लच् poss. aff., or ला to give or get, aff. क.
शीतलता: शीतलता f. (-ता) Coldness, coolness. E. शीतल, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शीतलत्वं.
शीतलप्रद: शीतलप्रद m. (-दः) Sandal. E. शीतल cold, and प्रद who gives.
शीतलवात: शीतलवात m. (-तः) A cool wind. E. शीतल, and वात wind.
शीतलवातक: शीतलवातक m. (-कः) A plant, (Marsilea quadrifolia.) E. शीतल cool, वात wind, कन् added.
शीतलषष्ठी: शीतलषष्ठी f. (-ष्ठी) The sixth of the light half of Māgha, when only cold food is eaten. E. शीतल, and षष्ठी sixth.
शीतशिव: शीतशिव n. (-वं) 1 A sort of resin, (Storax benzoin.) 2 Rock salt. m. (-वः) 1 A kind of fennel, (Anethum sowa.) 2 The Śami tree, (Mimosa suma, Rox.) E. शीत cool, and शिव auspicious.
शीतशूक: शीतशूक m. (-कः) Barley. E. शीत cold, and शूक an awn or beard.
शीतसह: शीतसह mfn. (-हः-हा-हं) Bearing or enduring cold. m. (-हः) A Pīlu, or tree so named, growing in the Himāla mountains. E. शीत cold, and सह enduring.
शीतहर: शीतहर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Removing cold. E. शीत, and हर what takes.
शीतांशु: शीतांशु m. (-शुः) 1 Camphor. 2 The moon. E. शीत cold, अंशु a ray.
शीताकुल: शीताकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Benumbed, frozen. E. शीत, and आकुल perplexed.
शीताद: शीताद m. (-दः) Scorbutic affection of the gums. E. शीत, and अद what eats.
शीताद्रि: शीताद्रि m. (-द्रिः) The snowy mountains. E. शीत cold, and अद्रि a mountain.
शीतार्त: शीतार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Cold, chilled, shivering, suffering or shrinking from cold. E. शीत cold, and आर्त्त pained.
शीतार्त्त: शीतार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Cold, chilled, shivering, suffering or shrinking from cold. E. शीत cold, and आर्त्त pained.
शीतालु: शीतालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) Cold, shivering, shrinking from cold. E. शीत cold, आलुच् aff., here implying aversion or impatience.
शीताश्मन्: शीताश्मन् m. (-श्मा) The moon gem, crystal. E. शीत cold, अश्मन् a stone.
शीतीभाव: शीतीभाव m. (-वः) 1 Final emancipation. 2 Coolness, composure. 3 Cold, coldness. E. शीत cold, भाव nature, च्चि augment.
शीतोत्तम: शीतोत्तम n. (-मं) Water. E. शीत cold, उत्तम best.
शीत्य: शीत्य mfn. (-त्यः-त्या-त्यं) 1 Ploughed, tilled: more usually सीत्य. 2 To be cooled or chilled. E. शीत cold, or शीता a furrow, यत् aff.
शीत्कार: शीत्कार m. (-रः) Uttering a sound expressive of pleasurable sensations. E. शीत् imitative sound, and कार making; also with कृत made, uttered, शीत्कृत n. (-तं).
शीधु: शीधु mn. (-धुः-घु) Rum, distilled from molasses. E. शी to sleep, or rest, Uṇādi aff. धक्.
शीधुगन्ध: शीधुगन्ध m. (-न्धः) A plant, (Mimusops elengi.) E. शीधु rum, and गन्ध smell.
शीधुप: शीधुप mf. (-पः-पी) A drinker of spirits, a dram-drinker. E. शीधु spirits, and पा to drink, aff. टक्.
शीन: शीन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Thick, congealed, (as oil or butter.) m. (-नः) 1 A fool, a blockhead. 2 A large snake. E. श्यै to go, aff. क्त.
शीफालिका: शीफालिका f. (-का) A flower, (Nyctanthes tristis:) see शेफालिका.
शीभ: शीभ (ऋ) शीभृ r. 10th cl. (शीभते) 1 To praise, to flatter. 2 To boast.
शीभ्य: शीभ्य m. (-भ्यः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A bull. E. शीभ to praise, यत् aff.
शीयमान: शीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Going away, dissipating, dispersing, departing. E. शद to go, शानच् aff., शीय substituted for the radical letters.
शीर: शीर m. (-रः) A large snake, (Boa constrictor.) E. शी to sleep, रक् Uṇādi aff.
शीर्ण: शीर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं.) 1 Thin, small, slender. 2 Wasted, withered, decayed. E. शॄ to injure, aff. क्त, form irr.
शीर्णता: शीर्णता f. (-ता) Emaciation, withering. E. शीर्ण, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शीर्णत्वं.
शीर्णनाला: शीर्णनाला f. (-ला) A plant, (Hemionites cordifolia.) E. शीर्ण shrivelled or slender, नाल stem.
शीर्णपत्र: शीर्णपत्र m. (-त्रः) A tree, (Pterospermum acerifolium.) E. शीर्ण withered, and पत्र a leaf.
शीर्णपाद: शीर्णपाद m. (-दः) YAMA, the deity of Tartarus. E. शीर्ण shrivelled, and पाद a foot.
शीर्णपुष्पिका: शीर्णपुष्पिका f. (-का) A kind of fennel, (Anethum sowa.) E. शीर्ण shrunk, पुष्प a flower, कन् aff., fem. form.
शीर्णवृन्त: शीर्णवृन्त n. (-न्तं) A water-melon. E. शीर्ण slender, and वृन्त footstalk.
शीर्णाङ्घ्रि: शीर्णाङ्घ्रि m. (-ङ्घ्रिः) YAMA, judge of the dead. E. शीर्ण shrivelled, and अङ्घ्रि a foot: being shrunk up in consequence of a curse of his mother's.
शीर्वि: शीर्व्वि mfn. (-र्व्विः-र्व्विः-र्व्वि) Mischievous, malignant, hurtful, savage. E. शॄ to injure, क्विन् Uṇādi aff.
शीर्व्वि: शीर्व्वि mfn. (-र्व्विः-र्व्विः-र्व्वि) Mischievous, malignant, hurtful, savage. E. शॄ to injure, क्विन् Uṇādi aff.
शीर्ष: शीर्ष n. (-र्षं) The head. E. see शिरस्, for which it is substituted.
शीर्षक: शीर्षक n. (-कं) 1 A helmet. 2 The skull. 3 Judgment, award, sentence, the fruit or result of judicial investigation. m. (-कः) Rāhu, the personified ascending node. E. कन् added to the last.
शीर्षकस्थ: शीर्षकस्थ mfn. (-स्थः-स्था-स्थं) 1 Staying in or on the head. 2 Abiding by an award, agreeing to submit to the penalty imposed by it. E. शीर्षक, and स्थ who stays.
शीर्षघातिन्: शीर्षघातिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) 1 Beheading, decapitating. 2 Striking or injuring the head. E. शीर्ष the head, हन to strike, aff. णिनि.
शीर्षच्छेद: शीर्षछेद m. (-दः) Decapitating. E. शीर्ष, and छेद cutting; also शीर्षछेदन.
शीर्षछेद: शीर्षछेद m. (-दः) Decapitating. E. शीर्ष, and छेद cutting; also शीर्षछेदन.
शीर्षच्छेदक: शीर्षछेदक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Meriting decapitation. E. शीर्ष the head, and छेद cutting, aff. ठक्.
शीर्षछेदक: शीर्षछेदक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Meriting decapitation. E. शीर्ष the head, and छेद cutting, aff. ठक्.
शीर्षच्छेदिन्: शीर्षछेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Who or what decapitates. E. शीर्ष, and छेदिन् who cuts.
शीर्षछेदिन्: शीर्षछेदिन् mfn. (-दी-दिनी-दि) Who or what decapitates. E. शीर्ष, and छेदिन् who cuts.
शीर्षच्छेद्य: शीर्षछेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Meriting death by decapitation. E. शीर्ष the head, छेद्य to be cut off.
शीर्षछेद्य: शीर्षछेद्य mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं) Meriting death by decapitation. E. शीर्ष the head, छेद्य to be cut off.
शीर्षण्य: शीर्षण्य n. (-ण्यं) A helmet. m. (-ण्यः) Clean and unentangled hair. E. शीर्षन् substituted for शिरस्, and यत् aff.
शीर्षरक्ष: शीर्षरक्ष n. (-क्षं) A helmet. E. शीर्ष the head, and रक्ष preserving.
शील: शील r. 1st cl. (शीलति) 1 To meditate, to consider, to reflect profoundly and abstractedly. 2 To worship, to adore. r. 1st and 10th cls. (शीलति शीलयति) To practise, to exercise, (as the memory, &c.) to repeat. r. 10th cl. (शीलयति) 1 To wear. 2 To have or be endowed with.

शील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Possessed of, endowed with, practising, versed in, &c. 2 Behaving, conducted. 3 Well-behaved, well-disposed. mn. (-लः-लं) 1 Nature, quality. 2 Disposition, inclination. 3 Good conduct or disposition, steady and uniform observance of law and morals. 4 Beauty. m. (-लः) A large snake. E. शील to meditate, to learn, &c., aff. घञ्; or शी to sleep, and लक् Uṇādi aff.
शीलत्व: शीलत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Disposition, quality. 2 Conversancy. E. शील, and त्व added; also with तल्, शीलता.
शीलन: शीलन n. (-नं) Careful study of the Śāstras or sacred writings. E. शील to meditate, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
शीलवत्: शीलवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Of a good or amiable disposition. E. शील good conduct, मतुप् poss. aff.
शीलवृत्त: शीलवृत्त mfn. (-त्तः-त्ता-त्तं) Moral, steady, and uniform in good behaviour. E. शील, and वृत्त practice.
शीलसम्पन्न: शीलसम्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Well-conducted, of proper conduct or disposition. E. शील, and सम्पन्न abounding with.
शीलित: शीलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Skilled, learned, conversant, exercised. 2 Having, endowed with. 3 Made or consisting of. E. शील to learn, &c., aff. क्त.
शीवन्: शीवन् m. (-वा) A large snake, the Boa. E. शी to sleep, क्वनिप् Uṇādi aff.
शीवल: शीवल n. (-लं) 1 An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria.) 2 Benzoin or Storax. E. शी to sleep, (on the water,) वलच् aff., and the vowel unchanged; also शैवाल, &c.
शुंशुमार: शुंशुमार m. (-रः) A porpoise; more usually शिशुमार.
शु: शु ind. 1 Handsomely, brilliantly, elegantly. 2 Well, right. E. शुभ to be splendid, aff. ड.
शुक: शुक r. 1st cl. (शोकति) 1 To go. 2 To touch.

शुक m. (-कः) 1 A parrot. 2 The son of VYĀSA, the author or narrator of the Bhāgavata. 3 The minister of RĀVAṆA. 4 The Śirīṣa tree. 5 A plant, commonly Seyālkānta. n. (-कं) 1 A drug and perfume, commonly Ganṭhiāla. 2 Cloth, clothes. 3 The ends or hem of a cloth. 4 A turban, a helmet. 5 A plant,  (Bignonia Indica.) E. शुभ to shine, कक् Uṇādi aff., and the radical final rejected.
