शुकच्छद: शुकछद n. (-दं) A fragrant root, of which various kinds are said to be known. E. शुक a parrot, and च्छद a cover or wing.
शुकछद: शुकछद n. (-दं) A fragrant root, of which various kinds are said to be known. E. शुक a parrot, and च्छद a cover or wing.
शुकजिह्वा: शुकजिह्वा f. (-ह्वा) A plant, commonly Sūya Tonta or parrot's beak. E. शुक a parrot, and जिह्वा the tongue.
शुकतरु: शुकतरु m. (-रुः) The Śirīṣa, (Acacia Sirisha.) E. शुक the same, and तरु a tree.
शुकदेव: शुकदेव m. (-वः) The son of VYĀSA; see शुक. E. शुक, and देव divine.
शुकद्रुम: शुकद्रुम m. (-मः) The Śirīṣa tree: see the last.
शुकनामा: शुकनामा f. (-मा) A plant; see शुकजिह्वा.
शुकनास: शुकनास m. (-सः) 1 A tree, (Bignonia Indica.) 2 Another tree, Sesbana grandiflora.) E. शुक, and नास the nose, the flowers being compared to a parrot's beak.
शुकपितामह: शुकपितामह m. (-हः) The sage PARĀŚARA, father of VYĀSA, and grandfather of ŚUKA.
शुकपुच्छ: शुकपुच्छ m. (-च्छः) Sulphur. E. शुक a parrot, पुच्छ the tail; of similar colour.
शुकपुच्छक: शुकपुच्छक n. (-कं) A perfume and medicinal root, commonly Ganṭhiāla. E. शुक a parrot, पुच्छ the tail, कन् aff. of comparison.
शुकप्रिया: शुकप्रिया f. (-या) The rose-apple, (Eugenia jambu.) E. शुक a parrot, and प्रिया beloved.
शुकवर्ह: शुकवर्ह n. (-ह) Ganṭhiāla, a perfume. E. शुक a parrot, and वर्ह a tail.
शुकवल्लभ: शुकवल्लभ m. (-भः) The pomegranate. E. शुक a parrot, and वल्लभ beloved.
शुकवाह: शुकवाह m. (-हः) KĀMADEVA. E. शुक a parrot, and वाह who is borne.
शुकादन: शुकादन m. (-नः) The pomegranate. E. शुक a parrot, and अदन eating.
शुकानना: शुकानना f. (-ना) A plant, commonly Sūya Tonta. E. शुक a parrot, and आनन the face.
शुक्त: शुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Sour, acid. 2 Pure, clean. 3 Harsh, hard. n. (-क्तं) 1 Flesh. 2 Sour-gruel. 3 Vinegar, acid, or an acid preparation made from roots or fruits, by steeping them in oil and salt, drying them, and then leaving them in water, where they undergo the acetous fermentation: the fluid produce is used as vinegar. 4 Crabbed or harsh speech. 5 A hymn of the Vedas. f. (-क्ता) A sort of sorrel. E. शुच to be pure, &c., aff. क्त.
शुक्ति: शुक्ति f. (-क्तिः) 1 A pearl oyster. 2 A conch. 3 A small shell. 4 A cockle. 5 A sort of perfume, in appearance a dried shell fish. 6 A portion of the skull used as a cup, &c. 7 A curl or feather on a horse's neck or breast. 8 A weight of two Karṣas or half a Pala. A disease of the cornea, formation of specks on it. E. शुच् to sorrow, &c., aff. क्तिच्.
शुक्तिका: शुक्तिका f. (-का) 1 A pearl oyster. 2 A sort of dock or sorrel. E. शुक्ति as above, or शुक्त sour, कन् added, fem. form.
शुक्तिज: शुक्तिज n. (-जं) A pearl. E. शुक्ति the oyster, and ज born.
शुक्तिपुट: शुक्तिपुट n. (-टं) The pearl oyster shell. E. शुक्ति, and पुट a bag or sheathe
शुक्तिपेशी: शुक्तिपेशी f. (-शी) The envelope of the pearl or pearl oyster shell. E. शुक्ति, and पेशी a covering.
शुक्तिबधू: शुक्तिबधू f. (-धूः) Mother of pearl or the pearl oyster. E. शुक्ति, and बधू wife or female; in which the pearl, it is supposed, is bred.
शुक्तिमत्: शुक्तिमत् m. (-मान्) One of the seven principal mountains or mountainous ranges of India. E. शुक्ति a pearl oyster, and मतुप् aff.
शुक्तिवीज: शुक्तिवीज n. (-जं) A pearl. E. शुक्ति the oyster, and वीज a seed.
शुक्तिस्पर्श: शुक्तिस्पर्श m. (-र्शः) Dusky spots on a pearl, causing it to be of little value. E. शुक्ति a pearl, and स्पर्श contact.
शुक्र: शुक्र m. (-क्रः) 1 The planet VENUS or its regent, the son of BHṚGU, and preceptor of the Daityas or Titans. 2 A name of fire. 3 The month Jyeṣṭha, (April-May.) n. (-क्रं) 1 Semen virile. 2 A morbid affection of the iris, change of colour, ulceration, &c. accompanied by imperfect vision. E. शुच् to grieve, &c., Uṇādi aff. रन्, deriv. irr.
शुक्रकर: शुक्रकर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Producing semen, spermatic. m. (-रः) The marrow of the bones. E. शुक्र seed, and कर what makes.
शुक्रभुज्: शुक्रभुज् m. (-भुक्) A peacock. E. शुक्र semen, भुज to eat, aff. क्विप्.
शुक्रभू: शुक्रभू f. (-भूः) The marrow of the bones. E. शुक्र semen, and भू being.
शुक्रल: शुक्रल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Spermatic, augmenting the seminal secretion. f. (-ला) A fragrant grass, considered by some as a sort of Cyperus, and by others, Zedoary. E. शुक्र semen, and लच् aff., or ला to get or give, aff. क.
शुक्रवार: शुक्रवार m. (-रः) Friday. E. शुक्र ŚUKRA, the regent of VENUS, or the planet, and वार a day.
शुक्रिय: शुक्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Sacred to ŚUKRA, &c. E. शुक्र as above, and घन् aff.
शुक्रशिष्य: शुक्रशिष्य m. (-ष्यः) A demon, a Titan, a powerful being opposed to the gods. E. शुक्र the teacher of this race, and शिष्य a pupil.
शुक्राचार्य: शुक्राचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The regent of VENUS. E. शुक्र, and आचार्य्य teacher.
शुक्राचार्य्य: शुक्राचार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The regent of VENUS. E. शुक्र, and आचार्य्य teacher.
शुक्ल: शुक्ल mfn. (-क्लः-क्ला-क्लं) White, of a white colour. m. (-क्लः) 1 White, (the colour.) 2 One of the astronomical Yogas. n. (-क्लं) 1 Silver. 2 Fresh butter. 3 A disease of the cornea, opacity, albugo. m. (-क्लः) One half of a month: see शुक्लपक्ष. f. (-क्ला) 1 A name of SARASVATĪ. 2 Clayed or candied sugar. E. शुच to be pure, &c., Uṇādi aff. रन्, and र changed to ल.
शुक्लकण्ठक: शुक्लकण्ठक m. (-कः) A kind of gallinule or water-hen. E. शुक्ल white, कण्ठ the throat, and कन् aff.
शुक्लकर्मन्: शुक्लकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Innocent, virtuous. E. शुक्ल white, pure, and कर्म्मन् act.
शुक्लकर्म्मन्: शुक्लकर्म्मन् mfn. (-र्म्मा-र्म्मा-र्म्म) Innocent, virtuous. E. शुक्ल white, pure, and कर्म्मन् act.
शुक्लत्व: शुक्लत्व n. (-त्वं) Whiteness. E. शुक्ल white, and त्व aff.; also with तल् aff. शुक्लता.
शुक्लदुग्ध: शुक्लदुग्ध m. (-ग्धः) An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.) E. शुक्ल white, दुग्ध milk.
शुक्लधातु: शुक्लधातु m. (-तुः) Chalk. E. शुक्ल white, and धातु a mineral.
शुक्लपक्ष: शुक्लपक्ष m. (-क्षः) The light half of a month, the fifteen days of the moon's increase, or from new to full moon. E. शुक्ल white, and पक्ष part or fortnight.
शुक्लपुष्प: शुक्लपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) 1 The white variety of Amaranth, (Gomphrœna globosa.) 2 A species of jasmine, (Jasminum pubescens.) f. (-ष्पा) 1 A shrub, (Phrynium dichotomum.) 2 A sort of sun-flower. E. शुक्ल white, and पुष्प a flower.
शुक्लपृष्ठक: शुक्लपृष्ठक m. (-कः) A small tree, (Vitex nigundo.)
शुक्लबल: शुक्लबल m. (-लः) A name, common to nine persons peculiar to the Jainas. E. शुक्ल white, and बल a BALADEVA, there being nine white BALADEVAS, corresponding to the nine KṚṢṆAS, or black VĀSUDEVAS, according to the notions of this sect.
शुक्लमण्डल: शुक्लमण्डल n. (-लं) The white of the eye, the cornea. E. शुक्ल white, and मण्डल a circle.
शुक्लवर्ग: शुक्लवर्ग m. (-र्गः) 1 A class of white objects, or the conch, pearloyster, and cowrie, &c. E. शुक्ल white, and वर्ग a class.
शुक्लवायस: शुक्लवायस m. (-सः) A crane. E. शुक्ल white, and वायस a crow.
शुक्लाङ्ग: शुक्लाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Having a white body or limbs. m. (-ङ्गः) A peacock. E. शुक्ल white, and अङ्ग body.
शुक्लापाङ्ग: शुक्लापाङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A peacock. E. शुक्ल white, and अपाङ्ग the corner of the eye.
शुक्लिमन्: शुक्लिमन् m. (-मा) Whiteness. E. शुक्ल white, and इमनिच् aff.
शुक्लीकरण: शुक्लीकरण n. (-णं) Whitening, making white. E. शुक्ल, and करण making, च्चि aff.
शुक्लीकृत: शुक्लीकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Made white, whitened. E. शुक्ल, and कृत made, च्चि aff.
शुक्लोपला: शुक्लोपला f. (-ला) 1 Clayed or candied sugar. 2 Any white stone. E. शुक्ल white, and उपला a stone.
शुक्षि: शुक्षि m. (-क्षिः) Air, wind. E. शुष to dry up, Uṇādi aff. क्षि.
शुङ्ग: शुङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) 1 The Indian fig tree, (Ficus Indica.) 2 The hog plum, (Spondias mangifera.) f. (-ङ्गा) 1 The sheath or calyx of a young bud. 2 The waved leaf fig. 3 The awn of barley, &c. E. शम to rest or pacify, aff. गच्; form irr.
शुङ्गिन्: शुङ्गिन् m. (-ङ्गी) The Indian fig tree. E. शुङ्ग the calyx of the bud, and इनि aff.
शुच: शुच r. 1st cl. (शोचति) To regret, to grieve for. r. 4th cl. (ई इर) ईशुचिर (शुच्यति) 1 To be wet. 2 To be clean or pure. 3 To stink, to be fetid. 4 To wound.
शुच्: शुच् f. (शुक्) 1 Sorrow, grief, distress, regret. 2 Calamity, affliction. E. शुच to regret, aff. क्विप्; also with टाप् added, शुचा f. (-चा.)
शुचि: शुचि mfn. (-चिः-चिः-चि) 1 White. 2 Clean, cleansed, purified. 3 Pure, pious, exempt from passion or vice. 4 Correct, free from fault or error. m. (-चिः) 1 White, (the colour.) 2 Purification by ablution, &c. 3 Judicial acquittal. 4 Mental purity, virtue, goodness. 5 Accuracy, correctness. 6 The condition of the religious student. 7 A faithful and tried minister or friend. 8 The month Āṣārha, (June-July.) 9 The month Jyeṣṭha, (May-June.) 10 The hot season. 11 The passion or sentiment of love. 12 ŚIVA. 13 The sun. 14 The moon. 15 The planet VENUS, or its ruler. 16 A name of fire. 17 A Brahman. 18 Oblation to fire at the first feeding of an infant. E. शुच to purify, Uṇādi aff. इन्, and the vowel unchanged.
शुचित: शुचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Sad, lamenting. 2 Pure, clean, cleansed. E. शुच to grieve, क्त aff.
शुचिता: शुचिता f. (-ता) Purity, cleanness. E. शुचि, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शुचित्वं.
शुचिप्रणी: शुचिप्रणी f. (-णीः) Sipping water, rinsing the mouth, &c. E. शुचि purification, and प्रणी effecting.
शुचिमणि: शुचिमणि m. (-णिः) Crystal. E. शुचि white, and मणि a gem.
शुचिरोचिस्: शुचिरोचिस् m. (-चीः) The moon. E. शुचि white, and रोचिस् light.
शुचिव्रत: शुचिव्रत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Pious, virtuous. E. शुचि, and व्रत obligation.
शुचिस्मित: शुचिस्मित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Smiled, smiling sweetly, accompanied with a sweet smile. E. शुचि white, (from the teeth being shewn,) and स्मित smiled.
शुच्य: शुच्य (ई) शुच्यी r. 1st cl. (शुच्यति) 1 To bathe. 2 To distil. 3 To express or squeeze out. 4 To churn. 5 To pain or distress.
शुटीर्य: शुटीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Heroism, prowess. E. शौटीर a hero, यत् aff.: see the next.
शुटीर्य्य: शुटीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Heroism, prowess. E. शौटीर a hero, यत् aff.: see the next.
शुटीरता: शुटीरता f. (-ता) Valour, heroism. E. शौटीर a hero, तल् aff., and the diphthong changed to the short vowel.
शुठ: शुठ r. 1st and 10th cls. (शोठति शोठयति) also (इ) शुठि (शुण्ठतिशुण्ठयति) 1 To be prevented or obstructed. 2 To have any impediment to motion, to be lame, &c. 2 To be lazy, to be dull or slow. 4 To be or become dry or desiccated. 5 To dry, to desiccate.
शुण्ठि: शुण्ठि f. (-ण्ठिः-ण्ठी) Dry ginger. E. शुठि to be stopped, (by it, phlegm,) aff. अच्, and fem. aff. ङीप्, or in one case इन् aff.
शुण्ठ्य: शुण्ठ्य n. (-ण्ठ्यं) Dry ginger. E. शुठि to be stopped, (disease by it,) and यत् aff.
शुण्ड: शुण्ड m. (-ण्डः) The exudation from an elephant's temples. f. (-ण्डा) 1 A tavern. 2 Spirituous liquor. 3 An animal called the waterelephant, the hippopotamus perhaps. 4 An elephant's proboscis or trunk. 5 The stalk of the lotus. 6 A whore. 7 A bawd. E. शुण to go, aff. ड, fem. aff. टाप्.
शुण्डक: शुण्डक m. (-कः) 1 A distiller. 2 A military flute or fife(?) E. कन् added to the preceding.
शुण्डापान: शुण्डापान n. (-नं) A place where spirits are sold, a tavern, a dram shop. E. शुण्डा spirits, and पान drinking.
शुण्डार: शुण्डार m. (-रः) A distiller, a vintner. E. शुण्डा spirits, र aff.
शुण्डाल: शुण्डाल m. (-लः) An elephant. E. शुण्डा his trunk, लच् poss. aff.
शुण्डिका: शुण्डिका f. (-का) The soft palate. E. शुण्डा an elephant's proboscis, कन् fem. form.
शुण्डिन्: शुण्डिन् m. (-ण्डी) 1 A distiller, a preparer and vender of spirituous liquor. 2 An elephant. E. शुण्डा spirits, &c., इनि aff.
शुतुद्रि: शुतुद्रि f. (-द्रिः) The Śatadru river or Setlej; see शतद्रु.
शुद्ध: शुद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) 1 Pure, purified, clean, cleansed. 2 Faultless, correct. 3 Alone, only, mere, simple. 4 White. 5 Whetted, sharp, (as an arrow.) 6 Authorised, admitted. 7 Innocent. 8 Acquitted. n. (-द्धं) 1 Pure spirit. 2 Rock salt. E. शुध to be or make pure, &c., aff. क्त.
शुद्धकोटि: शुद्धकोटि f. (-टिः) One of the sides of a right-angled triangle. E. शुद्ध, and कोटि flank.
शुद्धजङ्घ: शुद्धजङ्घ m. (-ङ्घः) An ass. E. शुद्ध clean, pure, and जङ्घा the thigh or leg.
शुद्धत्व: शुद्धत्व n. (-त्वं) Purity, cleanness, freedom from soil or defect. E. त्व added to शुद्ध; also with तल्, शुद्धता.
शुद्धदत्: शुद्धदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) White-toothed, having handsome teeth. E. शुद्ध, and दत् for दन्त a tooth.
शुद्धधी: शुद्धधी mfn. (-धीः-धीः-धि) Of pure understanding. E. शुद्ध, and धी intellect.
शुद्धबध: शुद्धबध m. (-धः) Simple putting to death, i. e. in any ordinary way. E. शुद्ध, and बध putting to death.
शुद्धमति: शुद्धमति mfn. (-तिः-तिः-ति) 1 Of pure or sincere purposes, honest, free from guile. 2 Intelligent. m. (-तिः) One of the Jaina pontiffs of the last age. E. शुद्ध pure, मति understanding.
शुद्धवर्ण: शुद्धवर्ण mfn. (-र्णः-र्णा-र्णं) 1 Of a good colour, caste, &c. 2 Welllettered. E. शुद्ध, and वर्ण colour, &c.
शुद्धवल्लिका: शुद्धवल्लिका f. (-का) A plant, (Menispermum glabrum.) E. शुद्ध pure, वल्ली pedicle, कन् added, fem. form.
शुद्धवासस्: शुद्धवासस् mfn. (-साः-साः-सः) Clean, having clean vesture. E. शुद्ध, and वासस् clothes.
शुद्धानुमान: शुद्धानुमान n. (-नं) A figure of rhetoric. E. शुद्ध correct, and अनुमान inference.
शुद्धान्त: शुद्धान्त m. (-न्तः) 1 A seraglio, a Haram. 2 The private or women's apartments in the palace of a prince. 3 The king's wife or concubine. E. शुद्ध pure, and अन्त end, limit.
शुद्धान्तपालक: शुद्धान्तपालक m. (-कः) A eunuch or an attendant on the women's apartments. E. शुद्धान्त the Haram, and पालक a guard.
शुद्धान्तयुज्: शुद्धान्तयुज् f. (-युक्) Change of mode or key in music.
शुद्धापह्नुति: शुद्धापह्नुति f. (-तिः) A figure of rhetoric. E. शुद्ध correct, अपह्नुति concealment.
शुद्धि: शुद्धि f. (-द्धिः) 1 Cleaning, cleansing. 2 Purity, purification. 3 Correction, correctness. 4 Innocence established by ordeal or trial, acquittal. E. शुध to be or make pure, &c., aff. क्तिन.
शुद्धिभृत्: शुद्धिभृत् mfn. (-भृत्) 1 Clean, clear, free from soil. 2 Pure, virtuous. E. शुद्धि, and भृत् having.
शुद्धोदन: शुद्धोदन m. (-नः) King of KAPILA and father of ŚĀKYA. E. शुद्ध, and ओदन rice, food.
शुद्धोदनसुत: शुद्धोदनसुत m. (-तः) ŚĀKYA, the founder of the Bauddha sect. E. शुद्धोदन the father of this personage, and सुत son.
शुध: शुध (ओ ऌ) औशुधॢ r. 4th cl. (शुध्यति) To be or become pure or purified.
शुन: शुन m. (-नः) A dog. E. शुण to go, अच् aff.: see शुनि, श्वन्, &c.; also with कन् added शुनक.
शुनाशीर: शुनाशीर m. (-रः) INDRA. E. सु good, venerable, नासीर van of his army, the स in each case changed; also शुनासीर, and more correctly, सुनासीर.
शुनि: शुनि m. (-निः) A dog. f. (-नी) A bitch. E. शुण to go, इक् aff. or श्वन् with ङीष् aff., and the semivowel changed
शुनिन्धय: शुनिन्धय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Suckled by a bitch. E. शुनी, and धे to suck, खश् aff.
शुनीर: शुनीर m. (-रः) A number of dogs.
शुन्ध: शुन्ध r. 1st and 10th cls. (शुन्धति-ते शुन्धयति-ते) 1 To be or become pure. 2 To cleanse, to purify.
शुन्ध्यु: शुन्ध्यु m. (-न्ध्युः) Fire. E. शुधि to purify, चुश् Uṇādi aff.
शुन्य: शुन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Empty, void. n. (-न्यं) 1 A number of dogs. 2 A cypher. E. श्वन् a dog, and यत् aff., the vowel substituted for the semivowel, more commonly शून्य.
शुभ: शुभ r. 1st cl. (शोभति-ते) r. 6th cl. (शुभति) 1 To be splendid, to shine. 2 To be beautiful or handsome. r. 1st and 6th cls. (शोभति शुभति) To hurt or injure, to kill. r. 1st cl. (शोभति) To speak.

शुभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) 1 Happy, well, right, fortunate, auspicious. 2 Handsome, beautiful. 3 Splendid, shining. 4 Eminent, distinguished. 5 Learned, versed in the Vedas, &c. n. (-भं) 1 Good, good fortune, auspiciousness, happiness. m. (-भः) One of the astrological Yogas. f. (-भा) 1 An assemblage of the gods. 2 A female friend and companion of the goddess UMĀ. 3 Bambu manna. 4 Bent grass. 5 The Śami tree. 6 A yellow pigment: see गोरोचना. 7 Light, lustre. 8 Beauty. E. शुभ to shine, aff. क.
शुभंयु: शुभंयु mfn. (-युः-युः-यु) Happy, fortunate, prosperous. E. शुभं happy, युस् poss. aff.
शुभकर: शुभकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Propitious, producing good, &c. E. शुभ, and कर what makes: also शुभङ्कर.
शुभकर्मन्: शुभकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Pious or virtuous act. 2 Reputable occupation or employment. E. शुभ, and कर्म्मन् act.
शुभकर्म्मन्: शुभकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) 1 Pious or virtuous act. 2 Reputable occupation or employment. E. शुभ, and कर्म्मन् act.
शुभग: शुभग mfn. (-गः-गा-गं) 1 Elegant, graceful. 2 Fortunate, propitious. E. शुभ, and गम to go or obtain, ड aff.
शुभङ्कर: शुभङ्कर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Propitious, auspicious, conferring happiness or fortune. f. (-री) PĀRVATĪ. E. शुभ happiness, कृ to make, खच् aff.
शुभद: शुभद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Propitious, auspicious. E. शुभ, and द who or what gives.
शुभदन्ती: शुभदन्ती f. (-न्ती) 1 The female elephant of the N. W. quarter. 2 A woman with good teeth. E. शुभ handsome, दन्त tooth, ङीप् aff.; elsewhere read शुभ्रदन्ती.
शुभफल: शुभफल n. (-लं) Happy result or consequence. E. शुभ, and फल fruit.
शुभलग्न: शुभलग्न m. (-ग्नः) An auspicious moment. E. शुभ, and लग्न rise of a planet.
शुभवासन: शुभवासन m. (-नः) Perfume for the mouth. E. शुभ auspicious, वासन perfuming.
शुभशील: शुभशील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of a good disposition. E. शुभ, and शील disposition.
शुभस्थली: शुभस्थली f. (-ली) A room or hall in which sacrifices are offered. E. शुभ auspicious, and स्थल place.
शुभाङ्ग: शुभाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Handsome, elegant. f. (-ङ्गी) 1 The wife of KĀMA. 2 The wife of KUVERA. 3 A handsome woman. E. शुभ handsome, and अङ्ग body.
शुभाचार: शुभाचार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Virtuous. f. (-रा) A female attendant on UMĀ. E. शुभ, and आचार observance.
शुभाञ्जन: शुभाञ्जन m. (-नः) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga:) see शोभाञ्जन.
शुभानन: शुभानन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Handsome, good-looking. f. (-ना) A handsome woman. E. शुभ, and आनन face.
शुभान्वित: शुभान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Happy, prosperous, fortunate. E. शुभ good fortune, and अन्वित endowed with.
शुभापाङ्गा: शुभापाङ्गा f. (-ङ्गा) A beautiful woman. E. शुभ, and अपाङ्ग the corner of the eye, for the eye or face.
शुभाशुभ: शुभाशुभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) Prosperous and unfortunate, good and evil. n. (-भं) Good and ill fortune. E. शुभ, and अशुभ unlucky.
शुभेतर: शुभेतर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Unlucky, inauspicious. 2 Evil, bad. E. शुभ, and इतर other.
शुभ्र: शुभ्र mfn. (-भ्रः-भ्रा-भ्रं) 1 White. 2 Shining. m. (-भ्रः) 1 White, (the colour.) 2 Sandal. n. (-भ्रं) 1 Talc. 2 Silver. 3 Green vitriol. f. (-भ्रा) 1 The Ganges. 2 Crystal. 3 Bambu manna. E. शुभ to shine, रक् aff.
शुभ्रकृत्: शुभ्रकृत् m. (-कृत्) The thirty-sixth year of the Indian cycle. E. शुभ्र white, and कृत् making.
शुभ्रदन्ती: शुभ्रदन्ती f. (-न्ती) The female elephant of the north-west quarter. E. शुभ्र white, दन्त a tusk, ङीप् aff.
शुभ्ररश्मि: शुभ्ररश्मि m. (-श्मिः) The sun. E. शुभ्र white, and रश्मि a ray.
शुभ्रांशु: शुभ्रांशु m. (-शुः) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. E. शुभ्र white, and अंशु a ray.
शुभ्रि: शुभ्रि m. (-भ्रिः) BRAHMĀ. E. शुभ to be propitious, क्रिन् Uṇādi aff.
शुम्भ: शुम्भ r. 1st and 6th cls. (शुम्भति) 1 To shine, to be splendid or beautiful. 2 To be handsome. 3 To hurt or injure. 4 To speak.
शुम्भ m. (-म्भः) An Asura or demon slain by DURGĀ.
शुम्भघातिनी: शुम्भघातिनी f. (-नी) DURGĀ. E. शुम्भ the Asura, and घातिनी destructress.
शुम्भपुर: शुम्भपुर nf. (-रं-री) A city and district, perhaps the modern Sambhalpur, in the district of Gondvāna. E. शुम्भ the Asura, and पुर city.
शुम्भमर्दिनी: शुम्भमर्द्दिनी f. (-नी) DURGĀ. E. शुम्भ the Asura, and मर्द्दिनी destructress.
शुम्भमर्द्दिनी: शुम्भमर्द्दिनी f. (-नी) DURGĀ. E. शुम्भ the Asura, and मर्द्दिनी destructress.
शुर: शुर (ई) शुरी r. 4th cl. (शूर्य्यते) 1 To hurt, to kill. 2 To be stupid or insensible; also शूर.
शुर m. (-रः) A lion. E. शुर to injure, aff. क.
शुल्क: शुल्क r. 10th cl. (शुल्कयति) 1 To speak. 2 To gain or acquire. 3 To create. 4 To abandon, to leave or forsake.

शुल्क mn. (-ल्कः-ल्कं) 1 Toll, duty, customs or taxes. 2 A present made by the bridegroom to the bride, at the time of bringing her home to his family; a marriage settlement or dower. 3 Money given to the parents of the bride. 4 Money given at the purchase of any thing to ratify the bargain. 5 The profits of household labour, employment of domestic utensils, care of milch cattle, preservation of ornaments, superintendence of servants, &c. when considered as the perquisite of the wife and her own legal property. E. शुल्क to quit, aff. घञ्.
शुल्कस्थान: शुल्कस्थान n. (-नं) Any object of taxation or duty. E. शुल्क, and स्थान place.
शुल्कहानि: शुल्कहानि f. (-निः) Loss or forfeiture of wages, dower, &c. E. शुल्क, and हानि privation.
शुल्ल: शुल्ल n. (-ल्लं) A cord, a rope or string.
शुल्व: शुल्व r. 10th cl. (शुल्वयति) 1 To measure. 2 To create.

शुल्व subst. mfn. (-ल्वः-ल्वा-ल्वी-ल्वं) 1 A rope, a cord, a string. n. (-ल्वं) 1 Copper. 2 A sacrificial observance. 3 Institute, law. 4 A quantity of water. E. शुल्व to measure, aff. अच्; or शुघ to be pure, &c., Uṇādi aff. वन्, and ध changed to ल.
शुल्वारि: शुल्वारि m. (-रिः) Sulphur. E. शुल्व copper, and अरि a foe.
शुशुमा: शुशुमा f. (-मा) The wife of ŚUKRA.
शुश्रुवस्: शुश्रुवस् mfn. (-वान्-वुषी-वत्) Heard, having heard. E. श्रु to hear, aff. क्वसु.
शुश्रूषक: शुश्रूषक m. (-कः) A servant, comprehending five descriptions of persons, a pupil, a religious pupil or the member of a religious community under a common head, a hired servant, an officer or deputy, and a slave. E. श्रु to hear, desid. v., ण्वुल् aff.
शुश्रूषण: शुश्रूषण n. (-णं) Service, serving. E. श्रु to hear, desiderative form, ल्युट् aff.
शुश्रूषा: शुश्रूषा f. (-षा) 1 Service, serving of five kinds: see शुश्रूषक. 2 Saying, speaking, telling. 2 Wishing to hear. E. श्रु to hear, desiderative form, अच् aff., fem. aff. टाप्.
शुश्रूषापर: शुश्रूषापर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Diligent or attentive in service. E. शुश्रूषा, and पर intent on.
शुश्रूषु: शुश्रूषु mfn. (-षुः-षुः-षु) Obedient, serving, attending. E. श्रु to hear, desid. v., उ aff.
शुष: शुष (औ, ऌ) औशुषॢ r. 4th cl. (शुष्यति) To dry.
शुष m. (-षः) 1 Drying. 2 A hole in the ground. E. शुष to dry, aff. क.
शुषि: शुषि f. (-षिः-षी) 1 A hole, a chasm. 2 Drying. 3 The hollow or groove in the fang of a snake. E. शुष to dry, aff. कि.
शुषिर: शुषिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Perforated, bored, pierced, full of holes or spaces. n. (-रं) 1 A hole, a vacuity, a chasm. 2 A wind-instrument. m. (-रः) 1 Fire. 2 A rat. f. (-रा) 3 A sort of perfume, commonly Nalī. 2 A river in general. E. शुष to dry, Uṇādi aff. किरच्.
शुषिल: शुषिल m. (-लः) Air, wind. E. शुष to dry, किरच् aff., semivowel changed to ल.
शुष्क: शुष्क mfn. (-ष्कः-ष्का-ष्कं) 1 Dry, dried. 2 Groundless, causeless. 3 Unproductive, unprofitable. E. शुष to dry, aff. क, or Uṇādi aff. कक्.
शुष्कता: शुष्कता f. (-ता) Dryness. E. तल् added to the last; also with त्व, शुष्कत्वं.
शुष्कमांस: शुष्कमांस n. (-सं) 1 Dry flesh. 2 Dried meat. E. शुष्क dry, मांस flesh.
शुष्कल: शुष्कल mfn. subst. (-लः-ला-ली-लं) Dry flesh. adj. Eating fish and flesh. E. शुष to dry, कलच् Uṇādi aff. or शुष्क, and ला to take, aff. क.
शुष्कवैर: शुष्कवैर n. (-रं) Groundless enmity. E. शुष्क, and वैर enmity.
शुष्कव्रण: शुष्कव्रण m. (-णः) A scar, a cicatrised sore. E. शुष्क dry, and व्रण a sore.
शुष्काङ्ग: शुष्काङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Emaciate, withered. f. (-ङ्गी) A lizard, a chameleon. E. शुष्क dry, अङ्ग the body.
शुष्कान्न: शुष्कान्न n. (-न्नं) Rice in the husk. E. शुष्क, and अन्न rice.
शुष्कार्द्र: शुष्कार्द्र n. (-र्द्रं) Dry ginger. E. शुष्क dry, and आर्द्र ginger.
शुष्ण: शुष्ण m. (-ष्णः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. E. शुष to dry, न Uṇādi aff.
शुष्म: शुष्म m. (-ष्मः) 1 The sun. 2 Fire. 3 Air, wind. n. (-ष्मं) 1 Light, lustre. 2 Strength, prowess. E. शुष to dry, मन् aff.
शुष्मन्: शुष्मन् m. (-ष्मा) Fire. n. (-ष्म) 1 Light, lustre. 2 Strength, prowess. E. शुष to dry, मनिन् aff.
शुष्यत्: शुष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्) Drying. E. शुष to dry, शतृ aff.
शूक: शूक mn. (-कः-कं) 1 The awn of barley, &c. 2 A bristle, a spicula. 3 Compassion, clemency, tenderness. f. (-का) Cowach. E. शो to make sharp or thin, ऊक aff., deriv. irr.
शूकक: शूकक m. (-कः) 1 Barley, or a bearded kind of wheat resembling it. 2 The sentiment of compassion or tenderness. E. कन added to the last.
शूककीट: शूककीट m. (-टः) A caterpillar. E. शूक a bristle, (the hairs on the insect,) and कीट a worm; also with कन् added शूककीटक.
शूकतृण: शूकतृण n. (-णं) A kind of grass. E. शूक an awn, and तृण grass.
शूकधान्य: शूकधान्य n. (-न्यं) Awned or bearded grain, as barley, &c. E. शूक an awn, and धान्य grain.
शूकपिण्डि: शूकपिण्डि f. (-ण्डिः-ण्डी) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. शूक an awn, and पिण्डि a heap.
शूकर: शूकर m. (-रः) A hog. f. (-री) 1 A kind of moss, (Lycopodium imbricatum.) 2 A sow. E. शूक an awn, (a bristle,) र aff., or शू imitative sound, कृ to make, with अच् and टाप् aff.
शूकराक्रान्ता: शूकराक्रान्ता f. (-न्ता) A kind of moss, &c.: see the last; also वराहक्रान्ता.
शूकवत्: शूकवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Awned, bearded. f. (-ती) Cowach. E. शूक an awn, मतुप् aff.
शूकशिम्बा: शूकशिम्बा f. (-म्बा) Cowach. E. शूक an awn, and शिम्बा a pod.
शूकशिम्बि: शूकशिम्बि f. (-म्बिः-म्बी) Cowach, (Carpopogon pruriens.) E. शूक an awn, and शिम्बि a pod; also with कन् added शूकशिम्बिका.
शूकापुट्ट: शूकापुट्ट m. (-ट्टः) A gem, perhaps amber. E. शूक an awn, आङ् before पुट्ट to become small, अच् aff.
शूकिन्: शूकिन् mfn. (-की-किनी-कि) Awned, bearded, (as grain.) E. शूक, and इनि aff.
शूकुल: शूकुल m. (-लः) 1 A fish in general. 2 A kind of fish. 3 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.)
शूक्ष्म: शूक्ष्म mfn. (-क्ष्मः-क्ष्मा-क्ष्मं) Minute, small, fine, subtile. m. (-क्ष्मः) 1 Fraud, dishonesty. 2 Universal spirit. E. स substituted for श in the more correct form सूक्ष्म, q. v.
शूद्र: शूद्र m. (-द्रः) A man of the fourth or servile tribe, said to have sprung from the feet of BRAHMĀ. f. (-द्रा) A woman of the Śūdra tribe. f. (-द्री or -द्राणी) The wife of a Śūdra. E. शुच to purify or cleanse, Uṇādi aff. रक्, the vowel made long, and च changed to द.
शूद्रता: शूद्रता f. (-ता) The nature or condition of a Śūdra. E. शूद्र, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, शूद्रत्वं.
शूद्रधर्म: शूद्रधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The duty of the Śūdra tribe, the service of the other three. E. शूद्र a Śūdra, and धर्म्म moral merit.
शूद्रधर्म्म: शूद्रधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) The duty of the Śūdra tribe, the service of the other three. E. शूद्र a Śūdra, and धर्म्म moral merit.
शूद्रप्रेष्य: शूद्रप्रेष्य m. (-ष्यः) A man of the three first classes, who has become a servant to one of the fourth. E. शूद्र a Śūdra, and प्रेष्य a slave.
शूद्रभिक्षित: शूद्रभिक्षित n. (-तं) Alms begged or received from a Śūdra. E. शूद्र, and भिक्षित begged as alms.
शूद्रभूयिष्ठ: शूद्रभूयिष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Abounding with Śūdras. E. शूद्र, and भूयिष्ठ many.
शूद्रयाजक: शूद्रयाजक m. (-कः) A priest who conducts sacrifices for Śūdras. E. शूद्र, and याजक sacrificer.
शूद्रराज्य: शूद्रराज्य n. (-ज्यं) A country of which a Śūdra is king. E. शूद्र, and राज्य kingdom.
शूद्रवृत्ति: शूद्रवृत्ति f. (-त्तिः) The duty or occupation of a Śūdra. E. शूद्र, and वृत्ति employment.
शूद्रशासन: शूद्रशासन n. (-नं) An edict or grant, &c. addressed to persons of the servile caste. E. शूद्र a Śūdra, and शासन edict.
शूद्रापरिणयन: शूद्रापरिणयन n. (-नं) Marrying a Śūdra female. E. शूद्रा, and परिणयन marrying.
शूद्रापुत्त्र: शूद्रापुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) The son of any man by a Śūdra woman. E. शूद्रा, and पुत्त्र son; also शूद्रासुतः, &c.
शूद्रार्ता: शूद्रार्त्ता f. (-र्त्ता) A plant, Priyangu commonly. E. शूद्र a Śūdra, and आर्त्त pained.
शूद्रार्त्ता: शूद्रार्त्ता f. (-र्त्ता) A plant, Priyangu commonly. E. शूद्र a Śūdra, and आर्त्त pained.
शूद्रावेदन: शूद्रावेदन n. (-नं) Marrying a woman of the fourth class. E. शूद्रा, and आवेदन marrying.
शूद्रावेदिन्: शूद्रावेदिन् m. (-दी) A man of the three first classes, who has a Śūdra wife. E. शूद्रा, and आवेदिन् who marries.
शूद्राभार्य: शूद्राभार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The husband of a Śūdra woman. E. शूद्रा Śūdra woman, and भार्य्या a wife.
शूद्राभार्य्य: शूद्राभार्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) The husband of a Śūdra woman. E. शूद्रा Śūdra woman, and भार्य्या a wife.
शून: शून mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Swelled, increased, grown. 2 Morbidly swollen. f. (-ना) 1 A shambles, a slaughter-house. 2 The soft palate. E. श्वि to increase, aff. क्त, form irr.
शूनावत्: शूनावत् m. (-वान्) A butcher, one who keeps a place where animals are killed for sale. E. शूना a shambles, and मतुप् aff.
शून्य: शून्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) 1 Empty, void. 2 Lonely, desart. n. (-न्यं) 1 Heaven, sky, æther. 2 A dot, a spot. 3 A cypher. 4 A vacuum. f. (-न्या) 1 A hollow reed. 2 The prickly pear. E. शुन a dog, यत् aff. of fitness, and the vowel substituted for the semivowel, and made optionally long.
शून्यगेह: शून्यगेह n. (-हं) An empty or deserted house. E. शून्य, and गेह a house.
शून्यत्व: शून्यत्व n. (-त्वं) 1 Vacuity, emptiness. 2 Unreality, the false or illusory nature of all existence. E. त्व added to शून्य; also with तल्, शून्यता.
शून्यमध्य: शून्यमध्य m. (-ध्यः) A hollow reed. E. शून्य empty, and मध्य the middle.
शून्यवादिन्: शून्यवादिन् m. (-दी) 1 A Bauddha. 2 An atheist. E. शून्य vacuum, and वादिन् declaring; denying the existence of any thing.
शून्यस्थान: शून्यस्थान n. (-नं) An empty place. E. शून्य, and स्थान place.
शून्यहस्त: शून्यहस्त mfn. (-स्तः-स्ता-स्तं) Empty-handed. E. शून्य, and हस्त the hand.
शूयमान: शूयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Swelling, enlarging, expanding. E. श्वि to swell, शानच् aff.
शूर: शूर r. 10th cl. (शूरयते) 1 To be valiant or powerful. 2 To make great effort or exertion. (ई) शूरी r. 4th cl. (शूर्य्यते) 1 To hurt or kill. 2 To be stupid.

शूर m. (-रः) 1 A hero. 2 The sun. 3 A lion. 4 A boar. 5 The grandfather of KṚṢṆA. 6 The Śāl tree, (Shorea robusta.) E. शु to bear, Sautra root, Uṇādi aff. क्रन्, and the vowel made long, or शूर to be brave, aff. अच्.
शूरण: शूरण m. (-णः) 1 An esculent root, (Arum campanulatum, Rox.) 2 A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) E. शूरी to hurt, (some diseases,) aff. युच्.
शूरणोद्भुज: शूरणोद्भुज m. (-जः) A kind of bird. E. शूरण the Arum, and उद् before भुज to eat, aff. क.
शूरता: शूरता f. (-ता) Heroism, prowess. E. तल् added to शूर; also with त्व, शूरत्वं.
शूरदेव: शूरदेव m. (-वः) The second Jina of the future era.
शूरमान: शूरमान n. (-नं) Vaunting, pride of prowess. E. शूर, and मान pride.
शूरमानिन्: शूरमानिन् m. (-नी) A boaster, one who thinks himself a hero. E. शूर, and मन to think, णिनि aff.
शूरम्मन्य: शूरम्मन्य m. (-न्यः) A boaster, one who thinks himself a hero E. शूर, and मन to think, खश् aff.
शूरसेन: शूरसेन m. (-नः) 1 The country about Mathura. 2 The name of a prince. E. शूर a hero, सेना an army.
शूर्प: शूर्प r. 10th cl. (शूर्पयति) To mete or measure.

शूर्प्प mn. (-र्प्पः-र्प्पं) 1 A winnowing basket. 2 A measure of two Droṇas. f. (-र्प्पी) A small kind of winnowing basket, a toy for children. 2 The sister of RĀVAṆA: see शूर्प्पनखा. E. शृ to injure, Uṇādi aff. प, and ऊ substituted for the vowel.
शूर्प्प: शूर्प्प mn. (-र्प्पः-र्प्पं) 1 A winnowing basket. 2 A measure of two Droṇas. f. (-र्प्पी) A small kind of winnowing basket, a toy for children. 2 The sister of RĀVAṆA: see शूर्प्पनखा. E. शृ to injure, Uṇādi aff. प, and ऊ substituted for the vowel.
शूर्पक: शूर्प्पक m. (-कः) A demon, the enemy of KĀMADEVA. E. शूर्प्प to measure, aff. ण्वुल्.
शूर्प्पक: शूर्प्पक m. (-कः) A demon, the enemy of KĀMADEVA. E. शूर्प्प to measure, aff. ण्वुल्.
शूर्पकर्ण: शूर्प्पकर्ण m. (-र्णः) An elephant. E. शूर्प्प a winnowing basket, and कर्ण the ear.
शूर्प्पकर्ण: शूर्प्पकर्ण m. (-र्णः) An elephant. E. शूर्प्प a winnowing basket, and कर्ण the ear.
शूर्पकाराति: शूर्प्पकाराति m. (-तिः) KĀMA or CUPID. E. शूर्प्पक a demon, and अराति an enemy; also शूर्प्पकारि, &c.
शूर्प्पकाराति: शूर्प्पकाराति m. (-तिः) KĀMA or CUPID. E. शूर्प्पक a demon, and अराति an enemy; also शूर्प्पकारि, &c.
शूर्पनखा: शूर्प्पनखा f. (-खा) The sister of the Daitya RĀVAṆA. E. शूर्प्प a winnowing basket, and नख a finger nail, (having them as large,) fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष्, whence also शूर्प्पनस्वी.
शूर्प्पनखा: शूर्प्पनखा f. (-खा) The sister of the Daitya RĀVAṆA. E. शूर्प्प a winnowing basket, and नख a finger nail, (having them as large,) fem. aff. टाप् or ङीष्, whence also शूर्प्पनस्वी.
शूर्पनिष्पाव: शूर्प्पनिष्पाव m. (-वः) A measure (a basket) of winnowed corn. E. शूर्प्प, and निष्पाव winnowing.
शूर्प्पनिष्पाव: शूर्प्पनिष्पाव m. (-वः) A measure (a basket) of winnowed corn. E. शूर्प्प, and निष्पाव winnowing.
शूर्पपर्णी: शूर्प्पपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus trilobus.)
शूर्प्पपर्णी: शूर्प्पपर्णी f. (-र्णी) A sort of bean, (Phaseolus trilobus.)
शूर्पवात: शूर्प्पवात m. (-तः) The air as agitated by the shaking of the winnowing basket. E. शूर्प्प a basket, and वात wind.
शूर्प्पवात: शूर्प्पवात m. (-तः) The air as agitated by the shaking of the winnowing basket. E. शूर्प्प a basket, and वात wind.
शूर्पश्रुति: शूर्प्पश्रुति m. (-तिः) An elephant. E. शूर्प्प a winnowing basket, and श्रुति an ear; as large.
शूर्प्पश्रुति: शूर्प्पश्रुति m. (-तिः) An elephant. E. शूर्प्प a winnowing basket, and श्रुति an ear; as large.
शूर्म: शूर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) An iron image, &c.: see the next.
शूर्म्म: शूर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) An iron image, &c.: see the next.
शूर्मि: शूर्म्मि mf. (-र्म्मिः-र्म्मी) 1 An iron image. 2 An anvil. E. शु for शोभा beauty, and उर्म्मि a wave or line, ङीष् optionally added; deriv. irr.: also with इ rejected, and कन् added, fem. form शूर्म्मिका; again, as differently read, सूर्म्मि, स्युर्म्मि, &c.
शूर्म्मि: शूर्म्मि mf. (-र्म्मिः-र्म्मी) 1 An iron image. 2 An anvil. E. शु for शोभा beauty, and उर्म्मि a wave or line, ङीष् optionally added; deriv. irr.: also with इ rejected, and कन् added, fem. form शूर्म्मिका; again, as differently read, सूर्म्मि, स्युर्म्मि, &c.
शूल: शूल r. 1st cl. (शूलति) 1 To disorder, to distemper or disease. 2 To make a loud noise. 3 To impale, to transfix.

शूल mn. (-लः-लं) 1 Sharp pain in general, or especially in the belly, as cholic, &c. or in the joints, from rheumatism or gout. 2 A weapon, a pike, a dart. 3 An iron pin or spit. 4 A banner, an ensign. 5 An astrological Yoga, that of the 9th lunar mansion. 6 Death, dying. f. (-ला) 1 A whore. 2 An instrument used for putting criminals to death, a stake for impaling them. E. शूल to disease, &c., aff. अच्.
शूलक: शूलक m. (-कः) A restive horse. E. शूल to distress, वुन् aff.
शूलघातन: शूलघातन n. (-नं) Iron rust or filings. E. शूल pain, and घातन what removes.
शूलघ्न: शूलघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Removing or allaying sharp pain, sedative, anodyne. E. शूल, and घ्न what destroys.
शूलधन्वन्: शूलधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) ŚIVA. E. शूल a pike or the three-pronged one, the trident of this deity, धन्वन् a bow, put for a weapon.
शूलधर: शूलधर m. (-रः) ŚIVA. f. (-रा) DURGĀ. E. शूल a pike or trident, धर who holds.
शूलधृक्: शूलधृक् f. (-धृक्) DURGĀ. E. शूल a trident, and धृष to be bold, aff. क्विप्.
शूलनाशन: शूलनाशन n. (-नं) White Sochal salt. E. शूल cholic, and नाशन removing.
शूलशत्रु: शूलशत्रु m. (-त्रुः) The castor oil plant, (Ricinus communis.) E. शूल cholic, and शत्रु hostile.
शूलहस्त: शूलहस्त m. (-स्तः) One armed with a lance or pike. E. शूल, and हस्त the hand.
शूलहृत्: शूलहृत् m. (-हृत्) Asafoetida. E. शूल cholic, and हृत् removing.
शूलाकृत: शूलाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Roasted on a spit, (meat.) E. शूल a spit, and कृत made, with डाच् augment, spitted.
शूलाग्र: शूलाग्र n. (-ग्रं) The point of a pike, stake, &c. E. शूल, and अग्र end.
शूलिक: शूलिक n. (-कं) Roat meat. m. (-कः) A hare. E. शूल a spit, and ठ् aff.
शूलिन्: शूलिन् mfn. (-ली-लिनी-लि) Suffering sharp pain, having the cholic, &c. m. (-ली) 1 MAHĀDEVA. 2 A spearman. 3 A stakebearer. E. शूल a trident, and इनि aff.
शूलिन: शूलिन m. (-नः) The Indian fig tree. E. शूल a stake, इनन् aff.
शूलोत्खा: शूलोत्खा f. (-त्खा) A medicinal plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.)
शूल्य: शूल्य mfn. (-ल्यः-ल्या-ल्यं) 1 Roasted, (on a spit.) 2 Deserving impalement. n. (-ल्यं) Roasted meat. E. शूल a spit, and यत् aff.
शूष: शूष r. 1st cl. (शूषति) To bring forth, to propagate.
शृकाल: शृकाल m. (-लः) A jackal: see the next.
शृगाल: शृगाल m. (-लः) 1 A shakal or jackal. 2 A coward, a poltroon. 3 A rogue, a cheat. 4 An ill-natured or harsh-speaking man. 5 A demon so named. 6 KṚṢṆA. f. (-ली) 1 Flight, retreat. 2 A fox. 3 A she jackal. E. शृज to create or abandon, (deceit, &c.) कालन् aff., or शृंग a horn, अ negative prefix, ला to possess, aff. क, deriv. irr.; also सृगाल, &c.
शृगालकण्टक: शृगालकण्टक m. (-कः) A plant, commonly Seyālkānta or jackal's thorn, (Zizyphus scandens.) E. शृगाल, and कण्टक a thorn.
शृगालकोलि: शृगालकोलि m. (-लिः) A sort of jujube. E. शृगाल a jackal, and कोलि the jujube.
शृगालजम्बू: शृगालजम्बू f. (-म्बूः) 1 A kind of cucumber, (Cucumis madraspatanus.) 2 The fruit of the jujube. E. शृगाल a jackal, and जम्बू roseapple.
शृगालिका: शृगालिका f. (-का) 1 The female jackal. 2 A fox. 3 Running away, flight, retreat. 4 A plant, (Convolvulus paniculatus.) E. शृगाली as above, and कन् added.
शृङ्खल: शृङ्खल subst. mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) A belt or chain worn round a man's body. 2 A chain for confining an elephant. 3 A chain, a fetter in general. E. शृङ्ग a horn, here said to mean a link, and खल to collect, aff. अच्; or शिञ्जा the tinkling of a chain, and स्खल to go, aff. अच्, deriv. irr.
शृङ्खलक: शृङ्खलक m. (-कः) A young camel with wooden rings or clogs on his feet. E. शृङ्खल a chain, and कन् aff.
शृङ्खलता: शृङ्खलता f. (-ता) 1 Connexion, concatenation. 2 Restraint. E. तल् added to शृङ्खल; also with त्व, शृङ्खलत्वं.
शृङ्खलित: शृङ्खलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Bound, chained, fettered, captive. E. शृङ्खला a chain, इतच् aff.
शृङ्ग: शृङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) 1 A horn. 2 A mark, a sign. 3 The top of a mountain. 4 Sovereignty, mastership. 6 Dignity, elevation. 6 A fountain, an artificial one or jet d'eau. 7 A lotus. 8 Very sharp. 9 Minutely fine. m. (-ङ्गः) 1 A medicinal root, commonly Jīvaka. 2 A Muni so named. f. (-ङ्गी) 1 Gold. 2 A fish, (Silurus Singio, HAM.) 3 A plant, (Betula.) 4 Ṛṣabha, a medicinal root, shaped like a bull's horn. 5 Another plant, a kind of Rhus, with an excrescence or gall in the bark, compared to a crab's horn. E. शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. गन्, and the vowel made short.
शृङ्गक: शृङ्गक m. (-कः) A medicinal root, commonly Jivaka. E. कन् added to the preceding.
शृङ्गला: शृङ्गला f. (-ला) A plant, a kind of Rhus, having an excrescence in the bark formed by an insect, which is compared in shape to the horn of a goat or a crab. E. शृङ्ग a horn, लच् aff.
शृङ्गवेर: शृङ्गवेर n. (-रं) Ginger. E. शृङ्ग a horn, and वेर body or shape; also with कन् added, शृङ्गवेरक.
शृङ्गाट: शृङ्गाट n. (-टं) A place where four roads meet. m. (-टः) 1 An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.) 2 A shrub, (Ruellia or Barleria longifolia.) E. शृङ्ग a horn, अट to go or be, aff. अच्.
शृङ्गाटक: शृङ्गाटक n. (-कं) 1 A place where four roads meet. 2 An aquatic plant, (Trapa bispinosa.) 2 A door. m. (-कः) A collection or mountain of three peaks. E. कन् added to the preceding.
शृङ्गार: शृङ्गार m. (-रः) 1 Love, the passion or sentiment as an object of poetical description or dramatic representation. 2 Copulation, coition. 3 Marks made with red-lead on an elephant's head and trunk by way of ornament. n. (-रं) 1 Cloves. 2 Redlead. 3 Fragrant powder for the dress or person. 4 Ginger. 5 Agallochum. E. शृङ्ग eminence, dignity, ऋ to go to or obtain, and अण् aff.; being the chief of the poetical Rasas; or शॄ to hurt, आरन् Uṇādi aff. with नुम्, and गुक् augments.
शृङ्गारक: शृङ्गारक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Horned, having a horn or crest. E. शृङ्ग, and आरकन् poss. aff.
शृङ्गारभूषण: शृङ्गारभूषण n. (-णं) Red-lead. E. शृङ्गार love, and भूषण adorning.
शृङ्गारयोनि: शृङ्गारयोनि m. (-निः) The deity of love or KĀMA. E. शृङ्गार the passion, and योनि origin.
शृङ्गारित: शृङ्गारित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Stained with red-lead, reddened. 2 Affected with passion. E. शृङ्गार, and इतच् aff.
शृङ्गारिन्: शृङ्गारिन् mfn. (-री-रिणी-रि) 1 Feeling, or relating to the passion of love. 2 Stained with red lead. m. (-री) 1 An empassioned lover. 2 Dress, decoration. 3 An elephant. 4 The betel-nut tree, (Areca faufel.) E. शृङ्गार love, इनि aff. of relation.
शृङ्गि: शृङ्गि f. (-ङ्गिः) A sort of sheat fish, (Silurus Singio, HAM.) mn. (-ङ्गिः-ङ्गि) Gold for ornaments: see शृङ्ग and शृङ्गी.
शृङ्गिक: शृङ्गिक n. (-कं) A sort of poison. f. (-का) A plant, (Betula.) E. शृङ्ग a fish, &c., कन् aff.
शृङ्गिकनक: शृङ्गिकनक n. (-कं) Gold for ornaments. E. शृङ्गि the same, and कनक gold.
शृङ्गिण: शृङ्गिण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Horned. m. (-णः) A ram. E. शृङ्ग a horn, इनन् aff.
शृङ्गिन्: शृङ्गिन् mfn. (-ङ्गी-ङ्गिणी-ङ्गि) 1 Horned. 2 Crested, peaked. m. (-ङ्गी) 1 An elephant. 2 A mountain. 3 A tree. f. (-ङ्गिणी) 1 A cow. 2 Arabian jasmine. 3 Heart pea. 4 Katuki, a medicinal plant. E. शृङ्ग a horn, &c., इनि poss. aff.
शृणि: शृणि f. (-णिः) The hook for goading an elephant. E. शॄ to injure, नि aff., and the radical vowel made short; also सृनि.
शृण्वत्: शृण्वत् mfn. (-ण्वन्-ण्वन्ती-ण्वत्) Hearing. E. श्रु to hear, शतृ aff.
शृत: शृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Boiled, (water, milk or Ghee.) E. श्रा to boil, aff. क्त, form. irr.; as applied to any other substances, the form is श्राण or श्रपित.
शृध: शृध (उ) शृधु r. 1st cl. (शर्द्धति) To fart. (शर्द्धति-ते) To be moist or wet. r. 1st and 10th cls. (शर्द्धति शर्द्धयति) To insult.
शृधू: शृधू f. (-धूः) The anus. E. शृध to fart, &c., Uṇādi aff. कू; also read शृधु.
शॄ: शॄ r. 9th cl. (शृणाति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill. With वि prefixed, pass. v. (विशीर्य्यते) To be injured or impaired, to waste or decay.
शेखर: शेखर m. (-रः) 1 A garland of flowers worn on the crown of the head. 2 A crest. f. (-री) A parasite plant. n. (-रं) The root of the Hyperanthera morunga. E. शिथि to go, अरन् aff., and the nasal omitted.
शेखरित: शेखरित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Crested, tufted, topped, peaked. E. शेखर, and इतच् aff.
शेप: शेप m. (-पः) The penis. E. शी to sleep, प aff.; also शेफस्, also read शेपस् n. (-पः.)
शेफ: शेफ m. (-फः) The penis. E. शी to sleep, फ aff.: see the next.
शेफस्: शेफस् n. (-फः) The penis. E. शी to sleep, (semine effuso,) असुन् aff., and फुट् augment; also with पुट augment, शेपस्, and with a final vowel, शेप or शेफ; again, व being substituted for प, शेव.
शेफालि: शेफालि f. (-लिः-ली) A plant: see the next.
शेफालिका: शेफालिका f. (-का) A flower, (Nyctanthes arbor-tristis.) E. शेफा sleeping, from शी with फ aff., अलि a bee, fem. aff. ङीष्, and कन् added; also शेफालि.
शेमुषी: शेमुषी f. (-षी) Understanding, intellect. E. शे derived from शीङ् to sleep, with the aff. विच्; implying, ignorance or delusion; मुष to steal, to take away, affs. क and ङीष्; or शम to pacify, (the senses,) क्वसु participial aff., fem. form, deriv. irr.
शेल: शेल (ऋ) शेऌ r. 1st cl. (शेलति) 1 To go, to move. 2 To shake, to tremble.
शेलु: शेलु m. (-लुः) A small tree, (Cordia myxa.) E. शिल to glean, उ aff.
शेव: शेव m. (-वः) 1 The penis. 2 A snake. 3 Heighth, elevation. 4 Happiness. ind. (-वम्) Hail, homage, a term of exclamation or salutation addressed to the deities. E. शीङ् to sleep, Uṇādi aff. वन्.
शेवधि: शेवधि m. (-धिः) A treasure as belonging to KUVERA, a Nidhi or substance of extraordinary rarity and value, possessed only by the god of wealth. E. शेव happiness, धा to have, कि aff.; or शे in future, अवधि boundary.
शेवल: शेवल n. (-लं) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra:) see the next.
शेवाल: शेवाल n. (-लं) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.) E. शी to sleep, (on the water,) वालन् Uṇādi aff.; also व being changed to प, शेपाल, and the pen. vowel shortened, शेवल; also शैवल, &c.
शेश्यित: शेश्यित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Fast asleep, sleeping much. E. शी to sleep, intens. v., क्त aff.
शेश्यितवत्: शेश्यितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Sleeping much or soundly. E. शी to sleep, intens. v., क्तवतु aff.
शेश्वीयमान: शेश्वीयमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Enlarging, expanding. E. श्वि to increase, intens. v., शानच् aff.
शेष: शेष n. (-षं) Remainder, leavings, rest, balance; what is left, omitted or rejected. m. (-षः) 1 The king of the serpent race, as a large thousand-headed snake, at once the couch and canopy of VIṢṆU, and the upholder of the world, which rests on one of his heads. 2 A name of BALADEVA. 3 Killing, destroying, finishing. f. (-षा) Flowers and other things that have been offered to an idol, and are then distributed amongst the worshippers and attendants. E. शिष to specify, aff. घञ्.
शेषकाल: शेषकाल n. (-लं) The last term, the time of death. E. शेष, and काल time.
शेषभाग: शेषभाग m. (-गः) The last or remaining part. E. शेष, and भाग portion.
शेषभुज्: शेषभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) Who eats the leavings of others. E. शेष, and भुज् who eats.
शेषभोजन: शेषभोजन n. (-नं) 1 Eating the rest of the food after feeding the family, guests, &c. 2 Eating the leavings of a meal. E. शेष, and भोजन food.
शेषरक्षण: शेषरक्षण n. (-णं) Taking care that an undertaking is brought to a conclusion. E. शेष, and रक्षण preserving.
शेषरात्रि: शेषरात्रि f. (-त्रिः) The last watch of the night. E. शेष the remainder, and रात्रि night.
शेषान्न: शेषान्न n. (-न्नं) Leavings of a meal, &c. E. शेष, and अन्न food.
शेषावस्था: शेषावस्था f. (-स्था) The last state or condition of life. E. शेष, and अवस्था state.
शैक्ष: शैक्ष m. (-क्षः) A young Brahman in his noviciate, one who has begun to read the Vedas. E. शिक्षा the pronunciation of the language of the Vedas, अण् aff.
शैख: शैख m. (-खः) The offspring of an outcaste Brahman.
शैखरिक: शैखरिक m. (-कः) A plant, (Achyranthes aspera.) E. शेखर a crest or top, ठक् aff.; also with ढक् aff. शैखरेय.
शैत्य: शैत्य n. (-त्यं) Cold, coldness. E. शीत cold, and ष्यञ् aff.
शैथिल्य: शैथिल्य n. (-ल्यं) 1 Looseness, laxity. 2 Flaccidity. 3 Slackness, remission. 4 Relaxation of rule or connexion. E. शिथिल, and ष्यञ् aff.
शैनेय: शैनेय m. (-यः) SĀTYAKI, the charioteer of KṚṢṆA.
शैरीयक: शैरीयक m. (-कः) A shrub, (Barleria cristata;) also शैरेयक.
शैल: शैल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) 1 Mountainous, mountaineer, &c. 2 Stony, rocky. m. (-लः) A mountain. n. (-लं) 1 Bitumen. 2 Storax. 3 A sort of collyrium: see रसाञ्जन. f. (-ली) A concise interpretation of a grammatical aphorism. E. शिला a rock, a stone, अण् aff.
शैलक: शैलक n. (कं) Storax or Benzoin. E. कन् added to the preceding.
शैलकटक: शैलकटक m. (-कः) The brow or slope of a mountain. E. शैल, and कटक flank.
शैलज: शैलज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced in or on mountains, rocks, &c. n. (-जं) 1 A fragrant resinous substance, (Storax or Benzoin.) 2 Bitumen. E. शैल a mountain, and ज produced.
शैलजन: शैलजन m. (-नः) A mountaineer. E. शैल, and जन a person.
शैलधन्वन्: शैलधन्वन् m. (-न्वा) ŚIVA. E. शैल a mountain, and धन्वन् a bow.
शैलधर: शैलधर m. (-रः) KṚṢṆA. E. शैल a mountain, and धर who upholds.
शैलनिर्यास: शैलनिर्य्यास n. (-सः) Storax, Benzoin. E. शैल a rock, and निर्य्यास exudation.
शैलनिर्य्यास: शैलनिर्य्यास n. (-सः) Storax, Benzoin. E. शैल a rock, and निर्य्यास exudation.
शैलपति: शैलपति m. (-तिः) The Himālaya. E. शैल, and पति master.
शैलभित्ति: शैलभित्ति f. (-त्तिः) A stone-cutter's chisel or axe, an instrument for dividing or cutting stones. E. शैल a mountain, भिद to divide, aff. क्तिन्.
शैलमय: शैलमय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Rocky. E. शैल, and मयट् aff.
शैलरन्ध्र: शैलरन्ध्र n. (-न्ध्रं) A cavern, a cave. E. शैल, and रन्ध्र a hole.
शैलशिखर: शैलशिखर n. (-रं) The crest or peak of a mountain. E. शैल, and शिखर a peak.
शैलशिविर: शैलशिविर n. (-रं) The ocean. E. शैल a rock, and शिविर a camp or palace.
शैलशृङ्ग: शैलशृङ्ग n. (-ङ्गं) The peak of a mountain. E. शैल, and शृङ्ग a horn.
शैलसार: शैलसार mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Hard, firm, as a rock. E. शैल, and सार essence.
शैलाग्र: शैलाग्र n. (-ग्रं) The peak of a mountain. E. शैल a mountain, and अग्र top.
शैलाट: शैलाट m. (-टः) 1 A lion. 2 A mountaineer, a savage, a barbarian. 3 An attendant on an idol. 4 Crystal. E. शैल a mountain, and अट to go, aff. अच्.
शैलालिन्: शैलालिन् m. (-ली) An actor, a dancer. E. शिलालिन् a Muni, said to have been the author of the principles of acting, &c., अण् aff., शैलाल his institutes, and इनि aff. of profession or practice.
शैलिक्य: शैलिक्य m. (-क्यः) An impostor, a pretended devotee.
शैलूष: शैलूष m. (-षः) An actor, a dancer, a tumbler, &c. 2 A rogue, a cheat. 3 The master of the band, or one who beats time. 4 The Bel tree, (Ægle marmelos.) E. शिलूष one of the early teachers of the arts of acting, &c., अण् aff. of descent.
शैलेय: शैलेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Produced in the mountains, &c., mountainous, mountaineer. 2 Mountain-like. n. (-यं) 1 A fragrant resin, (Storax or Benzoin.) 2 A vegetable perfume, commonly Murā. 3 Rock salt. m. (-यः) A bee. f. (-यी) A name of PĀRVATĪ. E. शिला a mountain, ढक् aff.
शैलोपशल्य: शैलोपशल्य n. (-ल्यं) The skirts of a mountain or low land at its base. E. शैल, and उपशल्य neighbouring space.
शैल्य: शैल्य nf. (-ल्यं-ली) Hardness, stoniness. E. शिला a stone, a rock, ष्यञ् aff.
शैव: शैव mfn. (-वः-वी-वं) Relating or appertaining to the god ŚIVA. m. (-वः) A worshipper of ŚIVA. n. (-वं) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra). E. शिव the deity, and अण् aff.
शैवल: शैवल m. (-लः) An aquatic plant. n. (-लं) A drug, commonly termed Padamkāṭh. E. शी to sleep, (on the water,) वलञ् aff.; also शैवाल, शेवाल, &c.
शैवलिनी: शैवलिनी f. (-नी) A river in general. E. शैवल Vallisneria, and इनि aff.
शैवाल: शैवाल m. (-लः) An aquatic plant, (Vallisneria octandra.) E. शी to sleep, (on the water,) वालन् aff., शेवाल, and अण् pleonasm.
शैव्य: शैव्य mfn. (-व्यः-वी-व्यं) Relating to ŚIVA, &c. m. (-व्यः) 1 One of the horses of KṚṢṆA car. 2 A king and champion in the Pāṇḍava army. E. शिव, and यञ् aff.
शैशव: शैशव n. (-वं) Childhood, pupilage, the period under sixteen. E. शिशु a child, अण् aff.
शैष्योपाध्यायिका: शैष्योपाध्यायिका f. (-का) Instruction of youth, tuition. E. शिष्य a pupil, उपाध्याय a preceptor, वुञ् aff.
शो: शो r. 4th cl. (श्यति) 1 To reduce or make small, to pare. 2 To whet or sharpen.
शोक: शोक m. (-कः) Sorrow, grief. E. शुच to regret, aff. घञ्.
शोकचर्चा: शोकचर्चा f. (-र्चा) Indulgence in sorrow. E. शोक, and चर्चा search.
शोकच्छिद्: शोकछिद् mfn. (-छिद्) Consoling, allaying, removing sorrow. E. शोक, and छिद what cuts.
शोकछिद्: शोकछिद् mfn. (-छिद्) Consoling, allaying, removing sorrow. E. शोक, and छिद what cuts.
शोकनिहत: शोकनिहत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Afflicted, overcome with grief. E. शोक, and निहत struck.
शोकभङ्ग: शोकभङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Dissipating or removing sorrow. E. शाक, and भङ्ग breaking.
शोकमूर्च्छित: शोकमूर्च्छित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Involved in distress, swooning with grief. E. शोक, and मूर्च्छित fainted.
शोकस्थान: शोकस्थान n. (-नं) Site, circumstance, or occasion of sorrow. E. शोक, and स्थान place.
शोकाकुल: शोकाकुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Overcome with sorrow. E. शोक, and आकुल bewildered.
शोकाग्नि: शोकाग्नि m. (-ग्निः) Deep distress, violent grief. E. शोक, and अग्नि fire; also similar compounds, as शोकानल, &c.
शोकाग्निसन्तप्त: शोकाग्निसन्तप्त mfn. (-प्तः-प्ता-प्तं) Distressed. E. शोकाग्नि, and सन्तप्त inflamed.
शोकापनुद: शोकापनुद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) 1 Alleviating, consoling. 2 Being consoled. E. शोक, and अपनुद what drives away.
शोकापनोद: शोकापनोद m. (-दः) A teacher of holy wisdom, a philosopher. E. शोक worldly care, अप away, नुद to send, घञ् aff.
शोकापहर्तृ: शोकापहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Allaying or dissipating grief. E. शोक, and अपहर्त्तृ what drives away.
शोकापहर्त्तृ: शोकापहर्त्तृ mfn. (-र्त्ता-र्त्त्री-र्त्तृ) Allaying or dissipating grief. E. शोक, and अपहर्त्तृ what drives away.
शोकारि: शोकारि m. (-रिः) The Kadamba tree, (Nauclea Kadamba.) E. शोक sorrow, अरि hostile.
शोकार्त: शोकार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Pained, afflicted by sorrow. E. शोक, and आर्त्त pained.
शोकार्त्त: शोकार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Pained, afflicted by sorrow. E. शोक, and आर्त्त pained.
शोकोद्भव: शोकोद्भव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Born or produced from or caused by grief. E. शोक, and उद्भब produced.
शोचन: शोचन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sorrowing, sorrowful. n. (-नं) Sorrow, grief, grieving. E. शुच to grieve, aff. युच् or ल्युट्.
शोचनीय: शोचनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be grieved or lamented, what may or ought to be. E. शुच to be sad, अनीयर् aff.
शोचित: शोचित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sorrowful, afflicted. E. शुचि to grieve, causal v., क्त aff.
शोचितव्य: शोचितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be grieved for, lamentable. E. शुच to grieve, तव्य aff.
शोचित्वा: शोचित्वा ind. Grieving or having grieved for. E. शुचि to lament, क्त्वा aff.
शोचिष्केश: शोचिष्केश m. (-शः) Fire or its deity. E. शोचिस् light, and केश hair, having locks of flame.
शोचिस्: शोचिस् n. (-चिः) Light, lustre, radiance, flame. E. शुच to be or make pure, Uṇādi aff. इसि.
शोच्य: शोच्य mfn. (-च्यः-च्या-च्यं) 1 To be lamented or bewailed. 2 To be cleansed or purified. E. शुच to grieve, यत् aff.
शोच्यक: शोच्यक m. (-कः) A low man. E. शोच्य to be purified (from), कन् aff.
शोठ: शोठ m. (-ठः) 1 A fool, a blockhead. 2 A sluggard, an idler. 3 A rogue, a cheat. 4 A low man, one of a degraded tribe or business. 5 A villain, a criminal, a sinner. E. शुठ to be prevented or stopped, aff. अच्.
शोण: शोण (ऋ) शोणृ r. 1st cl. (शोणति) 1 To be red. 2 To move or approach.

शोण mfn. (-णः-णा or णी-णं) 1 Crimson, of a crimson colour. 2 Red in the face, from passion, &c. m. (-णः) 1 Crimson, the colour of the red lotus. 2 A horse of a reddish or bright chesnut colour. 3 The Śoṇa river, which rises in the table land of Amarakaṇṭaka, and running first northerly and then easterly for 500 miles, falls into the Ganges above Patna. 4 A flower, (Bignonia Indica.) 5 Fire or its deity. 6 An ocean. 7 A red sort of sugar-cane. n. (-णं) 1 Red-lead. 2 Blood. E. शोण to be red, aff. अच्, fem. aff. ठाप् or ङीप्.
शोणक: शोणक m. (-कः) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
शोणरत्न: शोणरत्न n. (-त्नं) A ruby. E. शोण deep red, and रत्न a gem.
शोणाक: शोणाक m. (-कः) A tree, (Bignonia Indica.) E. शोण red, अक to go or be, aff. अच्.
शोणित: शोणित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Red, crimson, purple. n. (-तं) 1 Blood. 2 Saffron. E. शोण redness, इतच् aff.
शोणितप: शोणितप mfn. (-पः-पा-पं) Who or what drinks blood. E. शोणित, and पा to drink, क aff.
शोणितपुर: शोणितपुर n. (-रं) The city of Bānāsur. E. शोणित red, and पुर city.
शोणितोक्षित: शोणितोक्षित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Stained or sprinkled with blood. E. शोणित, and उक्षित moistened.
शोणितोपल: शोणितोपल n. (-लं) A ruby. E. शोणित red, and उपल a stone.
शोणिमन्: शोणिमन् m. (-मा) Redness. E. शोण, and इमनिच् aff.
शोथ: शोथ m. (-थः) Swelling, intumescence. E. शु to go, (to grow,) Uṇādi aff. थन्; also with कन् added शोथक m. (-कः)
शोथघ्न: शोथघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Discutient, removing swellings. f. (-घ्नी) Hogweed, (Boerhavia diffusa.) E. शोथ swelling, घ्न removing, fem. aff. ङीष्.
शोथजित्: शोथजित् mfn. (-जित्) Discutient. f. (जित्) Hogweed: see the last. E. शोथ swelling, and जित् overcoming.
शोथहृत्: शोथहृत् mfn. (-हृत्) Discutient, removing swellings. m. (-हृत्) Marking-nut plant. E. शोथ swelling, and हृत् removing.
शोधक: शोधक mfn. (-कः-का-कं) Who or what cleans, purifies, &c. m. (-कः) 1 A refiner. 2 (In arithmetic,) The subtrahend. E. शुध to be pure, ण्वुल् aff.
शोधन: शोधन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Cleaning, purifying, &c., that which cleanses, refines, &c. n. (-नं) 1 Cleaning, cleansing, purifying. 2 Correcting, freeing from faults or errors. 3 Correcting, as a writing. 4 Subtraction, (in arithmetic.) 5 The refining of metals. 6 A sort of refining, practised for chemical or medical purposes; exposing the metals to heat, and then sprinkling them with the urine of cows, &c. 7 Payment, acquittance. 8 Fæces, ordure. 9 Green vitriol. m. (-नः) The lime. f. (-नी) A broom. E. शुघ to be or make pure, aff. ल्युट् or युच्.
शोधनीय: शोधनीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) 1 To be corrected. 2 To be cleansed or purified. 3 To be refined. 4 To be subtracted. 5 To be liquidated (as a debt), due. E. शुघ to purify, aff. अनीयर्; also शोध्य and शोधितव्य.
शोधयित्वा: शोधयित्वा ind. 1 Having paid or discharged. 2 Having cleared, &c. E. शुघ to be pure, causal v., क्त्वा aff.
शोधित: शोधित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cleaned, cleansed. 2 Strained. 3 Corrected. 4 Refined. 5 Purified. 6 Discharged, liquidated, (as a debt.) E. शुध to clean, aff. क्त.
शोध्य: शोध्य mfn. (-ध्यः-ध्या-ध्यं) 1 To be purified, cleaned, refined, &c. 2 Payable, due. 3 To be subtracted. m. (-ध्यः) An accused person, one to be justified or tried. n. (-ध्यं) A constant number to be subtracted in some astronomical computations. E. शुध to be pure, यत aff.
शोफ: शोफ m. (-फः) Intumescense. E. शु to go, aff. फ.
शोभ: शोभ mfn. (-भः-भा-भं) 1 Handsome. 2 Bright. f. (-भा) 1 Light, lustre, radiance, splendour. 2 Beauty. 3 Distinguished merit. 4 A species of the Kṛti metre. E. शुभ to shine, aff. अच, fem. aff. टाप्.
शोभकृत्: शोभकृत् mfn. (-कृत्) Beautifying. m. (-कृत्) 1 The thirty-sixth year of the Hindu cycle. 2 Marking-nut plant. E. शोभ handsome, and कृन् what makes.
शोभन: शोभन mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Beautiful, handsome. 2 Shining, splendid. 3 Richly dressed or ornamented. 4 Propitious, auspicious. 5 Virtuous, moral, decorous, good. m. (-नः) 1 The fifth Yoga. 2 A planet. 3 Burnt-offering for auspicious results. n. (-नं) 1 A lotus. 2 Shining, being splendid or handsome. E. शुभ to shine, aff. युच्.
शोभनक: शोभनक m. (-कः) A tree, (Hyperanthera morunga.) E. कन् added to the preceding.
शोभनाचरित: शोभनाचरित n. (-तं) Virtuous practice. E. शोभन, and आचरित done.
शोभमाण: शोभमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Fair, splendid, shining. E. शुभ to shine, &c., शानच् aff.
शोभाञ्जन: शोभाञ्जन m. (-नः) A tree, commonly Sajinā or Sahajnā, (Hyperanthera morunga;) the legumes, blossoms, and leaves are esculent, and the root of the young tree is used as a substitute for horse-radish: in medicine the root is used as a rubefacient externally, as a stimulant internally, and the expressed oil of the seeds is employed to relieve arthritic pains, &c. E. शोभा beauty, अञ्ज to pervade or anoint, and ल्युट् or युच् aff; also शौभाञ्जन and सोभाञ्जन, &c.
शोभित: शोभित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Beautified, decorated. E. शुभ to shine, क्त aff.
शोशुच्यमान: शोशुच्यमान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Sorrowing or grieving deeply. E. शुच to be sorrowful, intens. v., शानच aff.
शोष: शोष m. (-षः) 1 Pulmonary consumption. 2 Drying. 3 Intumescence, swelling. E. शुष to dry, aff. अच्.
शोषण: शोषण n. (-णं) 1 Suction, sucking. 2 Drying up. m. (-णः) One of the arrows of KĀMADEVA, or CUPID. E. शुष to dry, ल्युट् aff.
शोषयित्वा: शोषयित्वा ind. Having dried up. E. शुष to dry, causal v., क्त्वा aff.
शोषित: शोषित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Dried, dried up, desiccated. E. शुष to dry, aff. क्त.
शोस्: शोस् ind. A particle of reproach or contempt.
शौक: शौक n. (-कं) 1 A flock of parrots. 2 Sorrowfulness. E. शुक a parrot, अञ् aff.
शौक्त: शौक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ती-क्तं) Acid, acetic. E. शुक्त vinegar, अण् aff.
शौक्तिक: शौक्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 Acid, acetic. 2 Relating to a pearl, &c. E. शुक्त or शुक्ति, and ठक् aff.
शौक्तेय: शौक्तेय n. (-यं) A pearl. E. शुक्ति a pearl-oyster, ढक् aff.; also from शुक्तिका with the same, शौक्तिकेय.
शौक्लिकेय: शौक्लिकेय m. (-यः) A sort of poison. E. शुक्लिक a country, ढक् aff.: according to some it is the venom of a snake of the Amphisbœna kind.
शौक्ल्य: शौक्ल्य n. (-क्ल्यं) Whiteness. E. शुक्ल white, ष्यञ् aff.
शौच: शौच n. (-चं) 1 Purification by ablution, &c. from personal defilement. 2 Purification at given periods from defilement caused by the death of a relation, &c. 3 The state or property of freedom from defilement, purity, cleanness. E. शुचि purity, अण् aff.
शौचविधि: शौचविधि f. (-धिः) The rules of purification after defilement by the death of a relation, &c. E. शौच, and बिधि precept.
शौचाचार: शौचाचार m. (-रः) A rule of purification, the mode in which the person is to be cleansed by ablution, &c. after voiding any excrement or contracting any impurity. E. शौच purification, and आचार rule, rite.
शौचेय: शौचेय m. (-यः) A washerman. E. शुचि cleaning, ढक् aff.
शौचेप्सु: शौचेप्सु mfn. (-प्सुः-प्सुः-प्सु) Wishing or intending to be purified. E. शौच, and इप्सु desirous.
शौट: शौट (ऋ) शौटृ r. 1st cl. (शौटति) To be proud.
शौटीर: शौटीर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) Proud, haughty. m. (-रः) 1 A hero. 2 An ascetic, one who abandons the world. 3 A proud or haughty man, but of low tribe or occupation, an upstart. E. शौट to be proud, and ईरन् Uṇādi aff.; also as derived from शौड the same, शौडीर; also the short vowel being substituted for the diphthong, शुटीर.
शौटीर्य: शौटीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Heroism, prowess. 2 Pride, arrogance. E. शौटीर a hero, and ष्यञ् aff.
शौटीर्य्य: शौटीर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Heroism, prowess. 2 Pride, arrogance. E. शौटीर a hero, and ष्यञ् aff.
शौड: शौड(ऋ)शौडृ r. 1st cl. (शौडति) To be proud.
शौण्ड: शौण्ड mfn. (-ण्डः-ण्डी-ण्डं) 1 Drunk, intoxicated. 2 Fond of, addicted to, (as liquor.) f. (-ण्डी) 1 Long-pepper. 2 Another sort, (Piper chavya.) E. शुण्डा spirituous liquor, अण् aff.
शौण्डिक: शौण्डिक m. (-कः) A distiller and vender of spirituous liquors. f. (-की) A female keeper of a tavern or dram shop. E. शुण्डा spirits, ठञ् aff.
शौण्डिर: शौण्डिर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Proud, haughty. 2 Elevated, looking upwards; more properly, शौडीर, and शौटीर as above.
शौद्र: शौद्र mfn. (-द्रः-द्री-द्रं) Śaudra, servile, relating or belonging to the last class. m. (-द्रः) The son of a man of either of the first three classes by a Śūdra woman, the last of the twelve sons acknowledged in the ancient Hindu law. E. शूद्र a Śūdra, and अण् aff.
शौद्धोदनि: शौद्धोदनि m. (-निः) BUDDHA, the founder of the Bauddha sect. E. शुद्धोदन a prince of the family of IKṢVĀKU, and इञ् aff. of descent.
शौधिका: शौधिका f. (-का) A white variety of panic seed.
शौनक: शौनक m. (-कः) The name of an inspired legislator older than MANU.
शौनिक: शौनिक m. (-कः) 1 A butcher, a poulterer, a vender of the flesh of beasts or birds. 2 Chase, hunting. E. शूना a slaughterhouse, ठञ् aff.
शौभ: शौभ n. (-भं) The city of HARIŚCANDRA, suspended in the air. m. (-भः) 1 A god, a divinity. 2 The betel-nut. E. शुभ auspicious, अण् aff.
शौभनेय: शौभनेय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) 1 Sprung from a handsome mother. 2 Relating to any thing handsome or brilliant. E. शोभना a handsome woman, aff. ढक्.
शौभाञ्जन: शौभाञ्जन m. (-नः) The Sajina tree. E. अण् pleonasm, added to शोभाञ्जन q. v.
शौभिक: शौभिक m. (-कः) A juggler, a conjurer.
शौरि: शौरि m. (-रिः) 1 A name of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. 2 The planet SATURN. E. शूर a proper name or a hero, इञ् aff.
शौर्प: शौर्प्प mfn. (-र्प्पः-र्प्पी-र्प्पं) Measured by a winnowing basket, &c. E. शूर्प्प a basket, अण् aff.; also with ठक् aff. शौर्प्पिक.
शौर्प्प: शौर्प्प mfn. (-र्प्पः-र्प्पी-र्प्पं) Measured by a winnowing basket, &c. E. शूर्प्प a basket, अण् aff.; also with ठक् aff. शौर्प्पिक.
शौर्य: शौर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Valour, heroism, prowess. 2 The heroic drama, or that which treats of war, magic, &c. E. शूर a hero, ष्यञ् aff.
शौर्य्य: शौर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) 1 Valour, heroism, prowess. 2 The heroic drama, or that which treats of war, magic, &c. E. शूर a hero, ष्यञ् aff.
शौर्योपार्जित: शौर्य्योपार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Acquired by valour. E. शौर्य्य, and उपार्ज्जित acquired.
शौर्य्योपार्ज्जित: शौर्य्योपार्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Acquired by valour. E. शौर्य्य, and उपार्ज्जित acquired.
शौल्क: शौल्क mfn. (-ल्कः-ल्की-ल्कं) Relating to customs or duties, levied as a tax, &c. m. (-ल्कः) A superintendant of tolls or customs, a custom-house officer. E. शुल्क a toll or tax, aff. अण्.
शौल्किक: शौल्किक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to a tax, a toll, &c. m. (-कः) Superintendant of tolls or customs. E. शुल्क a toll, and ठक् aff.
शौल्विक: शौल्विक m. (-कः) A coppersmith. E. शुल्व copper, ठक aff.
शौवस्तिक: शौवस्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Of or belonging to to-morrow. E. श्वस्तन् of to-morrow, ठक् added, with तुट् augment.
शौवस्तिकत्व: शौवस्तिकत्व n. (-त्वं) Ephemeralness, duration for a day. E. शौवस्तिक, and त्व added.
शौवापद: शौवापद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Relating to a beast of prey, savage, wild, ferocious, &c. E. श्वापद a beast of prey, अण् aff., and औ augment.
शौष्कल: शौष्कल mfn. (-लः-ली-लं) Eating fish and flesh. n. (-लं) The price of dried meat. E. शुष्कली dried flesh, aff. अण.
श्चुत: श्चुत (इर) श्चुतिर r. 1st cl. (श्चोतति) 1 To ooze, to drop or distil. 2 To sprinkle.
श्चोत: श्चोत m. (-तः) Sprinkling, aspersion. E. श्चुत to sprinkle, aff. घञ्.
श्च्युत: श्च्युत (इर) श्च्युतिर् r. 1st cl. (श्च्योतति) 1 To sprinkle. 2 To ooze, to drop or distil.
श्च्युतित: श्च्युतित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Dropping, flowing. 2 Shed, sprinkled, issued, oozed. E. श्च्युत to sprinkle, and क्त aff.
श्च्योत: श्च्योत m. (-तः) Sprinkling, pouring forth, aspersion. E. श्च्युत to sprinkle, aff. घञ्; also श्चोत.
श्च्योतत्: श्च्योतत् mfn. (-तन्-तन्ती-तत्) 1 Oozing, flowing, trickling. 2 Shedding. E. श्च्युत to ooze, शतृ aff.
श्मन्: श्मन् Aptote noun. The face, the mouth.
श्मशान: श्मशान n. (-नं) A cemetery, a place where dead bodies are burnt or buried. E. श्म substituted for शव a corpse, and शान for शयन place of repose.
श्मशानवासिन्: श्मशानवासिन् mfn. (-सी-सिनी-सि) A ghost, a gole, a sprite, male or female, abiding in cemeteries, &c. E. श्मशान a cemetery, and वासिन् who abides; also श्मशाननिवासिन्, श्मशानवर्त्तिन्, &c.
श्मशानवेश्मन्: श्मशानवेश्मन् m. (-श्मा) 1 MAHĀDEVA. 2 A ghost. E. श्मशान a cemetery, and वेश्मन् abode.
श्मश्रु: श्मश्रु n. (-श्रु) The beard. E. श्मन् for मुख the face, श्रि to serve, Uṇādi aff. डुन्, form irr.; also श्मश्रुन्.
श्मश्रुमुखी: श्मश्रुमुखी f. (-खी) A woman with a beard. E. श्मश्रु a beard, and मुख the face, ङीष् fem. aff.
श्मश्रुल: श्मश्रुल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Bearded, having a beard. E. श्मश्रु, and लच् aff.
श्मश्रुवर्द्धक: श्मश्रुवर्द्धक m. (-कः) A barber. E. श्मश्रु, and वर्द्धक who cuts.
श्मश्रूयमाण: श्मश्रूयमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Being as if bearded, having something like a beard. E. श्मश्रु used as a verb, शानच् aff.
श्मील: श्मील r. 1st cl. (श्मीलति) 1 To wink, to contract the eyelids. 2 To twinkle.
श्मीलन: श्मीलन n. (-नं) Winking, twinkling. E. श्मील, and ल्युट् aff.
श्मीलित: श्मीलित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Winked, blinked. n. (-तं) A wink, winking. E. श्मील to wink, क्त aff.
श्यान: श्यान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) Viscous, thick, adhesive, as clarified butter, &c. n. (-नं) Smoke. E. श्यै to go, aff. क्त.
श्याम: श्याम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) 1 Black or dark-blue. 2 Green. m. (-मः) 1 A sacred fig tree at Prayāga or Allahabad. 2 A cloud. 3 The Kokila or Indian cuckoo. 4 A potherb, (Convolvulus argenteus.) 5 Black, (the colour.) 6 Green, (the colour.) 7 Thorn-apple, (Datura metel.) mf. (-मः-मा) A sort of grain, (Panicum frumentaceum). n. (-मं) 1 Pepper. 2 Sea salt. f. (-मा) 1 A woman, described as one who has not borne children; also described as a female of slender make; or one from eight to sixteen; or one who resembles in darkness of complexion, the blossom of the Priyangu, or its stalk, in shape. 2 Night. 3 Shade, shadow. 4 The Jumnā river. 5 A form of DURGĀ. 6 A plant, commonly Priyangu. 7 A sort of Convolvulus, (C. turpethum,) with black flowers. 8 A medicinal plant, (Serratula anthelmintica.) 9 Indigo. 10 A twining shrub, (Ichnocarpus frutescens.) 11 Turmeric. 12 Holy basil. 12 A fragrant grass, (Cyperus.) 14 A shrub, (Abrus precatorius.) 15 A small singing bird with black plumage, commonly Shāma, (Turdus macrourus.) 16 A cow. E. श्यै to go, Uṇādi aff. मक्.
श्यामक: श्यामक m. (-कः) A sort of grain, (Panicum frumentaceum, &c.) E. श्यामा the same, कन् added, m. form.
श्यामकण्ठ: श्यामकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) 1 A peacock. 2 ŚIVA. 3 A small kind of bird. E. श्याम black or blue, कण्ठ the throat.
श्यामत्व: श्यामत्व n. (-त्वं) Blackness. E. त्व added to श्याम; also with तल्, श्यामता.
श्यामपत्र: श्यामपत्र m. (-त्रः) The Tamāla tree, (Xanthocymus pictorius.) E. श्याम black, and पत्र a leaf.
श्यामभास्: श्यामभास् mfn. (-भाः-भाः-भः) Black as jet, of a glossy black hue. E. श्याम, and भास् shining.
श्यामल: श्यामल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Of a black or dark-blue colour. m. (-लः) 1 Black, (the colour.) 2 Black-pepper. 3 The religious fig tree. 4 A large bee. f. (-ला) A name of PĀRVATĪ. E. श्याम black, ला to have, aff. क.
श्यामलता: श्यामलता f. (-ता) A climbing plant, (Ichnocarpus frutescens.) E. श्याम, and लता a creeper.
श्यामाक: श्यामाक m. (-कः) A kind of grain generally eaten by the Hindus, (Panicum frumentaceum; also P. colonum.) E. श्यामा the same, कन् added, and the final retained.
श्यामाङ्ग: श्यामाङ्ग mfn. (-ङ्गः-ङ्गी-ङ्गं) Black-bodied, black. m. (-ङ्गः) The planet MERCURY or its ruler. E. श्याम black, and अङ्ग the body.
श्यामापूजा: श्यामापूजा f. (-जा) Worship of ŚYĀMĀ or DURGĀ, on the new moon of Kārttika. E. श्यामा, and पूजा worship.
श्यामित: श्यामित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Blackened, turned or become black. E. श्याम, and इतच् aff.
श्याल: श्याल m. (-लः) A wife's brother. f. (-ली) A wife's sister. E. श्यै to go, aff. कालन्.
श्यालक: श्यालक m. (-कः) A wife's brother. f. (-लिका-लकी) A wife's sister. E. कन् added to the last.
श्याव: श्याव mfn. (-वः-वा-वं) Of a brown colour. m. (-वः) Brown, (the colour.) E. श्यै to go, व aff., deriv. irr.
श्यावतैल: श्यावतैल m. (-लः) The mango tree. E. श्याव brown, and तैल oil.
श्यावदत्: श्यावदत् mfn. (-दन्-दन्ती-दत्) Dark or black toothed, (naturally so.) E. श्याव dark or brown, दतृ for दन्त a tooth; also श्यावदन्त and श्यावदन्तक.
श्येत: श्येत mfn. (-तः-ता or -नी-तं) White, of a white colour. m. (-तः) White, (the colour.) E. श्यै to go, Uṇādi aff. इतच्.
श्येतकोलक: श्येतकोलक m. (-कः) A sort of fish, (Cyprinus sophore, HAM.)
श्येन: श्येन m. (-नः) 1 A hawk, a falcon. 2 White, (the colour.) 3 Whiteness, paleness. 4 Violence, desperation. f. (-नी) 1 The female hawk. 2 A species of the Triṣṭubh metre. E. श्यै to go, इञ् Uṇādi aff.
श्येनकरण: श्येनकरण n. (-णं) 1 Acting rashly or desperately. 2 Burning on a separate funeral pile. E. श्येन, and करण acting; also श्येनकरणिका.
श्येनचित्: श्येनचित् m. (-चित्) 1 A hawk feeder or keeper. 2 A receptacle shaped like a hawk for a sacrificial fire. E. श्येन a hawk, and चित् what collects.
श्येनजीविन्: श्येनजीविन् m. (-वी) One who sells hawks or lives by training them. E. श्येन, and जीविन् living.
श्येनोपदेश: श्येनोपदेश m. (-शः) Recommendation or injunction to women, to burn on a separate funeral pile. E. श्येन violence, and उपदेश advice.
श्यैनम्पाता: श्यैनम्पाता f. (-ता) Hawking, hunting. E. श्येन a hawk, पात falling, ञ aff., with नुम् augment.
श्योणाक: श्योणाक m. (-कः) A plant, (Bignonia Indica.) E. श्यै to go, डुणाक aff.
श्रक: श्रक (इ) श्रकि r. 1st cl. (श्रंकते) To go.
श्रग: श्रग (इ) श्रगि r. 1st cl. (श्रंगति) To go, to move.
श्रण: श्रण r. 1st and 10th cls. (श्रणति, श्राणयति) usually with वि prefixed, (विश्राणयति) To give, to present.
श्रत्: श्रत् ind. A particle and prefix implying belief or reverence.
श्रथ: श्रथ r. 1st and 10th cls. (श्रथति, श्रथयति) 1 To hurt, to injure, to kill. 2 To let loose or discharge, to set free, to liberate. 3 To bind or tie. r. 10th cl. (श्राथयति) 1 To apply diligently, to endeavour sedulously. 2 To delight frequently. 3 To march. r. 10th cl. (श्रथयति) To be weak or infirm. (इ) श्रथि r. 1st cl. (श्रंथते) 1 To be loose or lax, to be slack or flaccid. 2 To let loose, to loosen.
श्रथन: श्रथन n. (-नं) 1 Tying, stringing. 2 Loosening, untying. E. श्रथ to tie, &c., aff. ल्युट्.
श्रद्दधत्: श्रद्दधत् mfn. (-धन्-धती-धत्) Believing, having faith. E. श्रत्, and दधत् having.
श्रद्दधान: श्रद्दधान mfn. (-नः-ना-नं) 1 Trusting, believing. 2 Venerating, respecting. E. श्रत् particle of faith or respect, धा to have, शानच् aff.
श्रद्ध: श्रद्ध nf. (-द्धं-द्धा) 1 Respect, reverence. 2 Wish, desire. 3 Faith, belief. 4 Purity. E. श्रत् a particle implying belief, &c., धा to hold or have, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
श्रद्धाकृत: श्रद्धाकृत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Done with faith. E. श्रद्धा, and कृत done.
श्रद्धान्वित: श्रद्धान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Believing, faithful. E. श्रद्धा, and अन्वित endowed with; also श्रद्धासमन्वित.
श्रद्धामय: श्रद्धामय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Believing, full of faith. E. श्रद्धा, and मयट् aff.
श्रद्धायुक्त: श्रद्धायुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Having faith, believing. E. श्रद्धा, and युक्त joined.
श्रद्धारहित: श्रद्धारहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Distrusting, unbelieving. E. श्रद्धा, and रहित abandoned.
श्रद्धालु: श्रद्धालु mfn. (-लुः-लुः-लु) 1 Faithful, believing. 2 Wishing, desirous. f. (-लुः) A pregnant woman longing for any thing. E. श्रद्धा faith, आलुच् aff.
श्रद्धावत्: श्रद्धावत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Believing, trusting, having faith. E. श्रद्धा, and मतुप् aff.
श्रन्थ: श्रन्थ r. 9th cl. (श्रथ्नाति) 1 To set free, to let loose, to liberate. 2 To gladden, to delight frequently. 3 To string, to tie together. r. 1st and 10th cls. (श्रन्थति श्रन्थयति) To arrange, to place in order.
श्रन्थ m. (-न्थः) 1 Loosening, liberating. 2 Looesness, flaccidity. 3 Tying, binding, stringing. 4 A name of VIṢṆU. E. श्रन्थ to tie, &c., aff. अच्.
श्रन्थन: श्रन्थन nf. (-नं-ना) 1 Stringing flowers, &c. 2 Killing, destroying. 3 Tying, binding. 4 Loosening, untying. E. श्रन्थ to tie or unite, aff. युच्.
श्रन्थित: श्रन्थित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Strung, connected, bound together. 2 Overcome, surpassed, overpowered. 3 Hurt, injured. 4 Loosed, let loose. E. श्रन्थ to tie, or श्रथि to hurt, &c., aff. क्त.
श्रपण: श्रपण n. (-णं) Boiling in a pot. E. श्रै to boil, causal v., ल्युट् aff.
श्रपयित्वा: श्रपयित्वा ind. Having boiled or dressed. E. श्रै to cook, causal v., क्त्रा aff.
श्रपित: श्रपित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Boiled, (any thing except water, milk or Ghee.) f. (-ता) Rice-gruel. E. श्रै to cook or boil, causal v., aff. क्त.
श्रम: श्रम (ञि इर, उ) श्रमु r. 4th cl. (श्राम्यति) 1 To perform acts of austere devotion, to undergo mortification or penance. 2 To be wearied or fatigued. 3 To be distressed.
श्रम m. (-मः) 1 Military exercise. 2 Weariness, fatigue. 3 Labour, exertion, toil. E. श्रम to be wearied, aff. अच्.
श्रमजल: श्रमजल n. (-लं) Perspiration from exertion or fatigue. E. श्रम, and जल water.
श्रमण: श्रमण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Following a low or degraded business or profession. 2 Base, vile, bad. m. (-णः) 1 A religious character, an ascetic, a Yati, one devoted to meditation for the purpose of obtaining final emancipation from existence, probably the Sarmanes of the Greek writers. 2 A beggar, the religious mendicant. f. (-णा or णी) 1 Indian spikenard, (Valeriana Jatamansi.) 2 Bengal madder, (Rubia manjith.) 3 A handsome woman. 4 A woman of low caste or business. 5 A female mendicant. E. श्रम to be wearied, aff. युच्.
श्रमसिद्ध: श्रमसिद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Accomplished by labour or exertion. E. श्रम, and सिद्ध accomplished.
श्रमार्त: श्रमार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Exhausted, overcome with fatigue. E. श्रम, and आर्त्त pained.
श्रमार्त्त: श्रमार्त्त mfn. (-र्त्तः-र्त्ता-र्त्तं) Exhausted, overcome with fatigue. E. श्रम, and आर्त्त pained.
श्रमिन्: श्रमिन् mfn. (-मी-मिनी-मि) 1 Wearying, tiring, undergoing or incurring weariness or fatigue. 2 Laborious, diligent. E. श्रम to be weary, aff. घिनुण्.
श्रम्भ: श्रम्भ (उ) श्रम्भु r. 1st cl. (श्रम्भते) To be careless or inattentive, to err, to neglect, to mistake.
श्रय: श्रय m. (-यः) Asylum, refuge, protection. E. श्रि to serve, aff. अच्.
श्रयण: श्रयण n. (-णं) Asylum, refuge, shelter, protection. E. श्रि to serve, aff. ल्युट्.
श्रयणीय: श्रयणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be defended or sheltered. E. श्रि to serve, अनीयर् aff.
श्रव: श्रव m. (-वः) 1 The ear. 2 Oozing, dripping. E. श्रु to hear, &c., aff. अप्; also श्रवण, स्रव, &c.
श्रवण: श्रवण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Produced in or under the sign ŚRAVAṆĀ. mn. (-णः-णं) 1 The ear. 2 Hearing. n. (-णं) 1 Service. 2 Dripping, oozing. mf. (-णः-णा) The twenty-third of the lunar asterisms, represented by three footsteps, and containing three stars or α, β and γ Aquilæ. E. श्रु to hear, &c., aff. ल्युट् or युच्; or श्रवणा the asterism, अण् aff. of derivation, and the effect rejected.
श्रवणपथ: श्रवणपथ m. (-थः) The ear. E. श्रवण, and पथ for पथिन् path.
श्रवणाधिकारिन्: श्रवणाधिकारिन् m. (-री) A speaker, an addresser. E. श्रवण, and अघिकारिन् connected with or acting on.
श्रवणेन्द्रिय: श्रवणेन्द्रिय n. (-यं) The organ of hearing, the ear. E. श्रवण, and इन्द्रिय organ of sense.
श्रवणोदर: श्रवणोदर n. (-रं) The hollow of the outer ear. E. श्रवण, and उदर belly.
श्रवस्: श्रवस् n. (-वः) The ear. E. श्रु to hear, aff. असुन्.
श्रवाप्य: श्रवाप्य m. (-प्यः) An animal fit or proper for sacrifice. E. श्रु to drip, (Ghee,) आप्य Uṇādi aff.
श्रविष्ठ: श्रविष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) Produced in or under the sign ŚRAVIṢṬHĀ. f. (-ष्ठा) The twenty-fourth lunar asterism, also called DHANIṢṬHĀ, corresponding to the DOLPHIN. E. श्रव an ear, मतुप् poss. aff., इष्ठन् aff. of the superlative, and the possessive rejected; the attributive is formed by the aff. अण, and that again or its effect optionally rejected.
श्रविष्ठाज: श्रविष्ठाज m. (-जः) The planet MERCURY. E. श्रविष्ठा the asterism, and ज born.
श्रा: श्रा r. 2nd cl. (श्राति) 1 To boil, to cook, to mature, to ripen, &c. 2 To sweat. Causal form (श्रपयति) To render mature or ripe by cooking, &c. (श्रापयति) To heat, to cause to sweat.
श्राण: श्राण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) 1 Boiled, dressed, (any thing except butter, milk, or water.) 2 Moist, wet. f. (-णा) Rice-gruel. E. श्रै to cook, aff. क्त, form irr.
श्राद्ध: श्राद्ध mfn. (-द्धः-द्धा-द्धं) Faithful, believing. n. (-द्धं) A funeral ceremony observed at various fixed periods and for different purposes, consisting of offerings with water and fire to the gods and manes, and gifts and food to the relations present and assisting Brahmans; it is especially performed for a parent recently deceased, or for three paternal ancestors, or for all ancestors collectively, and is supposed necessary to secure the ascent and residence of the souls of the deceased in a world appropriated to the manes. The following distributions of this ceremony are specified; the पार्व्वणं in honor of three ancestors, एकोद्दिष्टं of one, नित्यं regular, नैमित्तिकं occasionally, काम्यं for the attainment of some particular object, आह्निकं daily, वृद्धिः for the obtaining of increase of prosperity, and सपिण्डनं in which the balls of meat offered to the deceased individually and collectively are blended together. There are many other kinds: those for a person recently deceased are one on the day after mourning expires, and twelve others in twelve successive months; one at the end of the third fortnight, one in the sixth month, and one in the twelfth, concluding with a Sapiṇḍana, on the anniversary of the person's death; in general they are all performed in the course of the two or three first days, and the Śrāddha for the deceased is only annually repeated. There is also a sort of Śrāddha performed daily during the days of mourning, usually ten, on which a funeral cake is presented, increasing one or more each day till ten cakes are offered. E. श्रद्धा faith, अण् or ण aff. of possession or relation, as the abandonment or presentation of meat, &c. through faith of its efficacy, in behalf of the souls of the deceased.
श्राद्धकर: श्राद्धकर m. (-रः) The offerer of an obsequial oblation. E. श्राद्ध, and कर who makes.
श्राद्धकर्मन्: श्राद्धकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) The rite or ceremony of funeral oblation. E. श्राद्ध, and कर्म्मन् act; also श्राद्धक्रिया, &c.
श्राद्धकर्म्मन्: श्राद्धकर्म्मन् n. (-र्म्म) The rite or ceremony of funeral oblation. E. श्राद्ध, and कर्म्मन् act; also श्राद्धक्रिया, &c.
श्राद्धकृत्: श्राद्धकृत् m. (कृत्) The celebrator of an obsequial rite. E. श्चाद्ध, and कृत् who makes.
श्राद्धद: श्राद्धद m. (-दः) The offerer of an obsequial rite. E. श्राद्ध, and द who gives.
श्राद्धदेव: श्राद्धदेव m. (-वः) YAMA. E. श्राद्ध the funeral ceremony called Śrāddha, and देव deity; as judge and monarch of the dead.
श्राद्धदेवता: श्राद्धदेवता f. (-ता) A divinity presiding over obsequial rites, a Pitṛ or progenitor, or YAMA. E. श्राद्ध, and देवता divinity.
श्राद्धभुज्: श्राद्धभुज् mfn. (-भुक्) Eating or partaking of the food prepared at a Śrāddha or obsequial rite. E. श्राद्ध, and भुज् who eats.
श्राद्धशिष्ट: श्राद्धशिष्ट n. (-ष्टं) Food that has been presented to the manes. E. श्राद्ध, and शिष्ट left.
श्राद्धिक: श्राद्धिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) 1 The object, receiver, or enjoyer of an obsequial oblation. 2 Anything relating to a Śrāddha. E. श्राद्ध as above, ठन् aff.
श्राद्धिन्: श्राद्धिन् mfn. (-द्धी-द्धिनी-द्धि) The object or receiver of a funeral oblation. E. श्राद्ध as above, इनि aff.
श्रान्त: श्रान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं) 1 Wearied, fatigued. 2 Calmed, tranquil. m. (-न्तः) An ascetic, one with subdued passions. E. श्रम to be weary, aff. क्त.
श्रान्तसंवाहन: श्रान्तसंवाहन n. (-नं) Affording rest or relief to the weary, giving them seats, beds, &c. E. श्रान्त wearied, संवाहन relieving.
श्रान्ति: श्रान्ति f. (-न्तिः) Weariness, exhaustion. E. श्रम to be weary, क्तिन् aff.
श्राम: श्राम r. 10th cl. (श्रामयति) 1 To call, to summon, to invite. 2 To counsel, to advise.
श्राम m. (-मः) 1 A month. 2 A temporary shed, or platform and canopy. 3 Time. E. श्रम to be weary, अण् aff.
श्रामणेर: श्रामणेर m. (-रः) A follower or disciple and servant of the principal Jainas or Jinas.
श्राय: श्राय mfn. (-यः-यी-यं) Sacred or belonging to the goddess ŚRĪ. m. (-यः) Refuge, reliance, shelter or protection. E. श्रि to serve, aff. अण्, or in the attributive form श्री the goddess, घञ् aff., and इ substituted for the primitive vowel changed to अय, and अ made long.
श्रायस: श्रायस mfn. (-सः-सी-सं) Produced in or on the best, &c. E. श्रेयम् the best, अण् aff., and the form changed by special rule.
श्राव: श्राव m. (-वः) Oozing, dropping, flowing. E. श्रु to ooze, aff. घञ्.
