श्रावक: श्रावक m. (-कः) 1 The lay votary of a Buddha or Jina. 2 A crow. E. श्रु to hear, causal form, ण्वुल् aff.
श्रावण: श्रावण mfn. (-णः-णी-णं) 1 Produced in or under the asterism Śravaṇā. 2 Relating to the ear or hearing. m. (-णः) 1 The month Śrāvaṇa or Śravaṇā, (July-August.) 2 A heretic, an impostor. n. (णं) Causing to be heard. f. (-णा) A plant, commonly Katuki. f. (-णी) Day of full moon in the month Śrāvaṇa. E. श्रवणा the asterism, &c., aff. अण्.
श्रावणिक: श्रावणिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Relating to or produced in the month Śrāvaṇa. m. (-कः) The month Śrāvaṇa. E. श्रवणा the asterism in which the moon is full this month, and ठक् aff.
श्रावणीय: श्रावणीय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) To be declared or pronounced, to be made to be heard. E. श्रु to hear, causal v., अनीयर् aff.
श्रावन्ती: श्रावन्ती f. (-न्ती) A city, also Dharmapattan. E. श्र to ooze, causal form, भच् aff.
श्रावयितव्य: श्रावयितव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be declared, to be made to be heard. E. श्रु to hear, causal v., तव्य aff.
श्रावष्ठीय: श्रावष्ठीय mfn. (-यः-यं) Produced in or under the asterism ŚRAVIṢṬHĀ, relating to it, &c. E. श्रविष्ठा, and छण् aff.
श्रावित: श्रावित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Spoken or read, caused to be heard. E. श्रु to hear, causal v., क्त aff.
श्राव्य: श्राव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) 1 To be heard. 2 To be read or related, to be caused to be heard. E. श्रु to hear, ण्यत् aff., or causal v., and यत् aff.
श्रि: श्रि (श्रि) r. 1st cl. (श्रयति-ते) To serve. With आङ् prefixed, 1 To seek asylum, to depend upon, to have recourse to. 2 To be near to. 3 To use, to employ. With अप and आङ्, To quit, to forsake. With उत् or सम and उत्, To be high or elevated. With वि, अप, and आङ्, 1 To fall, to prostrate, to worship. 2 To expect, to rely upon, to trust to.
श्रित: श्रित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Cherished, protected, refuged. 2 Served, honored, worshipped. 3 Joined with, contiguous to, connected with. 4 Covered, overspread. 5 Having, possessing. E. श्रि to serve, क्त aff.
श्रितवत्: श्रितवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) 1 Served, honored. 2 Taking refuge with. E. श्रि to serve, क्तवतु aff.
श्रिमन्य: श्रिमन्य mfn. (-न्यः-न्या-न्यं) Haughty, confident in wealth, beauty, &c. E. श्री, and मन्य who thinks, the vowel of the first made short.
श्रिष: श्रिष (उ) श्रिषु r. 10th cl. (श्रेषति) To burn.
श्री: श्री r. 9th cl. (श्रीणाति श्रीणीते) To cook, to dress. r. 1st and 10th cls. (श्रयति-ते श्रायति-ते) To satisfy.

श्री f. (-श्रीः) 1 Fortune, prosperity, success, thriving. 2 Wealth. 3 Beauty, splendour, lustre. 4 Light. 5 The three objects of life collectively, or love, duty, and wealth. 6 Dress, decoration. 7 State, paraphernalia. 8 Superhuman power. 9 Intellect, understanding. 10 Elevation, consequence. 11 Fame, glory. 12 The goddess LAKṢMĪ, the wife of VIṢṆU, and deity of plenty and prosperity. 13 A name of SARASVATI. 14 The mother of KUNTHU, the seventeenth Jina of the present age. 15 The Saral tree, (Pinus longifolia.) 16 Cloves. 17 A prefix to the names of deities, forming a kind of invocation at the beginning of a letter, &c. and often used repeatedly, as Śrī Śri DURGĀ; also a prefix of respect to proper names of persons, as Śri JAYADEVA; also of works, as ŚrīBhāgavata: this use of it is elliptical; the possessive aff. मतुप् or adj. युक्त joined, &c. being understood, and the sense will then be, the splendid, the illustrious, the famous, &c. E. श्रि to serve, (i. e. whom the world worships,) क्विप् aff. and the vowel made long.
श्रीकण्ठ: श्रीकण्ठ m. (-ण्ठः) 1 ŚIVA. 2 A country N. W. of Dehli, or about Tahnesar. 3 BHAVABHŪTI, the author of the Mālati Mādhava, a celebrated drama. E. श्री prosperity or eloquence, कण्ठ the throat.
श्रीकण्ठपदलाञ्छन: श्रीकण्ठपदलाञ्छन m. (-नः) BHAVABHŪTI, the poet. E. श्रीकण्ठ, and पद the name or title, लाञ्छन a mark; he who is known by the title of Śrīkaṇṭha.
श्रीकण्ठसख: श्रीकण्ठसख m. (-खः) KUVERA. E. श्रीकण्ठ ŚIVA, and सखि the friend.
श्रीकर: श्रीकर mfn. (-रः-रा-री-रं) Giving fortune or prosperity. m. (-रः) VIṢṆU. n. (-रं) The red lotus. E. श्री fortune, and कर who makes or confers.
श्रीकरण: श्रीकरण m. (-णः) A pen. E. श्री the word Śrī, and करण implement of making.
श्रीकान्त: श्रीकान्त m. (-न्तः) VIṢṆU. E. श्री the goddess, and कान्त husband.
श्रीकारी: श्रीकारी f. (-री) An antelope. E. श्री increasing, (nourishment,) कर maker, aff. ङीष्, the flesh being considered as highly digestible and nutritive.
श्रीखण्ड: श्रीखण्ड mn. (-ण्डः-ण्डं) Sandal wood. E. श्री fortune, and खण्ड part.
श्रीगदित: श्रीगदित n. (-तं) One of the minor dramatic compositions, a piece in one act, dedicated chiefly to the goddess of prosperity. E. श्री, and गदित said.
श्रीगर्ब्भ: श्रीगर्ब्भ m. (-र्ब्भः) VIṢṆU. E. श्री fortune, and गर्ब्भ womb or origin.
श्रीग्रह: श्रीग्रह m. (-हः) A place for watering birds. E. श्री wealth, and ग्रह taking.
श्रीघन: श्रीघन n. (-नं) Sour curds. m. (-नः) A Buddha or Bauddha saint. E. श्री prosperity, and घन a heap.
श्रीचक्र: श्रीचक्र n. (-क्रं) 1 A magical diagram. 2 An astrological division of the body, the uterine or pubic region. 3 A wheel of INDRA'S car. 4 The circle of the globe or earth. E. श्री prosperity, &c., and चक्र a wheel.
श्रीज: श्रीज m. (-जः) The deity of love. E. श्री LAKṢMĪ, and ज born.
श्रीद: श्रीद mfn. (-दः-दा-दं) Conferring wealth, prosperity, &c. m. (-दः) KUVERA, the god of riches. E. श्री wealth, and द who gives.
श्रीधर: श्रीधर m. (-रः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 A Jina of the past period. E. श्री the goddess, or good fortune, and घर who has.
श्रीनन्दन: श्रीनन्दन m. (-नः) The deity of love, KĀMA. E. श्री LAKṢMĪ, and नन्दन the son.
श्रीनिकेतन: श्रीनिकेतन m. (-नः) VIṢṆU. E. श्री the goddess, and निकेतन abode.
श्रीनिवास: श्रीनिवास m. (-सः) VIṢṆU. E. श्री the goddess, and निवास abode.
श्रीपति: श्रीपति m. (-तिः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 A king, a prince. E. श्री the goddess of fortune or rank, and पति husband or master.
श्रीपथ: श्रीपथ m. (-थः) A highway, a royal road. E. श्री royal paraphernalia, and पथ for पयिन् road.
श्रीपर्ण: श्रीपर्ण n. (-र्णं) 1 A lotus. 2 A tree, the wood of which is used to procure fire by attrition, (Premna spinosa). f. (-र्णी) 1 A shrub, (Gmelina arborea.) 2 A medicinal plant, commonly Kāyaphal. 3 The silk-cotton tree. 4 An aquatic plant, (Pistia stratiotes). E. श्री beauty or the goddess, and पर्ण a leaf.
श्रीपर्णिका: श्रीपर्णिका f. (-का) A medicinal shrub, commonly Kayaphal. E. कन् added to the last.
श्रीपिष्ट: श्रीपिष्ट m. (-ष्टः) Turpentine. E. श्री the Śarala or pine, and पिष्ट pounded, ground.
श्रीपुत्त्र: श्रीपुत्त्र m. (-त्त्रः) 1 A horse. 2 KĀMA. E. श्री fortune, or the goddess, and पुत्त्र a son.
श्रीफल: श्रीफल m. (-लः) A fruit tree, (Ægle marmelos.) f. (-ली) 1 The indigo plant, (Indigofera tinctoria.) 2 Emblic myrobalan. E. श्री beauty or the goddess, (to whom it may be offered,) and फल fruit.
श्रीभद्र: श्रीभद्र m. (-द्रः) A fragrant grass, (Cyperus rotundus.) E. श्री LAKṢMĪ, and भद्र auspicious.
श्रीभ्रातृ: श्रीभ्रातृ m. (-ता) A horse. E. श्री the goddess, भ्रातृ brother; being recovered as well as LAKṢMĪ, at the churning of the ocean.
श्रीमत्: श्रीमत् mfn. (-मान्-मती-मत्) 1 Wealthy, opulent. 2 Pleasing, beautiful. 3 Prosperous, fortunate, thriving. 4 Famous, illustrious. m. (-मान्) 1 A tree, commonly Tila or Tilaka. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 KUVERA, the god of wealth. 4 ŚIVA. E. श्री beauty, &c., मतुप् aff.
श्रीमुख: श्रीमुख m. (-खः) The seventh year of the Indian cycle. E. श्री prosperity, and मुख chief.
श्रीयुक्त: श्रीयुक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) 1 Famous, illustrious. 2 Fortunate, wealthy. E. श्री prosperity, and युक्त joined with, possessing.
श्रीयुत: श्रीयुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Famous, illustrious. 2 Fortunate, wealthy. E. श्री fortune, and युत joined.
श्रीरस: श्रीरस m. (-सः) Turpentine. E. श्री the Śarala tree or pine, and रस juice.
श्रीराग: श्रीराग m. (-रः) The third of the Rāgas or personified musical modes. E. श्री illustrious, राग the mode.
श्रीराम: श्रीराम m. (-मः) RĀMACANDRA. E. श्री celebrated, and राम the name of the prince.
श्रील: श्रील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) 1 Fortunate, prosperous. 2 Rich, wealthy. E. श्री fortune, लच् poss. aff.
श्रीवत्स: श्रीवत्स m. (-त्सः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 A particular mark, usually said to be a curl of hair, on the breast of VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA, and represented in delineations of him by ❈. 3 A hole in a wall made for felonious purposes. 4 The emblem of the tenth Jina, or the mark above ascribed to VIṢṆU or KṚṢṆA. E. श्री LAKṢMĪ, and वत्स dear to.
श्रीवत्सकिन्: श्रीवत्सकिन् m. (-की) A horse having a curl of hair on his breast. E. श्रीवत्स the mark of VIṢṆU, कन् aff. of comparison, and इनि poss. aff.
श्रीवत्सभृत्: श्रीवत्सभृत् m. (-भृत्) VIṢṆU. E. श्रीवत्स the mark so termed, and भृत् having.
श्रीवत्सलाञ्छन: श्रीवत्सलाञ्छन m. (-नः) VIṢṆU. E. श्रीवत्स the figure so named, and लाञ्छन sign, mark, (whose.)
श्रीवत्साङ्क: श्रीवत्साङ्क m. (-ङ्कः) VIṢṆU: see the last. E. श्रीवत्स, and अङ्क mark.
श्रीवराह: श्रीवराह m. (-हः) VIṢṆU. E. श्री illustrious, वराह the boar Avatāra.
श्रीवास: श्रीवास m. (-सः) 1 Turpentine. 2 VIṢṆU. 3 A lotus. 4 ŚIVA. E. श्री the Śarala or pine, or LAKṢMĪ, &c., and वास abode.
श्रीवृक्ष: श्रीवृक्ष m. (-क्षः) The holy fig tree, (Ficus religiosa.) E. श्री auspicious, and वृक्ष a tree.
श्रीवृक्षक: श्रीवृक्षक m. (-कः) A curl or lock of hair on the chest of a horse: a various reading perhaps for श्रीवत्सक; see श्रीवत्सकिन्.
श्रीवेष्ट: श्रीवेष्ट m. (-ष्टः) Turpentine. E. श्री the Śarala or pine tree, and वेष्ट extract.
श्रीश: श्रीश m. (-शः) 1 VIṢṆU. 2 RĀMACANDRA. E. श्री the goddess LAKṢMĪ, also incarnate in SĪTĀ, and ईश husband.
श्रीसज्ञ: श्रीसज्ञ n. (-ज्ञं) Cloves. E. श्री LAKṢMĪ, and सज्ञा appellation, the names of the goddess being all applied to the spice.
श्रीसहोदर: श्रीसहोदर m. (-रः) The moon. E. श्री the goddess, and सहोदर uterine brother; being reproduced with her and other objects, at the churning of the ocean.
श्रीहस्तिनी: श्रीहस्तिनी f. (-नी) The sun-flower, (Heliotropium Indicum.) E. श्री LAKṢMĪ, हस्त the hand, इनि and ङीष् aff.; held in the hand of the goddess.
श्रु: श्रु r. 1st cl. form irr. (शृणोति) To hear: form reg. (श्रवति) To go, to move, especially as a fluid, to drop, to ooze, to flow. With प्रति or सम् prefixed, To promise, to assent or agree to. With वि, To be famous.
श्रुत: श्रुत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Heard. 2 Understood. n. (-तं) 1 Sacred science, holy writ, &c. 2 The object of hearing, that which is heard. E. श्रु to hear, aff. क्त.
श्रुतकीर्ति: श्रुतकीर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Famous, celebrated. m. (-र्त्तिः) 1 A divine sage. 2 A generous man, a benefactor, a donor. f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 A river. 2 The wife of BHARATA. E. श्रुत heard, कीर्त्ति fame.
श्रुतकीर्त्ति: श्रुतकीर्त्ति mfn. (-र्त्तिः-र्त्तिः-र्त्ति) Famous, celebrated. m. (-र्त्तिः) 1 A divine sage. 2 A generous man, a benefactor, a donor. f. (-र्त्तिः) 1 A river. 2 The wife of BHARATA. E. श्रुत heard, कीर्त्ति fame.
श्रुतदेवी: श्रुतदेवी f. (-वी) SARASVATĪ. E. श्रुत that which is heard, (science, &c.) and देवी presiding deity.
श्रुतधर: श्रुतधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Recollecting, remembering what has been heard. 2 Having or observing the Vedas. E. श्रुत, and घर who has.
श्रुतर्षि: श्रुतर्षि m. (-र्षिः) A Ṛṣi of a particular order; one by whom holy writ has been heard, not taught; as the author of the Suśruta, a medical work, the son of VIŚVĀMITRA, &c. E. श्रुत heard, and ऋषि a saint.
श्रुतवत्: श्रुतवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Hearing, having heard. E. श्रु to hear, क्तवतु aff.
श्रुतश्रवोनुज: श्रुतश्रवोनुज m. (-जः) The planet ŚANI or SATURN. E. श्रुतश्रवस् one of the other sons of SŪRYA, and अनुज younger born.
श्रुतादान: श्रुतादान n. (-नं) Citing the Vedas. E. श्रुत holy writ, and आदान referring to, taking.
श्रुताध्ययनसम्पन्न: श्रुताध्ययनसम्पन्न mfn. (-न्नः-न्ना-न्नं) Well read in sacred science, conversant with the Vedas, and the branches of knowledge or philosophy, dependant on them. E. श्रुत heard, (knowledge of grammar, &c. that has been taught viva voce,) अध्ययन perusal, (of the Vedas,) सस्पन्न accomplished.
श्रुतान्वित: श्रुतान्वित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Acquainted with or conforming to the Vedas. E. श्रुत, and अन्वित possessed of.
श्रुति: श्रुति f. (-तिः) 1 The Vedas, severally or collectively, scripture, holy writ. 2 An ear. 3 Hearing. 4 Intelligence, news, rumour, report. 5 (In music,) A division of the octave, a quarter tone or interval, of which twenty-two are enumerated; four constituting a major tone, three a minor, and two a semitone: the Śrutis are personified as nymphs. 6 The constellation Śravaṇā. E. श्रु to hear, क्तिन् aff.
श्रुतिकट: श्रुतिकट m. (-टः) 1 Penance, expiation. 2 A snake. E. श्रुति the Vedas, or an ear, &c., and कट to go, aff. अच्.
श्रुतिकथित: श्रुतिकथित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Taught or prescribed by the Vedas. E. श्रुति as above, and कथित said, declared.
श्रुतिचोदन: श्रुतिचोदन n. (-नं) Holy precept or injunction, the doctrine of the Vedas. E. श्रुति, and चोदन saying.
श्रुतिजीविका: श्रुतिजीविका f. (-का) Law, the code of laws. E. श्रुति the Vedas, and जीविका living; existing according to scripture.
श्रुतितत्पर: श्रुतितत्पर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Hearing, having ears. 2 Studying the Vedas. E. श्रुति hearing, or the Vedas, and तत्पर attentive.
श्रुतिद्वैध: श्रुतिद्वैध n. (-धं) Disagreement or contradiction of any two passages in the Vedas, or of two Vedas. E. श्रुति, and द्वैध difference.
श्रुतिधर: श्रुतिधर mfn. (-रः-रा-रं) 1 Having, being versed in, or observing the Vedas. 2 Hearing. E. श्रुति, and घर who or what has.
श्रुतिन्: श्रुतिन् mfn. (-ती-तिनी-ति) 1 Hearing. 2 Observing, obeying. 3 Having or following the Vedas. E. श्रुत, and इनि aff.
श्रुतिमूल: श्रुतिमूल n. (-लं) 1 The root of the ear. 2 The text of the Vedas. E. श्रुति, and मूल root.
श्रुतिमण्डल: श्रुतिमण्डल n. (-लं) The outer ear. E. श्रुति, and मण्डल circle.
श्रुतिवर्जित: श्रुतिवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Deaf. 2 Ignorant or unread in the Vedas. E. श्रुति hearing, or the Vedas, and वर्ज्जित abandoned, lost.
श्रुतिवर्ज्जित: श्रुतिवर्ज्जित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Deaf. 2 Ignorant or unread in the Vedas. E. श्रुति hearing, or the Vedas, and वर्ज्जित abandoned, lost.
श्रुतिविषय: श्रुतिविषय m. (-यः) An object or doctrine of the Vedas. E. श्रुति. and विषय an object.
श्रुतिस्मृतिविहित: श्रुतिस्मृतिविहित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Scriptural, declared by the Vedas and the law. E. श्रुति, and स्मृति and विहित said.
श्रुत्यनुप्रास: श्रुत्यनुप्रास m. (-सः) Alliteration. E. श्रुति hearing, and अनुप्रास similarity of sound.
श्रुत्युक्त: श्रुत्युक्त mfn. (-क्तः-क्ता-क्तं) Said or enjoined by the Vedas. E. श्रुति, and उक्त said; also श्रुत्युदित, &c.
श्रुत्वा: श्रुत्वा ind. Having heard. E. श्रु to hear, क्त्वा aff.
श्रुव: श्रुव m. (-वः) Sacrifice, oblation. n. (-वं) A sort of ladle used for pouring Ghee or oiled butter at a sacrifice. E. श्रु to ooze or leak, aff. क, more usually श्रुव, &c.
श्रुश्रुतवत्: श्रुश्रुतवत् mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्) Hearing. E. श्रु to hear, reiterated, क्तवतु aff.
श्रूयमाण: श्रूयमाण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Hearing, being hearing. E. श्रु to hear, pass. v., शानच् aff.
श्रेणि: श्रेणि mf. (-णिः-णिः or-णी) 1 A line, a row, a range. 2 A company of artisans following the same business. 3 A corporation, a company of traders or those dealing in the same articles. 4 A bucket, a baling vessel. E. श्रि to serve, नि Uṇādi aff.
श्रेणिक: श्रेणिक m. (-कः) The name of one of the kings of Magadhā, contemporary with and patron of ŚĀKYASIṂHA. f. (-का) A tent. E. श्रेणि a line, &c., कन् aff.
श्रेणीभूत: श्रेणीभूत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) 1 Made or become a heap. 2 Arranged, set in rows. E. श्रेणि a range, भूत become, च्चि augment.
श्रेधी: श्रेधी f. (-धी) 1 A set or succession of substances. 2 (In arithmetic,) Progression.
श्रेयस्: श्रेयस् mfn. (-यान्-यसी-यः) Best, excellent, most excellent, ind. Well, most excellent. n. (-यः) 1 Virtue, moral merit. 2 Final happiness. 3 Good fortune, auspiciousness, prosperity. m. (-प्रान्) The 11th Jina or Jaina pontiff. f. (-यसी) 1 A plant resembling pepper, (Pothos officinalis.) 2 A shrub, (Cissampelos hexandra.) 3 Yellow myrobalan. E. श्र substituted for प्रशस्त good, and ईयसुन् aff. of the irr. superlative.
श्रेयस्कर: श्रेयस्कर mfn. (-रः-री-रं) 1 Conferring, or the means of, future felicity. 2 Propitious. 3 Making better or superior. E. श्रेयस्, and कर who or what does.
श्रेयस्काम: श्रेयस्काम mfn. (-मः-मा-मं) Desiring final felicity, &c. E. श्रेयस्, and काम desire.
श्रेयस्त्व: श्रेयस्त्व n. (-स्त्वं) 1 Superiority, betterness. 2 Final felicity, &c. E. श्रेयस्, and त्व aff.
श्रेयांश: श्रेयांश m. (-शः) The eleventh Jina or Jaina pontiff of the present era; also श्रेयांस.
श्रेयोर्थिन्: श्रेयोर्थिन् mfn. (-र्थी-र्थिनी-र्थि) Desirous of good, ambitious. E. श्रेयस्, and अर्थिन् who asks.
श्रेष्ठ: श्रेष्ठ mfn. (-ष्ठः-ष्ठा-ष्ठं) 1 Best, excellent, most excellent, pre-eminent. 2 Oldest, senior. m. (-ष्ठः) 1 KUVERA. 2 A king. 3 A Brahman. n. (-ष्ठं) Cow's milk. E. श्र for प्रशस्त best, इष्ठन् aff. of the irr. superlative.
श्रेष्ठकाष्ठ: श्रेष्ठकाष्ठ n. (-ष्ठं) The main pillar of a house. E. श्रेष्ठ best, and काष्ठ timber.
श्रेष्ठता: श्रेष्ठता f. (-ता) Superiority, betterness, excellence. E. श्रेष्ठ, and तल् aff.; also with त्व, श्रेष्ठत्वं.
श्रेष्ठाश्रम: श्रेष्ठाश्रम m. (-मः) The householder. E. श्रेष्ठ best, आश्रम order or state; the householder being considered the best of the four orders, as he supports the other three.
श्रेष्ठिन्: श्रेष्ठिन् mfn. (-ष्ठी-ष्ठिनी-ष्ठि) Best, chief. m. (-ष्ठी) 1 An artist eminent by birth. 2 The head or chief of a body of persons following the same trade or occupation, a president, a foreman. E. श्रेष्ठ excellence, इनि aff.
श्रै: श्रै r. 1st cl. (श्रायति) 1 To boil, to cook. 2 To melt, to liquefy. 3 To sweat.
श्रैष्ठ्य: श्रैष्ठ्य n. (-ष्ठ्यं) Superiority, betterness, preference. E. श्रेष्ठ, and ष्यञ् aff.
श्रोण: श्रोण (ऋ) श्रोणृ r. 1st cl. (श्रोणति) To accumulate, to heap together.
श्रोण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Dressed, cooked, matured. m. (-णः) A cripple. f. (-णा) 1 The constellation Śravaṇā. 2 Rice-gruel. E. श्रोण to heap together, aff. अच्; or शॄ to injure, Uṇādi aff. न.
श्रोणि: श्रोणि f. (-णिः-णी) 1 The hip and loins. 2 A road, a way. E. श्रोण to heap, aff. इन्; or श्रु to hear, Uṇādi aff. नि.
श्रोणिफलक: श्रोणिफलक n. (-कं) 1 The hip and loins, or the hip only. 2 The hip-bone, the os ilium. E. श्रोणि the same, and फल fruit, कन् aff. of comparison, or फलक a plank; also श्रोणिफल n. (-लं)
श्रोणिविम्ब: श्रोणिविम्ब n. (-म्बं) A string worn round the loins.
श्रोतस्: श्रोतस् n. (-तः) 1 The ear. 2 The current of a stream. 3 An organ of sense. E. श्रु to hear or to leak, aff. असुन्, and तुट् augment.
श्रोतव्य: श्रोतव्य mfn. (-व्यः-व्या-व्यं) To be heard or listened to. E. श्रु to hear, तव्य aff. of the future participle.
श्रोतृ: श्रोतृ mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ) Hearing, a hearer, who hears. E. श्रु to hear, तृच् aff.
श्रोत्र: श्रोत्र n. (-त्रं) The ear. E. श्रु to hear, Uṇādi aff. त्रन्.
श्रोत्रसुख: श्रोत्रसुख mfn. (-खः-खा-खं) Melodious, musical, sounding agreeably. E. श्रोत्र, and सुख pleasure.
श्रोत्रादि: श्रोत्रादि ind. The five senses. E. श्रोत्र, and आदि etcetera.
श्रोत्रिय: श्रोत्रिय mfn. (-यः-या-यं) Modest, docile, well-behaved. m. (-यः) 1 A Brahman versed in the study of the Vedas. 2 A Brahman following  a particular branch or school of the Vedas. E. श्रोत्र considered as substituted for छन्दस् the metre of the Vedas, and खन् aff.; or श्रोत्र the ear, said also to mean the Vedas, and घ aff.
श्रोत्रियता: श्रोत्रियता f. (-ता) Conversancy with the Vedas, the duty of a Brahman. E. श्रोत्रिय a priest acquainted with the Vedas, and तल् aff.
श्रोत्रियस्व: श्रोत्रियस्व n. (-स्वं) The property of a learned Brahman. E. श्रोत्रिय, and स्व own.
श्रौत: श्रौत mfn. (-तः-ती-तं) Relating or belonging to the Vedas, to the ear, hearing, &c. n. (-तं) 1 Preservation of the sacred fire. 2 Any observance ordained by the Vedas. f. (-ती) Comparison expressed by a particle, so, as, like, &c. E. श्रुति the Vedas, and अण् aff.
श्रौतस्मार्तक्रिया: श्रौतस्मार्त्तक्रिया f. (-या) Acts conformable to law and religion. E. श्रौत and स्मार्त्त, and क्रिया act.
श्रौतस्मार्त्तक्रिया: श्रौतस्मार्त्तक्रिया f. (-या) Acts conformable to law and religion. E. श्रौत and स्मार्त्त, and क्रिया act.
श्रौतस्मार्तधर्म: श्रौतस्मार्त्तधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Duty enjoined by the Vedas and laws. E. श्रौत and स्मार्त्त, and धर्म्म duty.
श्रौतस्मार्त्तधर्म्म: श्रौतस्मार्त्तधर्म्म m. (-र्म्मः) Duty enjoined by the Vedas and laws. E. श्रौत and स्मार्त्त, and धर्म्म duty.
श्रौत्र: श्रौत्र n. (-त्रं) 1 Conversancy with the Vedas. 2 The ear. E. श्रोत्र the ear, or श्रोत्रिय a Brahman studied in scripture, अण् aff.; in the second case the last syllable rejected as well as the pen. vowel.
श्रौषट्: श्रौषट् ind. An exclamation used in making an offering with fire to the gods or manes. E. श्रु to hear, (the prayer being heard in consequence,) and डौषट aff.
श्र्याह्व: श्र्याह्व n. (-ह्वं) The lotus. E. श्री LAKṢMĪ, and आह्वा appellation, the goddess appearing in the first instance from within the flower, and thence deriving many of her names.
श्लक: श्लक (इ) श्लकि r. 1st cl. (श्लंकते) To go, to move.
श्लक्ष्ण: श्लक्ष्ण mfn. (-क्ष्णः-क्ष्णा-क्ष्णं) 1 Small, fine, minute. 2 Gentle, mild, amiable. 3 Honest, sincere. 4 Plain, even, smooth. E. श्लिष to embrace, क्स्न aff., the short vowel substituted for the penultimate.
श्लग: श्लग (इ) श्लगि r. 1st cl. (श्लंङ्गति) To go, to move.
श्लथ: श्लथ r. 10th cl. (श्लथयमि) To be weak, to be relaxed, loose, flaccid. r. 1st cl. (श्लथयति) To hurt or kill.
श्लथ mfn. (-थः-था-थं) 1 Loose, flaccid, relaxed. 2 Dishevelled (hair). 3 Untied, unfastened. E. श्लथ to be relaxed, aff. अच्.
श्लाख: श्लाख (ऋ) श्लाखृ r. 1st cl. (श्लाखति) To pervade.
श्लाघ: श्लाघ (ऋ) श्लाघृ r. 1st cl. (श्लाघते) 1 To praise, to eulogise. 2 To flatter, to coax, to wheedle. 3 To boast.
श्लाघा: श्लाघा f. (-घा) 1 Praise, panegyric, flattery, eulogium. 2 Service, obedience. 3 Wish, desire. E. श्लाघ to praise, aff. अङ् and टाप्.
श्लाघित: श्लाघित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Praised, commended. E. श्लाघ to praise, क्त aff.
श्लाघ्य: श्लाघ्य mfn. (-घ्यः-घ्या-घ्यं) Venerable, respectable, praise-worthy, entitled to praise or veneration. E. श्लाघा praise, यत् aff.
श्लिकु: श्लिकु m. (-कुः) 1 A servant, a slave. 2 A blackguard. 3 A lecher, a libertine or debauchee. n. (-कु) Astronomy. astrology. E. श्लिष to embrace, Uṇādi aff. कु, and क substituted for the final.
श्लिष: श्लिष r. 4th cl. (ञि ओऌ) श्लिषॢ (श्लिष्यति) r. 1st and 10th cls. (श्लेषति श्लेषयति) 1 To embrace. 2 To adhere or cling to. 3 To unite, to join or connect. (उ) श्लिषु r. 1st cl. (श्लिपति) To burn.
श्लिषा: श्लिषा f. (-षा) Embracing, an embrace. E. श्लिष to embrace, अङ् and टाप् affs.
श्लिष्ट: श्लिष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) 1 Embraced. 2 Touched by, clung or adhered to. E. श्लिष to embrace, क्त aff.
श्लिष्यत्: श्लिष्यत् mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्) Embracing, clinging, adhering to, being in close contact with. E. श्लिष to embrace, शवृ aff.
श्लीपद: श्लीपद n. (-दं) Morbid enlargement of the legs.
श्लीपदप्रभव: श्लीपदप्रभव m. (-वः) The mango tree. E. श्लीपद swelled leg, and प्रभव production.
श्लीपदापह: श्लीपदापह m. (-हः) A plant, (Nageia putranjiva.) E. श्लीपद, and अपह removing.
श्लील: श्लील mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Prosperous, fortunate, affluent, happy. E. श्री good fortune, लच् poss. aff., and र changed to ल.
श्लेष: श्लेष m. (-षः) 1 Union, junction, the proximity of contact. 2 Association, society, presence. 3 Embracing, an embrace. 4 Adhering or clinging to, &c. 5 A figure of rhetoric, choice or connexion of words so as to admit of a double interpretation, a species of paronomasia or pun. E. श्लिष to embrace, aff. ण.
श्लेष्मक: श्लेष्मक m. (-कः) Phlegm, the watery or phlegmatic humor. E. श्लेष्मन् the same, कन् pleonasm.
श्लेष्मघ्न: श्लेष्मघ्न mfn. (-घ्नः-घ्नी-घ्नं) Removing phlegm. f. (-घ्ना) 1 Arabian jasmine. 2 A flower, (Pandanus odoratissimus.) f. (-घ्नी) Hogweed. E. श्लेष्म phlegm, and घ्न removing, fem. aff. टाप् or ङीप्.
श्लेष्मज: श्लेष्मज mfn. (-जः-जा-जं) Produced or proceeding from phlegm. E. श्लेष्मन्, and ज born.
श्लेष्मण: श्लेष्मण mfn. (-णः-णा-णं) Phlegmatic. f. (-णा) A plant, (Justicia adhenatoda, &c.) E. श्लेष्मन् the humor, and न aff.
श्लेष्मन्: श्लेष्मन् m. (-ष्मा) The phlegmatic humor, one of the three principal humors or fluids of the body. E. श्लिष to embrace or adhere to, (the body,) aff. मनिन्.
श्लेष्मल: श्लेष्मल mfn. (-लः-ला-लं) Phlegmatic, abounding or affected with phlegm, &c. m. (-लः) A plant, (Cordia latifolia.) E. श्लेष्म phlegm, लच् aff.
श्लेष्मह: श्लेष्मह m. (-हः) A medicinal plant, commonly Kayaphal. E. श्लेष्म phlegm, and ह destroying.
श्लेष्मात: श्लेष्मात m. (-तः) A small tree, (Cordia latifolia.) E. श्लेष्मन् phlegm, अत to go, (to remove,) aff. अच्; also with कन् added श्लेष्मातक.
श्लैष्मिक: श्लैष्मिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Allaying or exciting phlegm, phlegmatic. E. श्लेष्मन् phlegm, ठञ् aff.
श्लोक: श्लोक (ऋ) श्लोकृ r. 1st cl. (श्लोकते) 1 To put together, to compose, as verses. 2 To be put together or composed.

श्लोक m. (-कः) 1 A verse, a stanza. 2 Fame, celebrity. E. श्लोक to compose, (as verses,) aff. अच्; according to the Rāmāyaṇa, irr. derived from शोक sorrow: the first verse ever composed, having been the involuntary expression of VĀLMĪKI'S grief at beholding a bird killed by a fowler.
श्लोकत्व: श्लोकत्व n. (-त्वं) Versification. E. त्व added to the last.
श्लोण: श्लोण (ऋ) श्लोणृ r. 1st cl. (श्लोणति) To heap together, to collect or assemble.
श्वःश्रेयस: श्वःश्रेयस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Happy, prosperous. n. adv. (-सं) 1 Happy, well, right. subst. 2 BRAHMA, the Supreme Being. 3 Happiness, prosperity. E. श्वस् particle, implying happiness, श्रेयस्  best, excellent, and a final अच् or vowel added to the compound.
श्वक: श्वक (इ) श्वकि r. 1st cl. (श्वंकते) To go, to move.
श्वक्रीडिन्: श्वक्रीडिन् m. (-डी) A dog-feeder or trainer. E. श्व, and क्रीडिन् who plays with.
श्वग: श्वग (इ) श्वगि r. 1st cl. (श्वंगति) To go or move.
श्वगण: श्वगण m. (-णः) A pack or number of dogs. E. श्व a dog, and गण a troop.
श्वगणिक: श्वगणिक m. (-कः) A hunter. mf. (-कः-का) 1 A dog feeder. 2 One carried by dogs. E. श्व a dog, गण a number, and ठन् aff.
श्वच: श्वच r. 1st cl. (श्वचते) (इ) श्वचि (श्वंचते) To go, to move.
श्वज: श्वज r. 1st cl. (श्वजते) also (इ) श्वजि (श्वंजते) To go, to move.
श्वठ: श्वठ r. 10th cl. (श्वाठयति) (इ) श्वठि (श्वण्ठयति) 1 To finish. 2 To leave defective or unfinished. 3 To go, to move. (श्वठयति) 1 To speak amiss. 2 To speak well. 3 To abstain from speaking: see शठ.
श्वदंष्ट्रा: श्वदंष्ट्रा f. (-ष्ट्रा) 1 A dog's tooth. 2 A fruit, (Flacourtia cataphracta.) E. श्व for श्वन् a dog, दंष्ट्रा a tooth.
श्वधूर्त: श्वधूर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A jackal. E. श्वन् a dog, and धूर्त्त a cheat.
श्वधूर्त्त: श्वधूर्त्त m. (-र्त्तः) A jackal. E. श्वन् a dog, and धूर्त्त a cheat.
श्वन्: श्वन् m. (-श्वा श्वानौ श्वानः) accu. plu. (शुनः) A dog. f. (शुनी) A bitch. E. श्वि to increase, Uṇādi aff. कनिन्, form irr.
श्वनिश: श्वनिश nf. (-शं-शा) A night on which dogs bark and howl. E. श्व for श्वन् a dog, निशा night.
श्वपच: श्वपच mf. (-चः-चा) 1 A man or woman of a low and degraded caste. 2 A dog-feeder or keeper. E. श्वन् a dog, पच to cook (for his food), or to cherish as his property, and अच् aff.; also with क्विप् aff. श्वपच् m. (-पक्) and with अण् aff. श्वपाक.
श्वपद: श्वपद n. (-दं) 1 A dog's foot. 2 A mark like one, to be branded on the forehead of a thief. E. श्व, and पद a foot.
श्वपाक: श्वपाक m. (-कः) A man of a degraded and outcast tribe, the son of an Ugrā woman by a Kṣatrī male, and classed with the Caṇḍāla, with whom he is ordered to live out of the town, to feed from broken vessels, and wear the clothes of the dead; to possess no other property than asses and dogs, and to be excluded from all intercourse with other tribes; he can only be employed as public executioner, or to carry out the bodies of those who die without kindred. E. श्व a dog, पच to cook, (to feed on or to cherish,) aff. अण्: see श्वपच.
श्वफल: श्वफल m. (-लः) The lime or citron. E. श्व for श्वन् a dog, and फल fruit.
श्वभीरु: श्वभीरु m. (-रुः) A jackal. E. श्वन् a dog, and भीरु afraid of.
श्वभ्र: श्वभ्र r. 10th cl. (श्वभ्रयति) 1 To live in misery or distress. 2 To go, to move. 3 To make a hole, to pierce or perforate.
श्वभ्र n. (-भ्रं) A hole, a gap, a chasm. E. श्वभ्र to pierce, aff. अच्, or श्व a dog, भृ to cherish, aff. क.
श्वयथु: श्वयथु m. (-थुः) Swelling, intumescence. E. श्वि to swell, aff. अथुच्.
श्वयीचि: श्वयीचि f. (-चिः) Sickness, disease. E. श्वि to increase, Uṇādi aff. ईचि.
श्वर्त: श्वर्त्त r. 10th cl. (श्वर्त्तयति) 1 To live in misery or distress. 2 To go, to move.
श्वर्त्त: श्वर्त्त r. 10th cl. (श्वर्त्तयति) 1 To live in misery or distress. 2 To go, to move.
श्वल: श्वल r. 1st cl. (श्वलति) To run, to go quickly.
श्वल्ल: श्वल्ल r. 1st cl. (श्वल्लति) To run, to go fast or quickly.
श्ववत्: श्ववत् ind. Like a dog, cur-like. E. श्व, and वति aff.
श्ववत् m. (-वान्) A dog-feeder or trainer. E. श्व, and मतुप aff.
श्ववृत्ति: श्ववृत्ति m. (-त्तिः) Service, servitude. E. श्व a dog, and वृत्ति practice.
श्वव्याघ्र: श्वव्याघ्र m. (-घ्रः) The hunting leopard or Ciṭa. E. श्व a dog, and व्याघ्र a tiger.
श्वशुर: श्वशुर m. (-रः) 1 A father-in-law, a wife's or husband's father. 2 A venerable man, one to be treated as a father-in-law. m. du. (-रौ) A father and mother-in-law. E. शु a particle, implying respect, अश to pervade, Uṇādi aff. उरच्.
श्वशुर्य: श्वशुर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A brother-in-law, a wife's or husband's brother. 2 A husband's younger brother. E. श्वशुर a father-in-law, and यत् patronymic aff.
श्वशुर्य्य: श्वशुर्य्य m. (-र्य्यः) 1 A brother-in-law, a wife's or husband's brother. 2 A husband's younger brother. E. श्वशुर a father-in-law, and यत् patronymic aff.
श्वश्रू: श्वश्रू f. (-श्रूः) A mother-in-law. E. श्वशुर a father-in-law, the उ and अ rejected, र conjoined with श, and ऊङ् fem. aff.
श्वश्रूश्वशुर: श्वश्रूश्वशुर m. du. (-रौ) Mother and father-in-law. E. श्वश्रू, and श्वशुर conjoined.
श्वस: श्वस r. 2nd cl. (श्वसिति) 1 To breathe. 2 To live. With आङ् prefixed, To recover or revive, to console. With उत्, 1 To open, to expand. 2 To console. With निर्, 1 To breathe out, to expire. 2 To sigh. With वि, To have trust or faith in.
श्वस्: श्वस् ind. 1 To-morrow. 2 A particle, implying auspiciousness.
श्वसत्: श्वसत् mfn. (-सन्-सन्ती-सती-सत्) Breathing, sighing. E. श्वस to breathe, शतृ aff.
श्वसन: श्वसन m. (-नः) 1 Air, wind. 2 A thorny plant, (Vangueria spinosa.) n. (-नं) 1 Breathing, breath. 2 Sighing. E. श्वस to breathe, aff. ल्युट्.
श्वसनासन: श्वसनासन m. (-नः) A snake. E. श्वसन breathing, असन food; eating air.
श्वसनेश्वर: श्वसनेश्वर m. (-रः) A tree, (Pentaptera arjuna.) E. श्वसन breath, and ईश्वर sovereign.
श्वसनोत्सुक: श्वसनोत्सुक m. (-कः) A snake. E. श्वसन breathing, and उत्सुक delighting.
श्वसित: श्वसित mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) Sighed, breathed, sighing, breathing. n. (-तं) 1 Breathing, breath. 2 Sighing, a sigh. E. श्वस to breathe, क्त aff.
श्वसुत: श्वसुत m. (-तः) A plant, (Conyza lacera, &c.) E. श्व a dog, and सुत a son.
श्वस्तन: श्वस्तन mfn. (-नः-नी-नं) Future, what will be to-morrow, &c. E. श्वस् to-morrow, ट्युल् aff.
श्वस्त्य: श्वस्त्य mfn. (-स्त्यः-स्त्या-स्त्यं) To-morrow's, what will be to-morrow. E. श्वस् to-morrow, and त्यप् aff.
श्वस्पृष्ट: श्वस्पृष्ट mfn. (-ष्टः-ष्टा-ष्टं) Touched by a dog, defiled. E. श्व, and स्पृष्ट touched.
श्वागणिक: श्वागणिक m. (-कः) A hunter. mf. (-कः-की) 1 A dog-keeper, one who lives by feeding or keeping dogs. 2 One who rides or is drawn by dogs. E. श्वगण a number of dogs, ठञ् aff.
श्वादन्त: श्वादन्त m. (-न्तः) A dog's tooth. E. श्वन a dog, दन्त a tooth, and the vowel termination of the first word made long in this and similar compounds, as श्वाकर्ण, श्वापुच्छ, &c.
श्वान: श्वान m. (-नः) A dog. f. (-नी) A bitch. E. a various reading of श्वन्, q. v.
श्वापद: श्वापद mfn. (-दः-दी-दं) Ferocious, savage, relating or belonging to a beast of prey. m. (-दः) A beast of prey in general. E. श्वन् a dog, आपद to resemble, aff. अच्; or श्वपद with अण् added.
श्वाविध्: श्वाविध् m. (-विद् or वित्) A porcupine. E. श्वन् a dog, आङ् before व्यध to pierce, aff. क्विप्.
श्वाश्व: श्वाश्व n. (-श्वः) BHAIRAVA, or ŚIVA, in a terrific form. E. श्व a dog, and अश्व a horse, being usually represented mounted on a dog.
श्वास: श्वास m. (-सः) 1 Breath, breathing. 2 Air, wind. 3 Sighing, a sigh. E. श्वस to breathe, aff. ण.
श्वासप्रश्वासधारण: श्वासप्रश्वासधारण n. (-णं) Breathing through the nostrils for a few seconds as a religious exercise: see प्राणायाम. E. श्वास inspiration, प्रश्वास expiration, and धारण holding or checking.
श्वासहेति: श्वासहेति f. (-तिः) Sleep, sleepiness. E. श्वास breathing or sighing, and हेति a weapon.
श्वासारि: श्वासारि m. (-रिः) A plant, commonly Bamanaiṭhi. E. श्वास breath, and अरि hostile.
श्वासिन्: श्वासिन् m. (-सी) Air, wind. E. श्वास breath, and इनि aff.
श्वि: श्वि (इर टु and ओ) टुओश्वि r. 1st cl. (श्वयति) 1 To move, to go, or go to. 2 To grow, to increase.
श्वित: श्वित (आ) श्विता r. 1st cl. (श्वेतते) To be white.
श्वित्र: श्वित्र n. (-त्रं) Whiteness of the skin, vitiligo. E. श्वित to be white, Uṇādi aff. रक्.
श्वित्रघ्नी: श्वित्रघ्नी f. (-घ्नी) A plant, (Tragia involucrata.) E. श्वित्र vitiligo, and घ्न destroying.
श्वित्रिन्: श्वित्रिन् mfn. (-त्री-त्रिणी-त्रि) Affected with vitiligo or whiteness of the skin. E. श्वित्र, and इनि aff.
श्विद: श्विद (इ) श्विदि r. 1st cl. (श्विंदते) To be white, to become or continue so.
श्वॄ: श्वॄ r. 9th cl. (श्वृणाति) To hurt, to injure, to wound or kill.
श्वेत: श्वेत mfn. (-तः-ता-तं) White. m. (-तः) 1 White, (the colour.) 2 The planet VENUS, or its regent ŚUKRA. 3 The sixth range of mountains, dividing the known continent, the white mountains separating the Varṣas of Hiraṇmaya and Romanaka. 4 One of the minor Dvīpas or divisions of the world; in fable the White Island, identified geographically by WILFORD, with Britain. 5 A white cloud. 6 Cumminseed. 7 A conch. mf. (-तः-ता) A small white shell used as a coin, a Cowri. n. (-तं) Silver. f. (-ता) 1 A grass, (Andropogon aciculatum.) 2 A plant, Kāṣṭha Pātāla(?) 3 A flower, (Clitoria ternatea.) 4 Hogweed. 5 Bent grass with white blossoms. 6 Bambu manna. 7 Crystal. 8 Clayed or candied sugar. E. श्वित to be white, aff. अच् or घञ्.
श्वेतक: श्वेतक m. (-कः) A Cowri. n. (-कं) Silver. E. कन् added to the preceding.
श्वेतकुञ्जर: श्वेतकुञ्जर m. (-रः) INDRA'S elephant. E. श्वेत white, and कुञ्जर an elephant.
श्वेतकेतु: श्वेतकेतु m. (-तुः) A Bauddha or Jaina saint. E. श्वेत white, and केतु a banner.
श्वेतकेश: श्वेतकेश m. (-शः) A variety of the Hyperanthera morunga. E. श्वेत white, and केश a filament.
श्वेतकोल: श्वेतकोल n. (-लः) The Saphara fish, (Cyprinus Sophore, HAM.)
श्वेतखदिर: श्वेतखदिर m. (-रः) A white variety of the Mimosa catechu. E. श्वेत, and खदिर the Khayar.
श्वेतगज: श्वेतगज m. (-जः) 1 A white elephant. 2 The elephant of INDRA. E. श्वेत white, and गज an elephant.
श्वेतगरुत्: श्वेतगरुत् m. (-रुत्) A goose. E. श्वेत white, and गरुत् a wing.
श्वेतच्छद: श्वेतछद m. (-दः) 1 A goose. 2 A kind of basil, (Ocymum album, &c.) E. श्वेत white, and छद a feather or leaf.
श्वेतछद: श्वेतछद m. (-दः) 1 A goose. 2 A kind of basil, (Ocymum album, &c.) E. श्वेत white, and छद a feather or leaf.
श्वेतटङ्कण: श्वेतटङ्कण n. (-णं) White or refined borax. E. श्वेत white, and टङ्कण the same.
श्वेतदूर्वा: श्वेतदूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A bent grass with white blossoms. E. श्वेत, and टूर्व्वा Doob grass.
श्वेतदूर्व्वा: श्वेतदूर्व्वा f. (-र्व्वा) A bent grass with white blossoms. E. श्वेत, and टूर्व्वा Doob grass.
श्वेतद्विप: श्वेतद्विप m. (-पः) 1 A white elephant. 2 INDRA'S elephant. E. श्वेत white, and द्विप an elephant.
श्वेतद्वीप: श्वेतद्वीप m. (-पः) The white island, or a minor division of the universe so called: also termed Candra Dvīpa, and supposed by WILFORD to be Britain. E. श्वेत white, and द्वीप an island; also श्वेत q. v.
श्वेतधातु: श्वेतधातु m. (-तुः) 1 Chalk. 2 The milk stone, opal or chalcedony. E. श्वेत white, घातु a mineral.
श्वेतधामन्: श्वेतधामन् m. (-मा) 1 The moon. 2 Camphor. 3 Cuttle fish bone. E. श्वेत white, and धामन् a ray.
श्वेतनील: श्वेतनील m. (-लः) A cloud. E. श्वेत white, and नील black or dark blue.
श्वेतपत्र: श्वेतपत्र m. (-त्रः) A goose. E. श्वेत white, and पत्र a feather.
श्वेतपत्ररथ: श्वेतपत्ररथ m. (-थः) BRAHMĀ. E. श्वेतपत्र a goose, and रथ a car or conveyance.
श्वेतपद्म: श्वेतपद्म n. (-द्मं) The white lotus. E. श्वेत white, and पद्म a lotus.
श्वेतपर्णास: श्वेतपर्णास m. (-सः) Holy basil, or a variety of it, (Ocymum sanctum or album). E. श्वेत white, and पर्णास the same.
श्वेतपाटला: श्वेतपाटला f. (-ला) Trumpet flower, (Bignonia suave-olens.) E. श्वेत white, and पाटला the same.
श्वेतपिङ्ग: श्वेतपिङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) A lion. E. श्वेत white, and पिङ्ग tawny; of a light tawny colour.
श्वेतपिङ्गल: श्वेतपिङ्गल m. (-लः) A lion. E. श्वेत white, and पिङ्गल tawny; see the last; also with कन् added, श्वेतपिङ्गलक.
श्वेतपुष्प: श्वेतपुष्प m. (-ष्पः) A plant, (Vitex trifolia.) f. (-ष्पा) A Ghoṣa with white flowers. E. श्वेत white, and पुष्प a flower.
श्वेतपुष्पक: श्वेतपुष्पक m. (-कः) A plant, (Nerium odorum, the white variety.) E. कन् added to the last.
श्वेतप्रसूनक: श्वेतप्रसूनक m. (-कः) A tree, (Tapia cratæva.) E. श्वेत white, (flowers,) प्रसूनक productive.
श्वेतमरिच: श्वेतमरिच n. (-चं) The seed of the Hyperanthera morunga. E. श्वेत white, and मरिच pepper.
श्वेतरक्त: श्वेतरक्त m. (-क्तः) Pale red or pink, (the colour.) E. श्वेत white, and रक्त red.
श्वेतरथ: श्वेतरथ m. (-थः) The planet VENUS. E. श्वेत white, and रथ a car.
श्वेतरञ्जन: श्वेतरञ्जन n. (-नं) Lead. E. श्वेत white, रञ्जन colouring.
श्वेतरास्ना: श्वेतरास्ना f. (-स्ना) A plant, white Rasan: see रास्ना.
श्वेतरोचिस्: श्वेतरोचिस् m. (-चिः) The moon. E. श्वेत white, and रोचिस् light.
श्वेतरोहित: श्वेतरोहित m. (-तः) GARUḌA. E. श्वेत white, and रोहित red.
श्वेतवचा: श्वेतवचा f. (-चा) Orris root, (Acorus calamus.) E. श्वेत white, and वचा the same.
श्वेतवल्कल: श्वेतवल्कल m. (-लः) Glomerous fig tree, (Ficus glomerata.) E. श्वेत white, and वल्कल bark.
श्वेतवाजिन्: श्वेतवाजिन् m. (-जी) 1 The moon. 2 The prince ARJUNA. E. श्वेत white, वाजि a horse, इनि aff.
श्वेतवासस्: श्वेतवासस् m. (-साः) A religious mendicant, wearing white garments. E. श्वेत, and वासस् vesture.
श्वेतवाह: श्वेतवाह m. (-हः) ARJUNA. E. श्वेत white, and वाह a horse.
श्वेतवाहन: श्वेतवाहन m. (-नः) 1 The moon. 2 ARJUNA. 3 The Makara, a marine monster. E. श्वेत white, and वाहन a vehicle.
श्वेतवाहिन्: श्वेतवाहिन् m. (-ही) ARJUNA. E. श्वेत white, and वाह a vehicle, (a horse,) इनि aff.
श्वेतशुङ्ग: श्वेतशुङ्ग m. (-ङ्गः) Barley. E. श्वेत white, and शुङ्ग awn.
श्वेतसर्प: श्वेतसर्प m. (-र्पः) 1 A tree, (Tapia cratæva.) 2 A white snake. E. श्वेत white, सर्प what creeps or grows, or a serpent.
श्वेतसार: श्वेतसार m. (-रः) A tree, (Mimosa catechu) E. श्वेत white, सार pith or essence.
श्वेतसुरसा: श्वेतसुरसा f. (-सा) A white variety of the Nyctanthes arbor-tristis. E. श्वेत white, and सुरसा the Rasan, &c. to which it is compared.
श्वेतहय: श्वेतहय m. (-यः) 1 A white horse. 2 The horse of INDRA. 3 A name of ARJUNA. E. श्वेत white, and हय a horse.
श्वेतहस्तिन्: श्वेतहस्तिन् m. (-स्ती) 1 A white elephant. 2 The elephant of INDRA. E. श्वेत white, and हस्तिन् an elephant.
श्वेतार्क: श्वेतार्क m. (-र्कः) Gigantic swallow-wort, (Asclepias gigantea,) with white flowers. E. श्वेत white, and अर्क the same.
श्वेतोदर: श्वेतोदर m. (-रः) KUVERA. E. श्वेत white, and उदर the belly.
श्वैत्य: श्वैत्य n. (-त्यं) 1 Whiteness. 2 Vitiligo. E. श्वित or श्वेत, and ष्यञ् aff.
श्वैत्र: श्वैत्र n. (-त्रं) Vitiligo. E. श्वेत to be white, रन् aff.
श्वोवसीयस: श्वोवसीयस mfn. (-सः-सा-सं) Auspicious, fortunate. E. श्वेस and वस both particles implying auspiciousness, ईयसुन् affixed to the latter, and a final vowel added to the compound. ष
